<script id="kb-r2">
/* KBR2 · WebGL2 renderer (Beta 3D 3.0 · Ultra Realistic Graphics Overhaul) */
(()=>{'use strict';
/* ===== KBR2 · A: matematika + proceduralne PBR teksture (bez spoljnih fajlova) ===== */
const TAU=Math.PI*2,clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v,lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t,smooth=t=>t*t*(3-2*t);
const M4={
  // iste konvencije kao pogon: kolona-major, desna ruka, y gore, vertikalni FOV u radijanima
  persp(fov,asp,n,f){const v=1/Math.tan(fov/2),d=1/(n-f);return new Float32Array([v/asp,0,0,0,0,v,0,0,0,0,(f+n)*d,-1,0,0,2*f*n*d,0])},
  look(e,t,roll=0){let z=[e[0]-t[0],e[1]-t[1],e[2]-t[2]],l=Math.hypot(...z)||1;z=z.map(q=>q/l);let x=[z[2],0,-z[0]];l=Math.hypot(...x)||1;x=x.map(q=>q/l);let y=[z[1]*x[2]-z[2]*x[1],z[2]*x[0]-z[0]*x[2],z[0]*x[1]-z[1]*x[0]];const old=x;x=x.map((v,i)=>v*Math.cos(roll)+y[i]*Math.sin(roll));y=y.map((v,i)=>v*Math.cos(roll)-old[i]*Math.sin(roll));return new Float32Array([x[0],y[0],z[0],0,x[1],y[1],z[1],0,x[2],y[2],z[2],0,-x[0]*e[0]-x[1]*e[1]-x[2]*e[2],-y[0]*e[0]-y[1]*e[1]-y[2]*e[2],-z[0]*e[0]-z[1]*e[1]-z[2]*e[2],1])},
  mul(a,b){const o=new Float32Array(16);for(let c=0;c<4;c++)for(let r=0;r<4;r++)for(let k=0;k<4;k++)o[4*c+r]+=a[4*k+r]*b[4*c+k];return o},
  ortho(l,r,b,t,n,f){const w=1/(r-l),h=1/(t-b),d=1/(f-n);return new Float32Array([2*w,0,0,0,0,2*h,0,0,0,0,-2*d,0,-(r+l)*w,-(t+b)*h,-(f+n)*d,1])},
  lookDir(e,dir){let z=[-dir[0],-dir[1],-dir[2]];const up=Math.abs(dir[1])>.97?[1,0,0]:[0,1,0];let x=[up[1]*z[2]-up[2]*z[1],up[2]*z[0]-up[0]*z[2],up[0]*z[1]-up[1]*z[0]];let l=Math.hypot(...x)||1;x=x.map(q=>q/l);const y=[z[1]*x[2]-z[2]*x[1],z[2]*x[0]-z[0]*x[2],z[0]*x[1]-z[1]*x[0]];return {m:new Float32Array([x[0],y[0],z[0],0,x[1],y[1],z[1],0,x[2],y[2],z[2],0,-(x[0]*e[0]+x[1]*e[1]+x[2]*e[2]),-(y[0]*e[0]+y[1]*e[1]+y[2]*e[2]),-(z[0]*e[0]+z[1]*e[1]+z[2]*e[2]),1]),x,y,z}},
  planes(vp){const p=[];for(const [s,i] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[1,1],[-1,1],[1,2],[-1,2]]){const a=vp[3]+s*vp[i],b=vp[7]+s*vp[4+i],c=vp[11]+s*vp[8+i],d=vp[15]+s*vp[12+i],l=Math.hypot(a,b,c)||1;p.push([a/l,b/l,c/l,d/l])}return p}
};

M4.inv=function(m){const a=m,o=new Float32Array(16);
  const a00=a[0],a01=a[1],a02=a[2],a03=a[3],a10=a[4],a11=a[5],a12=a[6],a13=a[7],a20=a[8],a21=a[9],a22=a[10],a23=a[11],a30=a[12],a31=a[13],a32=a[14],a33=a[15];
  const b00=a00*a11-a01*a10,b01=a00*a12-a02*a10,b02=a00*a13-a03*a10,b03=a01*a12-a02*a11,b04=a01*a13-a03*a11,b05=a02*a13-a03*a12,b06=a20*a31-a21*a30,b07=a20*a32-a22*a30,b08=a20*a33-a23*a30,b09=a21*a32-a22*a31,b10=a21*a33-a23*a31,b11=a22*a33-a23*a32;
  let d=b00*b11-b01*b10+b02*b09+b03*b08-b04*b07+b05*b06;if(!d)return o;d=1/d;
  o[0]=(a11*b11-a12*b10+a13*b09)*d;o[1]=(a02*b10-a01*b11-a03*b09)*d;o[2]=(a31*b05-a32*b04+a33*b03)*d;o[3]=(a22*b04-a21*b05-a23*b03)*d;
  o[4]=(a12*b08-a10*b11-a13*b07)*d;o[5]=(a00*b11-a02*b08+a03*b07)*d;o[6]=(a32*b02-a30*b05-a33*b01)*d;o[7]=(a20*b05-a22*b02+a23*b01)*d;
  o[8]=(a10*b10-a11*b08+a13*b06)*d;o[9]=(a01*b08-a00*b10-a03*b06)*d;o[10]=(a30*b04-a31*b02+a33*b00)*d;o[11]=(a21*b02-a20*b04-a23*b00)*d;
  o[12]=(a11*b07-a10*b09-a12*b06)*d;o[13]=(a00*b09-a01*b07+a02*b06)*d;o[14]=(a31*b01-a30*b03-a32*b00)*d;o[15]=(a20*b03-a21*b01+a22*b00)*d;return o};
function aabbVisible(pl,mn,mx){for(const p of pl){const x=p[0]>0?mx[0]:mn[0],y=p[1]>0?mx[1]:mn[1],z=p[2]>0?mx[2]:mn[2];if(p[0]*x+p[1]*y+p[2]*z+p[3]<0)return false}return true}

/* --- brzi tileable proceduralni šum (optimizovan za 512x512 teksture) --- */
function rng(seed){let s=seed>>>0||1;return()=>{s^=s<<13;s>>>=0;s^=s>>>17;s^=s<<5;s>>>=0;return s/4294967296}}
function valueNoise(N,px,py,seed){
  const r=rng(seed),g=new Float32Array(px*py);for(let i=0;i<g.length;i++)g[i]=r();const o=new Float32Array(N*N);
  const xaA=new Int32Array(N),xbA=new Int32Array(N),txA=new Float32Array(N);
  for(let x=0;x<N;x++){const fx=x/N*px,x0=fx|0;xaA[x]=x0%px;xbA[x]=(x0+1)%px;const t=fx-x0;txA[x]=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  for(let y=0;y<N;y++){const fy=y/N*py,y0=fy|0,t=fy-y0,ty=t*t*(3-2*t),ya=(y0%py)*px,yb=((y0+1)%py)*px,row=y*N;
    for(let x=0;x<N;x++){const xa=xaA[x],xb=xbA[x],tx=txA[x];
      const a0=g[ya+xa],a1=g[ya+xb],b0=g[yb+xa],b1=g[yb+xb];
      const c0=a0+(a1-a0)*tx,c1=b0+(b1-b0)*tx;o[row+x]=c0+(c1-c0)*ty}}return o}
function fbm(N,px,py,oct,seed,gain=.5){const o=new Float32Array(N*N);let amp=1,sum=0;for(let k=0;k<oct;k++){const n=valueNoise(N,px<<k,py<<k,seed+k*977);for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++)o[i]+=n[i]*amp;sum+=amp;amp*=gain}const inv=1/sum;for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++)o[i]*=inv;return o}
function worley(N,cells,seed){
  const r=rng(seed),px=new Float32Array(cells*cells),py=new Float32Array(cells*cells);
  for(let i=0;i<cells*cells;i++){px[i]=r();py[i]=r()}
  const f1=new Float32Array(N*N),f2=new Float32Array(N*N),id=new Float32Array(N*N),invC=1/(cells*cells),sc=cells/N;
  for(let y=0;y<N;y++){const v=y*sc,cy=v|0,row=y*N;
    for(let x=0;x<N;x++){const u=x*sc,cx=u|0;let a=99,b=99,ai=0;
      for(let j=-1;j<=1;j++){const gy=((cy+j)%cells+cells)%cells,gyc=gy*cells,oy=cy+j-v;
        for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++){const gx=((cx+i)%cells+cells)%cells,idx=gyc+gx,dx=cx+i+px[idx]-u,dy=oy+py[idx],d2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
          if(d2<a){b=a;a=d2;ai=idx}else if(d2<b)b=d2}}
      f1[row+x]=Math.sqrt(a);f2[row+x]=Math.sqrt(b);id[row+x]=ai*invC}}return {f1,f2,id}}
function hash01(n){const s=Math.sin(n*127.1+311.7)*43758.5453;return s-Math.floor(s)}

/* --- 8 PBR materijala: alb(RGB detalj, A visina) + nor(RGB Scharr normala, A mikro-hrapavost/AO) --- */
const TEX_LAYERS=['malter','cigla','crep','kora','asfalt','trava','sljunak','blato'];
function buildMaterials(N){
  const L=8,alb=new Uint8Array(N*N*4*L),nor=new Uint8Array(N*N*4*L);
  const put=(layer,fn)=>{ // fn(x,y) -> [r,g,b,h,roughMod]
    const h=new Float32Array(N*N),rm=new Float32Array(N*N),base=layer*N*N*4;
    for(let y=0;y<N;y++)for(let x=0;x<N;x++){const v=fn(x,y),i=base+(y*N+x)*4;
      alb[i]=clamp(v[0],0,1)*255;alb[i+1]=clamp(v[1],0,1)*255;alb[i+2]=clamp(v[2],0,1)*255;alb[i+3]=clamp(v[3],0,1)*255;
      h[y*N+x]=v[3];rm[y*N+x]=v.length>4?clamp(v[4],0,1):.5}
    return {h,rm}};
  // Scharr 3x3 filter za ciste, glatke normal mape bez artefakata
  const normals=(layer,pack,str)=>{const h=pack.h,rm=pack.rm,base=layer*N*N*4,w=N;
    for(let y=0;y<N;y++){const ym=((y+w-1)%w)*w,y0=y*w,yp=((y+1)%w)*w;
      for(let x=0;x<N;x++){const xm=(x+w-1)%w,xp=(x+1)%w;
        const gx=(3*h[ym+xm]+10*h[y0+xm]+3*h[yp+xm]-3*h[ym+xp]-10*h[y0+xp]-3*h[yp+xp])*(str/16);
        const gy=(3*h[ym+xm]+10*h[ym+x]+3*h[ym+xp]-3*h[yp+xm]-10*h[yp+x]-3*h[yp+xp])*(str/16);
        let nx=gx,ny=gy,nz=1,l=Math.hypot(nx,ny,nz)||1;nx/=l;ny/=l;nz/=l;
        const i=base+(y0+x)*4;nor[i]=(nx*.5+.5)*255;nor[i+1]=(ny*.5+.5)*255;nor[i+2]=(nz*.5+.5)*255;nor[i+3]=rm[y0+x]*255}}};
  // 0 malter (srpski bavalit/fasadni malter + slivanje kise + mikropore)
  {const a=fbm(N,6,6,4,11),b=fbm(N,20,3,3,12),c=fbm(N,80,80,3,13),d=valueNoise(N,160,160,14);
    const p=put(0,(x,y)=>{const i=y*N+x,grain=(c[i]-.5)*.14+(d[i]-.5)*.08,v=.5+(a[i]-.5)*.22+(b[i]-.5)*.17+grain;
      const h=clamp(c[i]*.52+a[i]*.32+d[i]*.16,0,1);return [v,v*.998,v*.985,h,.62+(1-h)*.28]});normals(0,p,2.8)}
  // 1 cigla (terakota opeka sa dubokim fugama, oborenim ivicama i razlicitim pecenjem)
  {const rows=16,cols=4,bh=N/rows,bw=N/cols,gr=fbm(N,64,64,3,21),wth=fbm(N,12,12,3,22);
    const p=put(1,(x,y)=>{const row=Math.floor(y/bh),off=(row&1)*bw/2,xx=(x+off)%N,col=Math.floor(xx/bw),fx=(xx%bw)/bw,fy=(y%bh)/bh,id=row*7+col*13;
      const gx=Math.min(fx,1-fx)*bw,gy=Math.min(fy,1-fy)*bh,edge=Math.min(gx,gy*1.55),mW=N*(2.1/256),bW=N*(5.2/256);
      const mort=edge<mW?1:0,bev=clamp((edge-mW)/bW,0,1),t=hash01(id)*.24-.12,g=gr[y*N+x],w=wth[y*N+x];
      const chip=edge<mW*2.2?(g-.5)*.22:0;
      const v=mort?.40+g*.12:.54+t+(g-.5)*.16+(w-.5)*.10+chip;
      const h=mort?.06+g*.06:clamp(.52+bev*.38+(g-.5)*.12,0,1);
      return [v*(mort?.98:1.08),v*(mort?.99:.94),v*(mort?.97:.86),h,mort?.92:.58+(1-bev)*.25]});normals(1,p,4.2)}
  // 2 crep (balkanski falcovani crep: talasasti profil, preklop, mahovina u zlebovima)
  {const rows=8,cols=6,th=N/rows,tw=N/cols,mo=fbm(N,16,16,3,31),gr=fbm(N,96,96,2,32);
    const p=put(2,(x,y)=>{const row=Math.floor(y/th),off=(row&1)*tw/2,xx=(x+off)%N,col=Math.floor(xx/tw),fx=(xx%tw)/tw,fy=(y%th)/th,id=row*11+col*5,t=hash01(id)*.24-.12;
      const wave=.5+.5*Math.cos(fx*TAU),ridge=Math.abs(fx-.5)*2,lap=Math.pow(1-fy,2.4)*.55,side=smooth(clamp((ridge-.80)/.20,0,1));
      const m=mo[y*N+x]>.64?(mo[y*N+x]-.64)*1.9:0;
      const v=.50+t+(gr[y*N+x]-.5)*.14-side*.24-lap*.18+(wave-.5)*.08;
      const h=clamp(.22+fy*.42+wave*.26*(1-side)-lap*.22,0,1);
      return [v*(1-m*.42),v*(1+m*.22),v*(1-m*.52),h,clamp(.42+m*.45+side*.28,0,1)]});normals(2,p,3.8)}
  // 3 kora/drvo (duboke uzduzne brazde i pukotine kore)
  {const a=fbm(N,12,2,5,41,.56),b=fbm(N,5,24,3,42),c=valueNoise(N,96,32,43);
    const p=put(3,(x,y)=>{const i=y*N+x,r=a[i],cr=smooth(clamp((r-.28)/.35,0,1)),v=.34+cr*.48+(b[i]-.5)*.14+(c[i]-.5)*.08;
      return [v*1.03,v*.93,v*.80,clamp(cr*.82+c[i]*.18,0,1),.84-.18*cr]});normals(3,p,4.4)}
  // 4 asfalt (realistican srpski asfalt: agregat, habanje, katranske pukotine, varijacija sjaja)
  {const g1=valueNoise(N,160,160,51),g2=valueNoise(N,64,64,52),lo=fbm(N,6,6,4,53),w=worley(N,5,54),med=fbm(N,20,20,3,55);
    const p=put(4,(x,y)=>{const i=y*N+x,crack=clamp(1-(w.f2[i]-w.f1[i])*42,0,1)*smooth(clamp((lo[i]-.46)/.22,0,1));
      const patch=smooth(clamp((med[i]+lo[i]*.35-.78)/.09,0,1)), fleck=hash01(x+N*y);
      const sp=g1[i]>.88?.17:(g1[i]<.12?-.08:0);
      const wear=(lo[i]-.5)*.18+(med[i]-.5)*.10;
      const v=.5+(g1[i]-.5)*.18+(g2[i]-.5)*.14+wear+sp-crack*.34;
      const h=clamp(.52+(g1[i]-.5)*.34+(g2[i]-.5)*.18-crack*.46,0,1);
      const rm=clamp(.56+(g2[i]-.5)*.22+(lo[i]-.5)*.28-crack*.25,0,1);
      return [v*.99-patch*.07,v-patch*.072,v*1.02-patch*.068,clamp(h+patch*.07+(fleck-.5)*.09,0,1),clamp(rm-patch*.17,0,1)]});normals(4,p,2.3)}
  // 5 trava (gusti vlati + mikro senka korena)
  {const a=valueNoise(N,180,90,61),b=fbm(N,8,8,4,62),c=valueNoise(N,72,36,63);
    const p=put(5,(x,y)=>{const i=y*N+x,blade=a[i]*.55+c[i]*.45,v=.48+(blade-.5)*.44+(b[i]-.5)*.34;
      return [v*.93,v*1.06,v*.84,clamp(blade*.72+b[i]*.28,0,1),.78+(1-blade)*.18]});normals(5,p,2.0)}
  // 6 sljunak (ostri krecnjacki kamencici)
  {const w=worley(N,24,71),lo=fbm(N,8,8,3,72),fine=valueNoise(N,128,128,73);
    const p=put(6,(x,y)=>{const i=y*N+x,d=Math.min(1,w.f1[i]*1.65),st=hash01(w.id[i]*977)*.36-.18;
      const v=.56+st-d*.26+(lo[i]-.5)*.12+(fine[i]-.5)*.10;
      const h=clamp(1-d*d,0,1);return [v,v*.97,v*.91,h,.55+d*.38]});normals(6,p,4.4)}
  // 7 blato/zemlja (vlazna zemlja sa pukotinama i sitnim kamenjem)
  {const lo=fbm(N,5,5,4,81),mid=fbm(N,22,22,3,82),w=worley(N,7,83),gr=valueNoise(N,128,128,84);
    const p=put(7,(x,y)=>{const i=y*N+x,crack=clamp(1-(w.f2[i]-w.f1[i])*24,0,1)*.75;
      const v=.45+(lo[i]-.5)*.34+(mid[i]-.5)*.14+(gr[i]-.5)*.08-crack*.24;
      const h=clamp(lo[i]*.62+mid[i]*.28+gr[i]*.10-crack*.35,0,1);
      return [v*1.06,v*.96,v*.84,h,.66+(1-lo[i])*.24]});normals(7,p,2.8)}
  // normalizacija srednje svetline sloja = 0.5
  for(let layer=0;layer<L;layer++){const base=layer*N*N*4;let sum=0;for(let i=0;i<N*N;i++){const o=base+i*4;sum+=(alb[o]+alb[o+1]+alb[o+2])/3}const mean=sum/(N*N)/255,k=.5/Math.max(.05,mean);
    for(let i=0;i<N*N;i++){const o=base+i*4;alb[o]=clamp(alb[o]/255*k,0,1)*255;alb[o+1]=clamp(alb[o+1]/255*k,0,1)*255;alb[o+2]=clamp(alb[o+2]/255*k,0,1)*255}}
  return {alb,nor,N,L};
}

/* ===== KBR2 · B: GLSL ES 3.00 shaderi (PBR GGX + SSAO + Vogel PCF + Volumetrija + CAS) ===== */
const GLSL_HEAD='#version 300 es\nprecision highp float;precision highp int;precision highp sampler2D;precision highp sampler2DArray;precision highp sampler2DShadow;\n';
const GLSL_NOISE=`
float h11(float p){p=fract(p*.1031);p*=p+33.33;p*=p+p;return fract(p);}
float h21(vec2 p){vec3 q=fract(vec3(p.xyx)*.1031);q+=dot(q,q.yzx+33.33);return fract((q.x+q.y)*q.z);}
float h31(vec3 p){p=fract(p*.1031);p+=dot(p,p.zyx+31.32);return fract((p.x+p.y)*p.z);}
float ign(vec2 p){return fract(52.9829189*fract(dot(p,vec2(.06711056,.00583715))));}
float vnoise(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);return mix(mix(h21(i),h21(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),mix(h21(i+vec2(0,1)),h21(i+vec2(1,1)),f.x),f.y);}
float fbm2(vec2 p,int o){float a=.5,s=0.;for(int i=0;i<5;i++){if(i>=o)break;s+=a*vnoise(p);p=p*2.03+17.1;a*=.5;}return s;}
`;
/* nebo: Rayleigh/Mie atmosferski gradijent + gradski odsjaj Nisa nocu */
const GLSL_SKY=`
uniform vec3 uLDir;uniform vec3 uSunDir;uniform float uDusk;uniform float uRain;uniform float uFlash;uniform float uTime;uniform float uCloud;
vec3 skyBase(vec3 r){
  float ry=max(0.,r.y);
  vec3 horDay=pow(vec3(.74,.83,.89),vec3(2.2));
  vec3 zenDay=pow(vec3(.17,.40,.78),vec3(2.2));
  vec3 horNight=pow(vec3(.11,.155,.24),vec3(2.2));
  vec3 zenNight=pow(vec3(.018,.036,.085),vec3(2.2));
  vec3 hor=mix(horDay,horNight,uDusk);
  vec3 zen=mix(zenDay,zenNight,uDusk);
  vec3 c=mix(hor,zen,pow(ry,.46));
  // Diskretan topli odsjaj grada (Nis u dolini) blizu horizonta nocu
  float cityBand=exp(-ry*7.5)*uDusk*(1.-uRain*.35);
  float cityAz=.65+.35*sin(atan(r.x,r.z)*1.5+1.1);
  c+=vec3(.032,.020,.011)*cityBand*cityAz;
  // Olujno/kisno nebo
  vec3 grey=mix(pow(vec3(.50,.55,.60),vec3(2.2)),pow(vec3(.048,.060,.082),vec3(2.2)),uDusk);
  c=mix(c,grey,uRain*.76);
  // Sumrak/zora i Mie rasejanje oko sunca/meseca
  float s=max(dot(r,uSunDir),0.);
  float tw=(1.-smoothstep(-.08,.58,abs(uSunDir.y)));
  c+=vec3(1.,.46,.18)*pow(s,4.5)*tw*(1.-uRain*.82)*.72*(1.-uDusk*.55);
  c+=vec3(.95,.65,.40)*exp(-ry*5.5)*tw*(1.-uRain*.8)*.18*(1.-uDusk*.7);
  float m=max(dot(r,-uSunDir),0.);
  c+=vec3(.16,.24,.40)*pow(m,6.)*uDusk*(1.-uRain*.75)*.22;
  c+=vec3(.52,.66,.96)*(uFlash*.42);
  return c;
}`;

const VS_MAIN=GLSL_HEAD+`
layout(location=0) in vec3 aP;layout(location=1) in vec4 aC;layout(location=2) in float aT;layout(location=3) in vec2 aUV;layout(location=4) in vec4 aAux;layout(location=5) in vec3 aN;
uniform mat4 uVP;uniform vec3 uEye;out vec3 vP;out vec3 vC;out float vT;out vec2 vUV;flat out vec4 vAux;out vec3 vN;
invariant gl_Position;
void main(){vec3 P=aP;vT=aT;vC=aC.rgb;vP=aP;vUV=aUV*(1./16.);vAux=aAux;vN=aN;
  gl_Position=uVP*vec4(P,1.);}`;
const VS_PREPASS=GLSL_HEAD+`
layout(location=0) in vec3 aP;layout(location=1) in vec4 aC;layout(location=2) in float aT;
uniform mat4 uVP;uniform vec3 uEye;out vec3 vP;out vec3 vC;out float vT;
invariant gl_Position;
void main(){vec3 P=aP;vT=aT;vC=aC.rgb;vP=aP;
  gl_Position=uVP*vec4(P,1.);}`;
const VS_SHADOW=GLSL_HEAD+`
layout(location=0) in vec3 aP;layout(location=1) in vec4 aC;layout(location=2) in float aT;
uniform mat4 uVP;out vec3 vP;out vec3 vC;out float vT;
void main(){vP=aP;vC=aC.rgb;vT=aT;gl_Position=uVP*vec4(aP,1.);}`;
const VS_WIRE=GLSL_HEAD+`layout(location=0) in vec3 aP;uniform mat4 uVP;out vec3 vP;void main(){vP=aP;gl_Position=uVP*vec4(aP,1.);}`;
const FS_WIRE=GLSL_HEAD+GLSL_NOISE+GLSL_SKY+`
in vec3 vP;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;uniform vec3 uEye;uniform vec2 uFog;uniform float uFogDens;uniform float uGroundY;uniform vec3 uSkyAmb;uniform vec3 uLCol;
void main(){vec3 Vv=uEye-vP;float dist=length(Vv);vec3 V=Vv/max(dist,.001);
  vec3 col=vec3(.042,.047,.052)*(.45+uSkyAmb.x+uSkyAmb.y+uSkyAmb.z+uLCol.x*.25);
  vec3 fogDirV=normalize(vec3(-V.x,max(.06,-V.y*.4),-V.z));vec3 fogCol=skyBase(fogDirV);
  float f1=smoothstep(uFog.x,uFog.y,dist)*.9,f2=1.-exp(-dist*uFogDens*exp(-max(vP.y-uGroundY,0.)*.042));
  col=mix(col,fogCol,clamp(max(f1,f2),0.,.97));oC=vec4(col,0.);}`;
const FS_DEPTH=GLSL_HEAD+`
in vec3 vP;in vec3 vC;in float vT;
void main(){if(vT>7.0&&vT<8.0)discard;}`;

/* ===== SSAO (depth-based hemisphere occlusion + edge-preserving bilateral blur) ===== */
const FS_SSAO=(def)=>GLSL_HEAD+def+GLSL_NOISE+`
in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;
uniform sampler2D uDepth;uniform mat4 uInvP;uniform mat4 uProj;
uniform float uRadius;uniform float uBias;
#ifdef CONTACT
uniform vec3 uViewLight;
#endif
vec3 viewPos(vec2 tc){
  float z=texture(uDepth,tc).r;
  vec4 p=uInvP*vec4(tc*2.-1.,z*2.-1.,1.);
  return p.xyz/p.w;
}
void main(){
  float d0=texture(uDepth,uv).r;
  if(d0>=.9999){oC=vec4(1.,0.,1.,1.);return;}
  vec3 P=viewPos(uv);
  float linKey=exp(-max(-P.z,0.)*.03);
  if(-P.z>150.){oC=vec4(1.,linKey,1.,1.);return;}
  vec3 N=normalize(cross(dFdx(P),dFdy(P)));
  if(dot(N,-P)<0.)N=-N;
  vec3 T=normalize(abs(N.y)<.9?cross(N,vec3(0.,1.,0.)):cross(N,vec3(1.,0.,0.)));
  vec3 B=cross(N,T);
  float ang=ign(gl_FragCoord.xy)*6.2831853;
  float rad=uRadius*clamp(-P.z*.045,.55,2.4);
  float occ=0.;
  for(int i=0;i<SSAO_TAPS;i++){
    float fi=(float(i)+.5)/float(SSAO_TAPS);
    float r=sqrt(fi)*rad;
    float a=float(i)*2.3999632+ang;
    float hz=sqrt(max(.04,1.-fi))*.88+.12;
    vec3 sp=P+(T*cos(a)+B*sin(a))*r+N*(hz*rad*.85);
    vec4 q=uProj*vec4(sp,1.);
    vec2 suv=q.xy/q.w*.5+.5;
    if(suv.x<=.002||suv.x>=.998||suv.y<=.002||suv.y>=.998)continue;
    float sz=viewPos(suv).z;
    float diff=abs(P.z-sz);
    float rc=(1.-smoothstep(rad*.2,rad*2.4,diff));
    occ+=step(sp.z+uBias,sz)*rc;
  }
  float fade=(1.-smoothstep(95.,145.,-P.z));
  float ao=mix(1.,pow(clamp(1.-occ/float(SSAO_TAPS)*1.55,0.,1.),1.25),fade);
  float contact=1.;
#ifdef CONTACT
  if(-P.z<62.&&dot(N,uViewLight)>.04){
    for(int j=1;j<=9;j++){
      float t=(float(j)-.48)*.125;vec3 sp=P+N*.042+uViewLight*t;
      vec4 clip=uProj*vec4(sp,1.);if(clip.w<=0.)break;
      vec2 tc=clip.xy/clip.w*.5+.5;if(any(lessThan(tc,vec2(0)))||any(greaterThan(tc,vec2(1))))break;
      float dz=viewPos(tc).z-sp.z;
      if(dz>.021+t*.012&&dz<.12+t*.16){contact=mix(.23,1.,t/1.15);break;}
    }
  }
#endif
  oC=vec4(ao,linKey,contact,1.);
}`;

const FS_SSAO_BLUR=GLSL_HEAD+`
in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;
uniform sampler2D uSrc;uniform vec2 uDir;
void main(){
  vec2 c0=texture(uSrc,uv).rg;
  float sum=c0.r*.26,wsum=.26;
  const float W[4]=float[4](.21,.15,.09,.04);
  for(int i=1;i<=4;i++){
    float wi=W[i-1];
    vec2 s1=texture(uSrc,uv+uDir*float(i)).rg;
    vec2 s2=texture(uSrc,uv-uDir*float(i)).rg;
    float k1=exp(-abs(s1.g-c0.g)*45.)*wi;
    float k2=exp(-abs(s2.g-c0.g)*45.)*wi;
    sum+=s1.r*k1+s2.r*k2;wsum+=k1+k2;
  }
  oC=vec4(sum/max(wsum,.001),c0.g,texture(uSrc,uv).b,1.);
}`;

/* ===== GLAVNI PBR FRAGMENT SHADER ===== */
const GLSL_LEAF=`
float leafCoverage(vec2 uv){
  vec2 g=uv*vec2(6.,4.);float row=floor(g.y),col=floor(g.x+mod(row,2.)*.5);
  vec2 p=vec2(fract(g.x+mod(row,2.)*.5)-.5,fract(g.y)-.5);
  p.x+=p.y*(mod(col+row,2.)-.5)*.9;
  float blade=(1.-abs(p.y)*1.85)*.47-abs(p.x);
  float stem=.027-abs(uv.x-.5+.09*sin(uv.y*5.));
  float envelope=1.-dot((uv-.5)*vec2(1.84,1.72),(uv-.5)*vec2(1.84,1.72));
  return step(0.,min(envelope,max(stem,blade)));
}`;
const FS_MAIN=(def)=>GLSL_HEAD+def+GLSL_NOISE+GLSL_SKY+GLSL_LEAF+`
in vec3 vP;in vec3 vC;in float vT;in vec2 vUV;flat in vec4 vAux;in vec3 vN;
layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;
uniform vec3 uEye;uniform vec3 uLCol;uniform vec3 uSkyAmb;uniform vec3 uGndAmb;
uniform vec2 uFog;uniform float uFogDens;uniform float uGroundY;uniform float uSeason;uniform float uTorch;uniform float uMorse;
uniform vec3 uTorchPos;uniform vec3 uTorchDir;uniform vec2 uBeam;uniform vec3 uLights[12];uniform vec3 uLightRGB[12];uniform vec4 uLobe[12];uniform vec4 uWindows[2];uniform vec3 uSignal;uniform vec3 uFlashPos;
#ifdef SUN_SHADOW
uniform mat4 uSunVP[2];uniform vec2 uCasc;uniform float uCascN;uniform vec2 uShadowTexel;uniform sampler2DShadow uSunShadow;
#endif
#ifdef SPOT_SHADOW
uniform mat4 uSpotVP;uniform sampler2DShadow uSpotShadow;uniform float uSpotOn;uniform vec2 uSpotTexel;
#endif
uniform sampler2DArray uTexA;uniform sampler2DArray uTexN;uniform float uTexOn;
#ifdef SSAO
uniform sampler2D uAO;uniform vec2 uInvRes;uniform float uAOOn;
#endif
uniform float uWet;uniform float uSnow;uniform float uInterior;
uniform sampler2D uTerrN;uniform sampler2D uTerrM;uniform vec3 uTerrBox;uniform float uTerrOn;uniform sampler2D uSign;
vec3 toLin(vec3 c){return pow(max(c,vec3(0.)),vec3(2.2));}

/* Cook-Torrance GGX PBR specular */
vec3 ggxSpec(vec3 N,vec3 V,vec3 L,float rough,vec3 F0){
  float ndl=max(dot(N,L),0.);
  if(ndl<=.0001)return vec3(0.);
  vec3 H=normalize(L+V);
  float ndv=max(dot(N,V),.001),ndh=max(dot(N,H),0.),vdh=max(dot(V,H),0.);
  float a=max(rough*rough,.022),a2=a*a;
  float den=ndh*ndh*(a2-1.)+1.;
  float D=a2/(3.14159265*den*den);
  float k=(rough+1.)*(rough+1.)*.125;
  float G=(ndv/(ndv*(1.-k)+k))*(ndl/(ndl*(1.-k)+k));
  vec3 F=F0+(1.-F0)*pow(clamp(1.-vdh,0.,1.),5.);
  return (D*G*F)/max(4.*ndv*ndl,.001)*ndl;
}

#ifdef SUN_SHADOW
float sampleCascade(int c,vec3 P,vec3 N){
  float R=c==0?uCasc.x:uCasc.y;
  float texW=R*2.*uShadowTexel.y;
  vec3 Pn=P+N*(texW*1.65+.018);
  vec4 q=uSunVP[c]*vec4(Pn,1.);vec3 s=q.xyz*.5+.5;
  if(s.x<0.||s.x>1.||s.y<0.||s.y>1.||s.z>1.)return 1.;
  float m=2.5*uShadowTexel.x;
  float u=clamp((s.x+float(c))/uCascN,float(c)/uCascN+m,float(c+1)/uCascN-m);
  vec2 uv=vec2(u,clamp(s.y,uShadowTexel.y*2.5,1.-uShadowTexel.y*2.5));
  float slopeBias=clamp(1.-abs(dot(N,normalize(uLDir))),0.,1.)*(c==0?.0007:.0014);
  float ref=s.z-(c==0?.00045:.0011)-slopeBias;
#if SHADOW_TAPS>1
  float rot=h21(floor(uv/uShadowTexel))*6.2831853;
  float spread=c==0?1.85:1.55;
  float sh=0.;
  for(int i=0;i<SHADOW_TAPS;i++){
    float r=sqrt((float(i)+.5)/float(SHADOW_TAPS))*spread;
    float a=float(i)*2.3999632+rot;
    vec2 o=vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*r*uShadowTexel;
    sh+=texture(uSunShadow,vec3(uv+o,ref));
  }
  return sh/float(SHADOW_TAPS);
#else
  return texture(uSunShadow,vec3(uv,ref));
#endif
}
#endif

float sunShadow(vec3 P,vec3 N,float d){
#ifdef SUN_SHADOW
  if(d>uCasc.y||uLCol.x+uLCol.y+uLCol.z<.001)return 1.;
  float sh;
  if(uCascN>1.5){
    if(d<uCasc.x*.82)sh=sampleCascade(0,P,N);
    else if(d<uCasc.x){float s0=sampleCascade(0,P,N),s1=sampleCascade(1,P,N);sh=mix(s0,s1,smoothstep(uCasc.x*.82,uCasc.x,d));}
    else sh=sampleCascade(1,P,N);
  }else sh=sampleCascade(0,P,N);
  return mix(sh,1.,smoothstep(.84,1.,d/uCasc.y));
#else
  return 1.;
#endif
}

float spotShadow(vec3 P,vec3 N){
#ifdef SPOT_SHADOW
  if(uSpotOn<.5)return 1.;
  vec4 q=uSpotVP*vec4(P+N*.055,1.);if(q.w<=0.)return 1.;vec3 s=q.xyz/q.w*.5+.5;
  if(s.x<0.||s.x>1.||s.y<0.||s.y>1.||s.z>1.)return 1.;
  float ref=s.z-.00075;float sh=0.;
  float rot=ign(gl_FragCoord.xy)*6.2831853;
  for(int i=0;i<8;i++){
    float r=sqrt((float(i)+.5)/8.)*1.75;
    float a=float(i)*2.3999632+rot;
    sh+=texture(uSpotShadow,vec3(s.xy+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*r*uSpotTexel,ref));
  }
  return sh*.125;
#else
  return 1.;
#endif
}

vec4 tex1(float L,vec3 p,vec3 N,vec3 w,float sc,out vec3 nrm,out float rm){
#ifdef KB_ARCH_HIGH
  if((L==1.||L==2.||L==4.||L==6.)&&distance(p,uEye)<29.){
    vec3 U=w.y>max(w.x,w.z)?vec3(1,0,0):(w.x>w.z?vec3(0,0,1):vec3(1,0,0));
    vec3 B=w.y>max(w.x,w.z)?vec3(0,0,1):vec3(0,1,0);
    vec3 E=normalize(uEye-p);
    vec2 tc=vec2(dot(p,U),dot(p,B))*sc, gx=dFdx(tc), gy=dFdy(tc);
    vec2 delta=vec2(dot(E,U),dot(E,B))/max(.26,abs(dot(E,N)))*(L==4.?.019:.053)*sc;
    delta*=1.-smoothstep(15.,29.,distance(p,uEye));
    float depth=0., prev=0., diff=0.;vec2 q=tc;
    for(int j=0;j<10;j++){
      diff=depth-(1.-textureGrad(uTexA,vec3(q,L),gx,gy).a);
      if(diff>=0.)break;
      prev=diff;q-=delta*.111111;depth+=.111111;
    }
    q+=delta*.111111*clamp(diff/max(.001,diff-prev),0.,1.);
    vec4 normalR=textureGrad(uTexN,vec3(q,L),gx,gy);
    vec3 un=normalize(U-N*dot(U,N)),bn=normalize(B-N*dot(B,N)-un*dot(B,un));
    nrm=normalize(N*max(.25,normalR.b*2.-1.)+un*(normalR.r*2.-1.)+bn*(normalR.g*2.-1.));
    rm=normalR.a;return textureGrad(uTexA,vec3(q,L),gx,gy);
  }
#endif
#ifdef TRIPLANAR
  vec4 a=texture(uTexA,vec3(p.zy*sc,L)),b=texture(uTexA,vec3(p.xz*sc,L)),c=texture(uTexA,vec3(p.xy*sc,L));
  vec4 r=a*w.x+b*w.y+c*w.z;
  #ifdef NORMALMAP
  vec4 nx4=texture(uTexN,vec3(p.zy*sc,L)),ny4=texture(uTexN,vec3(p.xz*sc,L)),nz4=texture(uTexN,vec3(p.xy*sc,L));
  vec3 tx=nx4.xyz*2.-1.,ty=ny4.xyz*2.-1.,tz=nz4.xyz*2.-1.;
  tx=vec3(tx.xy+N.zy,N.x);ty=vec3(ty.xy+N.xz,N.y);tz=vec3(tz.xy+N.xy,N.z);
  nrm=normalize(tx.zyx*w.x+ty.xzy*w.y+tz.xyz*w.z);
  rm=nx4.a*w.x+ny4.a*w.y+nz4.a*w.z;
  #else
  nrm=N;rm=.5;
  #endif
  return r;
#else
  vec2 uv=w.y>.5?p.xz:(w.x>w.z?p.zy:p.xy);
  nrm=N;rm=.5;return texture(uTexA,vec3(uv*sc,L));
#endif
}

vec3 groundColor(vec2 xz,vec4 m,float slope){
  vec3 mead,forest,park,dry;
  if(uSeason<.5){mead=vec3(.34,.51,.22);forest=vec3(.14,.31,.15);park=vec3(.27,.51,.21);dry=vec3(.48,.44,.26);}
  else if(uSeason<1.5){mead=vec3(.32,.44,.20);forest=vec3(.13,.27,.14);park=vec3(.24,.42,.18);dry=vec3(.50,.45,.25);}
  else if(uSeason<2.5){mead=vec3(.50,.41,.21);forest=vec3(.36,.27,.14);park=vec3(.43,.37,.19);dry=vec3(.46,.34,.20);}
  else{mead=vec3(.82,.85,.86);forest=vec3(.66,.72,.71);park=vec3(.84,.87,.88);dry=vec3(.70,.73,.74);}
  float n1=vnoise(xz*.038),n2=vnoise(xz*.26+11.),n3=vnoise(xz*1.85+5.);
  vec3 c=mix(mead,dry,smoothstep(.40,.78,n1)*.62);
  c=mix(c,park,m.g);
  // Sumska prostirka (lisce/humus) u sumskim delovima Kalac brda
  vec3 litter=uSeason>2.5?vec3(.58,.62,.62):vec3(.23,.18,.11);
  c=mix(c,mix(forest*(.78+.42*n2),litter,smoothstep(.42,.74,n2)*.48),m.r);
  c*=.83+.30*n2+.12*(n3-.5);
  // Prirodni prelaz pored ulica i dvorista (plavi kanal maske terena)
  vec3 verge=uSeason>2.5?vec3(.68,.70,.72):vec3(.42,.39,.31);
  c=mix(c,verge,m.b*smoothstep(.35,.72,n2)*.38);
  // Strme padine Kalac brda: slojevi zemlje i krecnjackog kamena
  vec3 soil=uSeason>2.5?vec3(.55,.57,.59):vec3(.38,.29,.20);
  vec3 rock=uSeason>2.5?vec3(.52,.55,.58):vec3(.47,.45,.41);
  c=mix(c,soil,smoothstep(.13,.28,slope)*.72);
  c=mix(c,rock,smoothstep(.27,.46,slope)*.78*(.8+.35*n3));
  if(uSeason<.5){vec2 g=floor(xz*2.6);float f=step(.94,h21(g)),k=h21(g+7.);c=mix(c,k<.5?vec3(.95,.95,.88):vec3(.95,.80,.20),f*.85*(1.-m.r)*smoothstep(.45,.62,n1));}
  c=mix(vec3(dot(c,vec3(.33,.5,.17))),c,.86)*.94;
  return c;
}

// A window is an aperture into a finite room. Test nearer furniture boxes before the enclosing walls.
float roomBox(vec3 o,vec3 invRay,vec3 lo,vec3 hi){
  vec3 a=(lo-o)*invRay,b=(hi-o)*invRay,n=min(a,b),f=max(a,b);
  float nearT=max(max(n.x,n.y),n.z),farT=min(min(f.x,f.y),f.z);
  return nearT>0.&&nearT<farT?nearT:1e4;
}
vec3 interiorRoom(vec2 w,vec2 halfWindow,vec3 N,vec3 V,float seed,out float glow){
  vec3 U=normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0),N));vec3 d=normalize(vec3(-dot(V,U),-V.y,max(.065,dot(V,N))));
  vec3 iv=vec3(d.x<0.?-1.:1.,d.y<0.?-1.:1.,1.)/max(abs(d),vec3(.001));
  vec3 o=vec3(w,0.),hi=vec3(1.6+seed*.55,1.38,2.8+seed),lo=vec3(-hi.x,-1.48,0.);
  vec3 f=max((lo-o)*iv,(hi-o)*iv);float t=min(f.x,min(f.y,f.z));vec3 hit=o+t*d;
  vec3 plaster=mix(vec3(.42,.38,.30),vec3(.39,.45,.41),seed);
  vec3 c= f.y<t+.001?(d.y>0.?vec3(.70,.68,.59):vec3(.23,.145,.09)*(.78+.22*step(.06,fract(hit.x*4.)))):plaster*(f.x<t+.001?.71:1.);
  float frame=step(abs(hit.x+.52),.45)*step(abs(hit.y-.08),.33)*step(f.z,t+.001);
  c=mix(c,vec3(.22,.28,.23),frame);
  float shelf=roomBox(o,iv,vec3(.54,-1.48,1.68),vec3(1.33,-.33,2.13));
  float chair=roomBox(o,iv,vec3(-1.18,-1.24,1.05),vec3(-.43,-.65,1.69));
  if(min(shelf,chair)<t){hit=o+d*min(shelf,chair);c=shelf<chair?vec3(.23,.14,.085)*(.72+.28*step(.06,fract(hit.y*4.))):vec3(.26,.30,.28);}
  float drape=smoothstep(halfWindow.x*.60,halfWindow.x*.95,abs(w.x+.06*d.x))*(.35+.65*seed);
  c=mix(c,vec3(.58,.50,.37)*(.82+.18*cos(w.x*77.)),drape);
  glow=(1.-smoothstep(.3,3.6,length(hit-vec3(.28,1.02,1.6))))*.6+.24;
  return c;
}
void facade(inout vec3 base,inout vec3 emis,inout float glass,inout float rough,inout float spec,inout vec3 Nm,vec3 N,vec3 V){
  float L=vAux.x*.25,F=mod(vAux.y,16.),sd=vAux.z,door=vAux.w;bool dead=vAux.y>15.5;
  float u=vUV.x,v=vUV.y;const float fh=2.85;
  float pgrain=fbm2(vec2(u*.42,v*.57)+vec2(sd*.071,sd*.023),3);
  float rainStain=pow(vnoise(vec2(u*.17+sd*.031,v*.045)),2.8);
  base*=mix(.84,1.12,pgrain)*(1.-rainStain*.13);
#ifdef KB_ARCH_HIGH
  float chip=fbm2(vec2(u*2.7+sd*.21,v*3.8),3);
  float stone=fbm2(vec2(u*.9+sd*.032,v*.38),3);
  float damp=(1.-smoothstep(.22,1.85,v))*(.35+.65*stone);
  float faded=smoothstep(.43,.76,chip)*.14;
  base*=1.-damp*.18-faded;
  base=mix(base,base*vec3(.78,.84,.72),smoothstep(.68,.86,stone)*damp*.18);
  rough=clamp(rough+.06*damp,0.,1.);
#endif
  // Kamena/betonska sokla u prizemlju sa okapnicom
  float pl=1.-smoothstep(.42,.68,v);
  if(v<.74&&v>.63){base=mix(base,vec3(.56,.54,.51),.45);rough=.78;}
  base=mix(base,base*vec3(.60,.58,.55),pl*.78);
  if(v>.62&&v<.74)Nm=normalize(N+vec3(0,.30,0));
  if(v<0.)base=mix(base,vec3(.26,.25,.24),.42);
  // Realistican udeo izlozene opeke (tipicne nedovrsene/ciglene kuce na Kalac brdu)
  if(mod(sd,5.5)<.95 && v>.66){
    vec2 brick=vec2(u*1.58+mod(floor(v*3.4),2.)*.5,v*3.4);
    vec2 seam=abs(fract(brick)-.5);
    float mortar=smoothstep(.44,.485,max(seam.x,seam.y));
    float tone=.84+.28*h21(floor(brick));
#ifdef KB_ARCH_HIGH
    base=mix(base,base*vec3(.86,.62,.52)*tone,(1.-mortar)*.38);
    base*=1.-mortar*.22;
#else
    base=mix(base,base*vec3(.86,.62,.52)*tone,mortar*.29);
#endif
  }
  if(v<0.||L<2.2)return;
  float fi=floor(v/fh),fv=v-fi*fh;
  if(fi>=F)return;
  // Medjuspratni venac i krovna streha-senka
  if(fi>0.&&fv<.17){base*=.72;if(fv<.05)base*=.85;}
  if(fi==F-1.&&fv>2.56){float es=smoothstep(2.56,2.84,fv);base*=mix(1.,.64,es);}
  float nC=max(1.,floor((L-1.1)/2.6+.5)),pitch=L/nC;
  float ci=clamp(floor(u/pitch),0.,nC-1.),cu=(ci+.5)*pitch,du=u-cu;
  float ww=min(1.28,pitch*.56),hw=ww*.5,hh=.68,wy=fv-1.5;
  float hs=h21(vec2(sd*3.7+fi*17.,ci*7.3+3.));
  vec3 frameC=sd<96.?vec3(.88,.86,.82):(sd<190.?vec3(.28,.18,.11):vec3(.48,.52,.55));
  // Ulazna vrata sa pragom, nadsvetlom i diskretnim svetlom iznad ulaza nocu
  if(door>.5&&fi<.5&&ci==floor(nC*.5)){
    float ax=abs(du);
    // Malo ulazno svetlo iznad vrata na naseljenim kucama
    if(!dead&&uDusk>.15&&hs<.55){
      float lp=length(vec2(du,fv-2.34));
      if(lp<.09){emis=vec3(1.,.82,.52)*3.8*uDusk;base=vec3(.9,.8,.6);}
      else if(lp<1.1){base+=vec3(1.,.78,.45)*exp(-lp*2.2)*.18*uDusk;}
    }
    if(ax<.62&&fv<2.20){
      float inner=step(ax,.46)*step(fv,2.06)*step(.07,fv);
      vec3 dc=sd<110.?vec3(.16,.09,.05):(sd<200.?vec3(.09,.18,.13):vec3(.16,.18,.21));
      // Paneli vrata
      float panel=step(abs(du),.34)*step(abs(fv-.62),.34)+step(abs(du),.34)*step(abs(fv-1.55),.38);
      base=mix(frameC*.85,dc*(1.-panel*.14),inner);rough=.52;spec=.06;
      if(fv<.08)base=vec3(.44,.43,.40);
      if(inner>.5){
        float pane=step(abs(du),.18)*step(1.38,fv)*step(fv,1.94);
        if(pane>.5){base=vec3(.02,.03,.038);glass=1.;rough=.10;spec=.62;emis=vec3(1.,.72,.38)*1.15*uDusk*step(.45,hs);}
        float knob=step(length(vec2(du-.33,fv-1.0)),.042);base=mix(base,vec3(.78,.68,.36),knob);
      }
      Nm=normalize(N+vec3(0,.26*sign(fv-1.05)*(1.-smoothstep(.008,.045,abs(abs(fv-1.05)-.59))),0));
    }
    return;
  }
  float ax=abs(du),ay=abs(wy);
  // Trag kise ispod prozorske klupcice
  if(ax<hw+.06&&wy<-hh-.10&&wy>-hh-.68){
    float st=(1.-(1.-smoothstep(-hh-.68,-hh-.12,wy)))*(1.-smoothstep(hw-.10,hw+.06,ax));
    base*=1.-st*.11;
  }
#ifdef KB_ARCH_HIGH
  if(ax<hw+.23&&wy>hh+.045&&wy<hh+.16){
    float ledge=1.-smoothstep(hh+.06,hh+.16,wy);
    base=mix(base,vec3(.42,.40,.37),ledge*.52);
    rough=.86;
  }
  if(ax<hw+.05&&ay<hh+.04){
    float opening=(1.-smoothstep(hw-.12,hw+.045,ax))*(1.-smoothstep(hh-.12,hh+.035,ay));
    base*=mix(1.,.68,opening*.28);
  }
#endif
  // Spoljni okvir i duboka senka spaletne
  if(ax<hw+.19&&ay<hh+.19){
    float edge=max(ax-hw,ay-hh);
    if(edge>0.){float lit=smoothstep(.02,.16,edge);base=mix(base,vec3(.62,.61,.57),.26+.24*lit);rough=.82;Nm=normalize(N+normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0),N))*sign(du)*step(ay-hh,ax-hw)*.45+vec3(0,sign(wy)*step(ax-hw,ay-hh)*.45,0));}
    if(wy>hh&&wy<hh+.11)base*=.78;
  }
  // Izbacena prozorska klupcica sa senkom ispod
  if(ay<hh+.13&&ax<hw+.15&&wy<-hh&&wy>-hh-.13){base=vec3(.68,.66,.63)*(wy<-hh-.06?.64:1.03);rough=.72;Nm=normalize(N+vec3(0,.55,0));return;}
  // Roletne / kapci
  float blinds=h21(vec2(sd*1.13+fi,ci*3.9));
  if(blinds>.82&&ax<hw+.13&&ay<hh-.06&&ax>hw-.13){
    float slat=.78+.22*step(.25,fract((wy+hh)*10.5));
    base=vec3(.34,.24,.15)*slat;Nm=normalize(N+vec3(0,.22*cos((wy+hh)*66.),0));rough=.78;return;
  }
  if(ax<hw&&ay<hh){
    Nm=N;
    bool fr=ax>hw-.085||ay>hh-.085;
    bool bar=ax<.026||(abs(wy-.12)<.028&&hs<.72);
    if(fr||bar){vec3 tangent=normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0),N));
      Nm=normalize(N+tangent*(ax/hw>ay/hh?sign(du)*.32:0.)+vec3(0,ay/hh>=ax/hw?sign(wy)*.32:0.,0));base=frameC;rough=.46;spec=.07;return;}
    glass=1.;rough=.08;spec=.68;
    float glow;vec3 room=interiorRoom(vec2(du,wy),vec2(hw,hh),N,V,hs,glow);
    float on=(!dead&&hs<.52)?1.:0.;vec3 lamp=hs>.43?vec3(.88,.94,1.):vec3(1.,.68,.37);
    base=room*(.48-.28*uDusk); emis=room*lamp*(.06+on*glow*2.5*uDusk);
    glass=mix(.68,.30,on*uDusk);rough=.14;
  }
}

void main(){
  if(vT>9.1&&vT<9.4&&leafCoverage(vUV)<.5)discard;
  if(vT>7.0&&vT<8.0){oC=vec4(vC*1.6,vT-7.0);return;}
  vec3 dx=dFdx(vP),dy=dFdy(vP);vec3 N=normalize(cross(dx,dy));
  if(dot(vN,vN)>.25)N=normalize(vN);
  vec3 Vv=uEye-vP;float dist=length(Vv);vec3 V=Vv/max(dist,.001);
  if(dot(N,V)<0.)N=-N;
  float cls=floor(vT+.5);
  vec3 base=toLin(vC);
  float rough=.85,spec=.04;vec3 emis=vec3(0.);float glass=0.;float texRM=.5;
  if(uTerrOn>.5&&(cls==6.||cls==5.)){
    vec2 tuv=(vP.xz-uTerrBox.xy)*uTerrBox.z;vec4 tn=texture(uTerrN,tuv);vec2 e=tn.rg*2.-1.;
    vec3 tN=normalize(vec3(e.x,sqrt(max(.0,1.-dot(e,e))),e.y));
    if(cls==6.){N=tN;vec4 tm=texture(uTerrM,tuv);base=toLin(groundColor(vP.xz,tm,1.-N.y));}
    else if(N.y>.75){N=normalize(mix(N,tN,.65));}
  }
  vec3 Nm=N;
  vec3 w=pow(abs(N),vec3(4.));w/=max(w.x+w.y+w.z,.001);
  float wetMask=0.;
  bool isSidewalk=(cls==5.&&vT>5.15&&vT<5.35);
  bool isAsphalt=(cls==5.&&!isSidewalk&&dot(vC,vec3(.3,.59,.11))<.42);
  if(uTexOn>.5&&(cls<7.||cls==9.)){
    float L=-1.,sc=1.;
    float lum=dot(vC,vec3(.3,.59,.11));
    if(cls==1.){float fr=vT-cls;L=fr>.05?1.:(fr<-.05?0.:(h31(floor(vC*255.))>.55?1.:0.));sc=L>.5?.52:.26;rough=.88;}
    else if(cls==2.){L=2.;sc=.78;rough=.60;spec=.06;}
    else if(cls==3.){bool leaf=vC.g>vC.r*1.12&&vC.g>vC.b*1.1;L=leaf?5.:3.;sc=leaf?.8:.72;rough=.88;}
    else if(cls==5.){
      if(isSidewalk){L=0.;sc=.45;rough=.82;wetMask=.75;}
      else{L=lum<.42?4.:(vC.r>vC.g*.95&&lum>.45?6.:7.);sc=L==4.?.26:(L==6.?.72:.42);rough=L==4.?.68:.92;wetMask=L==4.?1.:.65;}
    }
    else if(cls==6.){float pn=vnoise(vP.xz*.045);L=pn>.72?7.:5.;sc=L==7.?.36:.92;rough=.92;}
    else if(cls==9.){L=5.;sc=1.45;rough=.76;spec=.05;}
    if(L>=0.){
      vec3 nn;float rm;vec4 t=tex1(L,vP,N,w,sc,nn,rm);
      base*=t.rgb*1.92;Nm=nn;texRM=rm;
      rough=clamp(rough+(rm-.5)*.26,.08,.98);
    }
  }
  // Mikro-detalji asfalta i betonskih trotoara/ivicnjaka
  if(isAsphalt){
    float macro=fbm2(vP.xz*.09,3);
    float patchN=smoothstep(.64,.82,vnoise(vP.xz*.18+3.1));
    float lane=abs(vUV.x),ruts=vAux.x>.5?exp(-pow((lane-vAux.x*.021)*3.,2.)):0.;
    base*=1.-ruts*.13;rough-=ruts*.09;
    base*=mix(.86,1.10,macro)*(1.-patchN*.12);
    rough=clamp(rough-(1.-macro)*.10,.25,.95);
  }else if(isSidewalk){
    vec2 tile=fract(vP.xz*.65);
    float joint=1.-smoothstep(.015,.045,min(min(tile.x,1.-tile.x),min(tile.y,1.-tile.y)));
    base*=1.-joint*.22;
    rough=clamp(rough+joint*.12,.3,.95);
  }
  if(cls==1.&&vAux.x>0.)facade(base,emis,glass,rough,spec,Nm,N,V);
#ifdef KB_ARCH_HIGH
  if(cls==2.){
    vec2 tile=vP.xz*vec2(1.08,2.10);
    tile.x+=mod(floor(tile.y),2.)*.50;
    vec2 tf=fract(tile),tb=floor(tile);
    float seam=1.-smoothstep(.022,.092,min(min(tf.x,1.-tf.x),min(tf.y,1.-tf.y)));
    float ridge=.5+.5*cos(tf.x*6.2831853);
    float colVar=.87+.22*h21(tb);
    base*=colVar*(1.-.22*seam)*(.94+.12*ridge);
    // Blago talasasto naginjanje normale za realan odsjaj mesecine na crepu
    float waveG=-sin(tf.x*6.2831853)*.16;
    Nm=normalize(Nm+vec3(waveG,0.,(tf.y-.5)*.12));
    rough=mix(rough,.72,.28);
    spec=.065;
  }
  if(cls==1.&&glass<.5&&vAux.x>0.){
    float patina=fbm2(vP.xz*.28+vP.yy*.05,3);
    base*=1.-.075*smoothstep(.55,.78,patina);
  }
#endif
#ifdef KB_ARCH_MAX
  if(cls==2.){
    float moss=fbm2(vP.xz*.38+vec2(23.1),3);
    base=mix(base,base*vec3(.52,.74,.40),smoothstep(.64,.84,moss)*.36);
  }
  if(cls==1.&&vAux.x>0.&&glass<.5){
    float g0=vnoise(vP.xz*3.8+vP.yy*.85);
    float g1=vnoise(vP.xz*3.8+vP.yy*.85+vec2(.016,0.));
    float g2=vnoise(vP.xz*3.8+vP.yy*.85+vec2(0.,.016));
    Nm=normalize(Nm+vec3((g1-g0)*.22,(g2-g0)*.14,(g0-g1)*.22));
  }
#endif
  if(cls==8.){vec4 sg=texture(uSign,vUV/vec2(2048.,1024.));base=toLin(sg.rgb);rough=.42;spec=.28;}
  if(cls==4.){
    float lampHead=step(.8,dot(vC,vec3(.3,.59,.11)));
    float lit=step(h31(floor(vP*vec3(.6,1.2,.6)+.5)),.62)*(lampHead>.5?1.:step(.1,vC.g-.1));
    float dark=lampHead>.5?1.:lit;
    emis=vec3(1.,.74,.4)*3.2*dark*uDusk;
    if(lampHead>.5)emis=vec3(1.,.84,.52)*6.2*uDusk*(.45+.55*smoothstep(.55,1.,uDusk))+base*.35;
    if(distance(vP,uSignal)<5.)emis*=uMorse;
    glass=lampHead>.5?0.:1.;rough=.10;spec=.55;
    base*=mix(.25,.5,1.-uDusk);
  }
  // Mokre povrsine, bare sa talasicima kise i sneg
  float up=clamp(Nm.y,0.,1.);
  float pud=0.;
  if(uWet>.01&&cls==5.){
    float pn=fbm2(vP.xz*.22,3)+vnoise(vP.xz*1.4)*.15;
    pud=smoothstep(.48,.67,pn)*wetMask*smoothstep(.75,.95,N.y);
    base*=mix(1.,.50,uWet*(.55+.45*pud));
    rough=mix(rough,mix(.24,.045,pud),uWet*(.5+.5*pud));
    spec=mix(spec,.55,uWet*pud);
    // Koncentricni talasici od kapi kise u barama
    if(pud>.15&&uRain>.1){
      vec2 rc=vP.xz*2.1,ri=floor(rc),rf=fract(rc)-.5;
      float ph=fract(uTime*1.65+h21(ri)*6.28);
      float rr=length(rf);
      float ring=sin((rr-ph*.48)*48.)*exp(-abs(rr-ph*.48)*14.)*(1.-ph)*(1.-smoothstep(.05,.48,rr));
      vec2 rdir=rf/max(rr,.001);
      Nm=normalize(mix(Nm,vec3(rdir.x*ring*.22,1.,rdir.y*ring*.22),pud*uRain*.65));
    }else if(pud>.1){Nm=normalize(mix(Nm,vec3(0.,1.,0.),pud*.85));}
  }else if(uWet>.01){
    base*=mix(1.,.76,uWet*.6);rough=mix(rough,.38,uWet*.42);
  }
  if(uSeason>2.5&&cls!=4.&&(cls<7.||cls==9.)){
    float snowK=smoothstep(.35,.7,up+(vnoise(vP.xz*.9)-.5)*.35);
    base=mix(base,vec3(.78,.82,.88),snowK*.86);rough=mix(rough,.78,snowK);
  }

  // F0 dielektrik/staklo/mokar asfalt
  if(cls==10.){glass=.86;rough=.095;spec=.72;}
  if(cls==11.){emis=base*(2.4+.35*sin(uTime*8.));}
  vec3 F0=vec3(mix(.04,.08,spec));
  if(glass>.5)F0=vec3(.065);
  if(pud>.2)F0=mix(F0,vec3(.045),pud);

  // Direktno svetlo (Sunce / Mesec) + GGX PBR + meke kaskadne senke
  vec3 L=normalize(uLDir);float ndl=max(dot(Nm,L),0.);
  float sh=1.;if(ndl>0.)sh=sunShadow(vP,N,dist);
#if defined(SSAO) && defined(KB_ARCH_HIGH)
  sh*=texture(uAO,gl_FragCoord.xy*uInvRes).b;
#endif
  vec3 sunSpec=ggxSpec(Nm,V,L,rough,F0)*uLCol*sh;
  vec3 direct=uLCol*ndl*sh;

  // Screen-Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO) sa multi-bounce bojom
  float ao=1.;
#ifdef SSAO
  if(uAOOn>.5)ao=texture(uAO,gl_FragCoord.xy*uInvRes).r;
#endif
  // Blagi kontakt AO iz teksture/normal mape (mikro-udubljenja)
  float microAO=mix(.84,1.04,texRM);
  float combAO=clamp(ao*microAO,0.,1.);
  vec3 multiAO=max(vec3(combAO),((2.0404*base-.3324)*combAO+(-4.7951*base+.6417))*combAO*combAO+(2.7552*base+.6903)*combAO);

  float hemi=Nm.y*.5+.5;
  vec3 amb=mix(uGndAmb,uSkyAmb,hemi)*multiAO;
  vec3 col=base*(direct+amb)+sunSpec;

  // Podpovrsinsko rasejanje lisca (subsurface translucency)
  if(cls==9.){
    if(vT>9.1&&vT<9.4)col*=.85+.27*smoothstep(.02,.22,abs(fract(vUV.x*6.)-.5));
    float tr=pow(max(-dot(V,L),0.),2.6)*.65+.18*max(0.,dot(-N,L));
    col+=base*vec3(1.08,1.16,.78)*uLCol*tr*.55*sh;
  }

  // 12 najblizih ulicnih lampi / baklji sa GGX odsjajem na mokrom asfaltu i volumetrijskim oreolom
  for(int i=0;i<12;i++){
    vec3 lp=uLights[i];
    vec3 q=lp-vP;float dl=length(q);
    if(dl<28.){
      vec3 ql=q/max(dl,.001);
      float att=pow(1.-smoothstep(1.2,26.,dl),2.)/(1.+dl*dl*.042);
      // Ulicna lampa jace sija nadole ka kolovozu i fasadama
      vec4 lobe=uLobe[i];
      float axis=dot(-ql,lobe.xyz);
      float downCone=lobe.w<-.9?1.:mix(lobe.w>.6?.01:.06,1.2,smoothstep(lobe.w,min(.995,lobe.w+.36),axis));
      float flick=distance(lp,uSignal)<1.8?uMorse:1.;
      float nd=max(dot(Nm,ql),0.);
      vec3 lcol=uLightRGB[i]*8.6*att*downCone*flick;
      if(isAsphalt&&pud>.06)col+=uLightRGB[i]*att*downCone*pow(max(dot(reflect(-ql,Nm),V),0.),mix(22.,55.,pud))*.55*pud*uWet;
      col+=base*lcol*(nd*.92+.08)*multiAO;
      col+=lcol*ggxSpec(Nm,V,ql,rough,F0)*(1.1+uWet*2.1+pud*2.6);
      if(cls==9.){float ltr=pow(max(-dot(V,ql),0.),2.5);col+=base*lcol*ltr*.32;}
    }
#ifdef VOL_FOG
    if(uDusk>.12&&uInterior<.5){
      vec3 toL=lp-uEye;float tL=clamp(dot(toL,-V),0.,dist);
      if(tL>1.&&tL<115.){
        float perp=length(toL+V*tL);
        float halo=exp(-perp*perp*.11)*smoothstep(1.,5.,tL)*(1.-smoothstep(16.,115.,tL));
        vec3 mid=uEye-V*tL;
        float layer=mix(vnoise(mid.xz*.17+floor(mid.y*.19)+uTime*.035),vnoise(mid.xz*.17+floor(mid.y*.19)+1.+uTime*.035),fract(mid.y*.19));
        float cone=uLobe[i].w>.6?smoothstep(uLobe[i].w,.99,dot(normalize(mid-lp+vec3(.0001)),uLobe[i].xyz)):1.;
        col+=uLightRGB[i]*halo*cone*(.032+uFogDens*11.+uRain*.043)*(.55+.6*layer);
      }
    }
#endif
  }

#ifdef KB_ARCH_HIGH
  if(isAsphalt&&pud>.06&&uWet>.03&&uDusk>.08){
    vec3 reflectRay=reflect(-V,Nm);
    for(int j=0;j<2;j++){
      vec4 w=uWindows[j];vec3 delta=w.xyz-vP;float d=length(delta);
      if(w.w>.0&&d>.1&&d<34.&&reflectRay.y>0.0){
        vec3 L=delta/d;vec3 crossAxis=normalize(vec3(-L.z,.0001,L.x));
        float across=dot(reflectRay-L,crossAxis),along=reflectRay.y-L.y;
        float shape=exp(-across*across*min(760.,d*d*1.55)-along*along*61.);
        col+=vec3(.90,.62,.34)*w.w*shape*(1.-smoothstep(8.,34.,d))*.28*uDusk*pud*uWet;
      }
    }
  }
#endif
  // Baterijska lampa: PBR GGX + meke senke + diskretni volumetrijski snop
  if(uTorch>.001){
    vec3 to=vP-uTorchPos;float d=length(to);vec3 tl=to/max(d,.001);
    float cone=smoothstep(uBeam.x,uBeam.y,dot(tl,uTorchDir));
    if(cone>0.){
      float att=(1.-smoothstep(4.,52.,d))/(1.+d*d*.011);
      float nd=max(dot(Nm,-tl),0.);float ts=spotShadow(vP,N);
      vec3 tc=vec3(1.,.89,.66)*uTorch*ts;
      col+=base*tc*9.5*att*cone*nd;
      col+=tc*ggxSpec(Nm,V,-tl,rough,F0)*att*cone*(7.+uWet*6.);
    }
#ifdef VOL_FOG
    if(uInterior<.5&&dist>2.){
      float mt=min(dist,24.);
      vec3 midP=uEye-V*(mt*.42);
      vec3 mto=midP-uTorchPos;float md=length(mto);
      float mcone=smoothstep(uBeam.x-.06,uBeam.y,dot(mto/max(md,.001),uTorchDir));
      float mbeam=mcone*exp(-md*.11)*smoothstep(1.5,5.5,md)*(mt/24.);
      col+=vec3(1.,.90,.70)*mbeam*(.022+uFogDens*14.+uRain*.045)*uTorch*uDusk;
    }
#endif
  }

  // Blic / munja
  {float fd=length(vP-uFlashPos);col+=base*vec3(.78,.91,1.)*(1.-smoothstep(1.,34.,fd))*uFlash*3.2;}

  // Fresnel refleksija neba na mokrom asfaltu, barama i staklu
  if((uWet>.01&&cls==5.)||glass>.5){
    vec3 R=reflect(-V,Nm);
    float fr=pow(clamp(1.-max(dot(Nm,V),0.),0.,1.),4.);
    float k=(glass>.5?.65:uWet*(.35+.65*pud))*(.10+.90*fr)*(1.-rough);
    col=mix(col,skyBase(R)*(glass>.5?.88:1.05),clamp(k,0.,.88));
  }

  col+=emis;

  // Atmosferska magla: daljinska + dolinska (Kalac brdo padine) + mesecina u magli
  vec3 fogDirV=normalize(vec3(-V.x,max(.06,-V.y*.42),-V.z));
  vec3 fogCol=skyBase(fogDirV)*(1.-uInterior*.65)+uInterior*vec3(.028,.032,.038);
  float f1=smoothstep(uFog.x,uFog.y,dist)*(.82+uRain*.12);
  float f2=1.-exp(-dist*uFogDens*exp(-max(vP.y-uGroundY,0.)*.042));
  float f=clamp(max(f1,f2),0.,.97);
  col=mix(col,fogCol,f);
  oC=vec4(col,isAsphalt?pud*uWet:0.);
}`;

const VS_FS=GLSL_HEAD+`out vec2 uv;void main(){vec2 p=vec2(float((gl_VertexID<<1)&2),float(gl_VertexID&2));uv=p;gl_Position=vec4(p*2.-1.,0.,1.);}`;

const VS_SKY=VS_FS.replace('p*2.-1.,0.,1.', 'p*2.-1.,1.,1.');
const FS_SKY=(def)=>GLSL_HEAD+def+GLSL_NOISE+GLSL_SKY+`
in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;
uniform mat4 uInvVP;uniform vec3 uEye;
void main(){
  vec4 a=uInvVP*vec4(uv*2.-1.,1.,1.);vec3 r=normalize(a.xyz/a.w-uEye);
  vec3 c=skyBase(r);
  float night=uDusk;
  float sd=dot(r,uSunDir);
  float sunV=smoothstep(.99975,.99985,sd)*smoothstep(-.02,.06,uSunDir.y);
  c+=vec3(1.,.9,.7)*(sunV*30.+pow(max(sd,0.),400.)*3.)*(1.-uRain*.9)*smoothstep(-.1,.1,uSunDir.y);
  float md=dot(r,-uSunDir);
  float moon=smoothstep(.9991,.99955,md)*smoothstep(-.02,.08,-uSunDir.y);
  float moonHalo=pow(max(md,0.),240.)*.48+pow(max(md,0.),28.)*.08;
  c+=vec3(.76,.84,.98)*(moon*4.8+moonHalo)*(1.-uRain*.78);
  // Zvezde sa razlicitim temperaturama boja + diskretan Mlecni put
  vec3 q=r*210.;vec3 id=floor(q),f=fract(q)-.5;float hh=h31(id);
  float star=step(.993,hh)*(1.-smoothstep(0.,.22,length(f+(vec3(h31(id+1.),h31(id+2.),h31(id+3.))-.5)*.5)))*night*night*smoothstep(.02,.32,r.y)*(1.-uRain);
  vec3 sCol=mix(vec3(.78,.86,1.),vec3(1.,.92,.76),h11(hh*53.));
  c+=sCol*star*(1.6+h11(hh*100.+floor(uTime*2.8))*.55);
  float mw=exp(-abs(r.x*.65+r.z*.45-.18)*5.5)*fbm2(r.xz*3.2+r.y*2.,3)*smoothstep(.12,.55,r.y)*night*night*(1.-uRain);
  c+=vec3(.022,.028,.048)*mw;
#ifdef CLOUDS
  if(r.y>.008){
    vec2 p1=r.xz/(r.y+.11)*1.05+vec2(uTime*.0038,uTime*.0014);
    vec2 p2=r.xz/(r.y+.18)*2.10+vec2(uTime*.007,-uTime*.002);
    float n1=fbm2(p1*1.25,CLOUD_OCT);
    float n2=fbm2(p2*1.15,max(1,CLOUD_OCT-1));
    float n=n1*.72+n2*.28;
    float cov=mix(.50,.26,uRain);
    float cl=smoothstep(cov,cov+.27,n)*smoothstep(.008,.15,r.y);
    vec3 cc=mix(vec3(.88,.90,.93),vec3(.11,.14,.21),uDusk);
    cc=mix(cc,vec3(.24,.27,.31)*mix(1.,.14,uDusk),uRain*.82);
    vec2 lStep=(uSunDir.y>=0.?uSunDir.xz:-uSunDir.xz)*.14;
    float lit=clamp(.5+.65*(fbm2(p1*1.25+lStep,2)-n1)*2.2,0.,1.);
    cc*=mix(.58,1.22,lit);
    // Srebrni obod oblaka oko meseca nocu i zlatni oko sunca u sumrak
    float edge=smoothstep(cov,cov+.12,n)*(1.-smoothstep(cov+.12,cov+.28,n));
    cc+=vec3(.45,.58,.85)*pow(max(md,0.),12.)*edge*uDusk*(1.-uRain*.6)*.9;
    cc+=vec3(1.,.55,.28)*pow(max(sd,0.),6.)*(1.-smoothstep(0.,.5,abs(uSunDir.y)))*.55*(1.-uDusk);
    c=mix(c,cc,cl*.88);
  }
#endif
  oC=vec4(c,0.);
}`;

/* bloom (5-step dual-filter Kawase/Karis) */
const FS_SSR=GLSL_HEAD+`
in vec2 uv;out vec4 oC;uniform sampler2D uColor;uniform sampler2D uDepth;
uniform mat4 uProjection;uniform mat4 uUnproject;uniform mat4 uView;
vec3 positionAt(vec2 p){float d=texture(uDepth,p).r;vec4 q=uUnproject*vec4(p*2.-1.,d*2.-1.,1.);return q.xyz/q.w;}
void main(){
 vec4 src=texture(uColor,uv);vec3 P=positionAt(uv),N=cross(dFdx(P),dFdy(P));
 if(src.a<.055||P.z< -78.){oC=src;return;}
 N=normalize(N+vec3(1e-7));if(dot(N,-P)<0.)N=-N;
 vec3 flatN=mat3(uView)*vec3(0,1,0);N=normalize(mix(flatN,N,.42));
 vec3 dir=reflect(normalize(P),N);float t=.12;vec3 origin=P+N*.065;
 for(int i=0;i<26;i++){
   float stepLen=.14+.065*float(i);float last=t;t+=stepLen;vec3 ray=origin+dir*t;
   vec4 clip=uProjection*vec4(ray,1.);if(clip.w<.1)break;
   vec2 q=clip.xy/clip.w*.5+.5;if(any(lessThan(q,vec2(.004)))||any(greaterThan(q,vec2(.996))))break;
   float gap=positionAt(q).z-ray.z;
   if(gap>.025&&gap<.16+stepLen*.65){
     for(int j=0;j<4;j++){float mid=(last+t)*.5;vec3 pos=origin+dir*mid;clip=uProjection*vec4(pos,1.);vec2 probe=clip.xy/clip.w*.5+.5;if(positionAt(probe).z>pos.z){t=mid;q=probe;}else last=mid;}
     float edge=clamp(min(min(q.x,q.y),min(1.-q.x,1.-q.y))*12.,0.,1.);
     float fres=pow(1.-clamp(dot(N,normalize(-P)),0.,1.),2.);
     src.rgb=mix(src.rgb,texture(uColor,q).rgb,src.a*edge*(.12+.57*fres)*(1.-smoothstep(15.,28.,t)));break;
   }
 }
 oC=src;
}`;
const FS_BLOOM_PRE=GLSL_HEAD+`in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;uniform sampler2D uSrc;uniform vec2 uTexel;uniform float uThr;
void main(){vec3 c=texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(-.5,-.5)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(.5,-.5)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(-.5,.5)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(.5,.5)).rgb;c*=.25;
float l=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b));float knee=uThr*.5;float rq=clamp(l-uThr+knee,0.,2.*knee);rq=rq*rq/(4.*knee+1e-4);
float soft=max(rq,l-uThr)/max(l,1e-4);oC=vec4(min(c*soft,vec3(18.)),1.);}`;
const FS_BLOOM_DOWN=GLSL_HEAD+`in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;uniform sampler2D uSrc;uniform vec2 uTexel;
void main(){vec3 c=texture(uSrc,uv).rgb*4.;c+=texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(-1,-1)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(1,-1)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(-1,1)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(1,1)).rgb;oC=vec4(c/8.,1.);}`;
const FS_BLOOM_UP=GLSL_HEAD+`in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;uniform sampler2D uSrc;uniform vec2 uTexel;uniform float uK;
void main(){vec3 c=texture(uSrc,uv).rgb*4.;c+=2.*(texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(-1,0)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(1,0)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(0,-1)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(0,1)).rgb);c+=texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(-1,-1)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(1,-1)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(-1,1)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+uTexel*vec2(1,1)).rgb;oC=vec4(c/16.*uK,1.);}`;

/* kompozit: HDR + bloom -> adaptivna ekspozicija -> ACES -> filmski color grading -> vinjeta/zrno -> gamma */
const FS_COMP=(def)=>GLSL_HEAD+def+`
in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;
uniform sampler2D uHDR;uniform sampler2D uBloom;uniform float uExposure;uniform float uBloomK;uniform float uVig;uniform float uGrain;uniform float uCA;
uniform float uTime;uniform float uDanger;uniform float uHurt;uniform float uNight;uniform float uAspect;uniform vec2 uRes;uniform float uCine;
float hash(vec2 p){vec3 q=fract(vec3(p.xyx)*.1031);q+=dot(q,q.yzx+33.33);return fract((q.x+q.y)*q.z);}
vec3 aces(vec3 x){return clamp((x*(2.51*x+.03))/(x*(2.43*x+.59)+.14),0.,1.);}
void main(){
  vec2 d=(uv-.5)*uCA*(.35+length(uv-.5)*1.5);
  vec3 c;
#ifdef CA
  c=vec3(texture(uHDR,uv+d).r,texture(uHDR,uv).g,texture(uHDR,uv-d).b);
#else
  c=texture(uHDR,uv).rgb;
#endif
#ifdef BLOOM
  c+=texture(uBloom,uv).rgb*uBloomK;
#endif
  c*=uExposure;
  c=aces(c);
  float l=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));
  // Prirodni filmski color grading: hladne nocne senke + topli natrijumski tonovi bez preterane saturacije
  c=mix(vec3(l),c,1.03-.18*uNight-.10*uNight*uCine);
  c*=mix(vec3(1.),vec3(.92,.99,1.08),uNight*(1.-smoothstep(0.,.52,l)));
  c*=mix(vec3(1.),vec3(.88,1.01,1.11),uCine*uNight*(1.-smoothstep(0.,.48,l)));
  c*=mix(vec3(1.),vec3(1.07,1.0,.90),uCine*uNight*smoothstep(.45,1.,l));
  c=mix(c,c*c*(3.-2.*c),.28*uCine*uNight);
  c=max(c-.006*uCine*uNight,0.);
  c=pow(c,vec3(1./2.2));
  vec2 q=(uv-.5)*vec2(uAspect,1.);float vg=(1.-smoothstep(.24,.98,length(q)));
  c*=mix(1.,vg,uVig);
  c=mix(c,c*vec3(1.35,.5,.55),clamp(uDanger*(1.-vg)*1.4,0.,.7));
  c=mix(c,c*vec3(1.5,.35,.35),uHurt*.35);
  c+=(hash(uv*uRes+fract(uTime)*91.7)-.5)*uGrain;
  oC=vec4(clamp(c,0.,1.),dot(c,vec3(.299,.587,.114)));
}`;

/* FXAA + Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) za kristalnu ostrinu bez zamucenja */
const FS_FXAA=GLSL_HEAD+`in vec2 uv;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;uniform sampler2D uSrc;uniform vec2 uTexel;uniform float uSharp;
void main(){
  vec3 L=vec3(.299,.587,.114);
  vec3 rNW=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(-1,-1)*uTexel).rgb,rNE=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(1,-1)*uTexel).rgb,rSW=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(-1,1)*uTexel).rgb,rSE=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(1,1)*uTexel).rgb,rM=texture(uSrc,uv).rgb;
  float lNW=dot(rNW,L),lNE=dot(rNE,L),lSW=dot(rSW,L),lSE=dot(rSE,L),lM=dot(rM,L);
  float lMin=min(lM,min(min(lNW,lNE),min(lSW,lSE))),lMax=max(lM,max(max(lNW,lNE),max(lSW,lSE)));
  vec3 res=rM;
  if(lMax-lMin>max(.0312,lMax*.125)){
    vec2 dir=vec2(-((lNW+lNE)-(lSW+lSE)),((lNW+lSW)-(lNE+lSE)));
    float red=max((lNW+lNE+lSW+lSE)*.03125,1./128.);float rcp=1./(min(abs(dir.x),abs(dir.y))+red);
    dir=clamp(dir*rcp,vec2(-8.),vec2(8.))*uTexel;
    vec3 a=.5*(texture(uSrc,uv+dir*(1./3.-.5)).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+dir*(2./3.-.5)).rgb);
    vec3 b=a*.5+.25*(texture(uSrc,uv+dir*-.5).rgb+texture(uSrc,uv+dir*.5).rgb);
    float lB=dot(b,L);res=(lB<lMin||lB>lMax)?a:b;
  }
  if(uSharp>.01){
    vec3 nN=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(0,-1)*uTexel).rgb,nS=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(0,1)*uTexel).rgb;
    vec3 nW=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(-1,0)*uTexel).rgb,nE=texture(uSrc,uv+vec2(1,0)*uTexel).rgb;
    vec3 mn=min(res,min(min(nN,nS),min(nW,nE)));
    vec3 mx=max(res,max(max(nN,nS),max(nW,nE)));
    vec3 amp=clamp(min(mn,1.-mx)/max(mx,vec3(.001)),0.,1.);
    vec3 w=-sqrt(amp)*(.16*uSharp);
    res=clamp((res+(nN+nS+nW+nE)*w)/(1.+4.*w),0.,1.);
  }
  oC=vec4(res,1.);
}`;

/* ===== KBR2 · D: unapredjena vegetacija (4 vrste: cetinar, lisce/hrast, zbun, breza/topola + canopy AO + vetar + LOD) ===== */
const VS_TREE=GLSL_HEAD+`
layout(location=0) in vec3 aP;layout(location=1) in vec4 aC;layout(location=2) in float aT;layout(location=5) in vec3 aN;
layout(location=3) in vec2 aLeafUV;invariant gl_Position;
layout(location=6) in vec4 iA;layout(location=7) in vec4 iB;
uniform mat4 uVP;uniform float uTime;uniform float uWind;uniform float uSeason;
out vec3 vP;out vec3 vC;out float vT;out vec2 vUV;flat out vec4 vAux;out vec3 vN;
void main(){
  float s=iA.w,cr=cos(iB.x),sr=sin(iB.x);
  vec3 p=aP*s;p=vec3(cr*p.x+sr*p.z,p.y,-sr*p.x+cr*p.z);
  vec3 n=vec3(cr*aN.x+sr*aN.z,aN.y,-sr*aN.x+cr*aN.z);
  float hh=clamp(aP.y,0.,1.5),ph=iB.z*6.2831;
  float gust=.7+.3*sin(uTime*.35+iA.x*.02+iA.z*.02);
  float sway=(sin(uTime*(.9+iB.z*.5)+ph+iA.x*.05)*.6+sin(uTime*1.9+ph*1.7+iA.z*.08)*.4)*gust;
  float k=uWind*hh*hh*s*.036;p.x+=sway*k*.82;p.z+=sway*k*.62;
  if(aT>8.5)p+=vec3(sin(uTime*4.8+aP.x*29.+ph),cos(uTime*4.1+aP.z*27.),sin(uTime*5.3+aP.y*25.))*.022*uWind*(.3+hh);
  vec3 col=aC.rgb;float tint=iB.y,broad=iB.w;
  if(aT>8.5){
    if(uSeason<.5){col*=vec3(1.08,1.22,.76);if(broad>.5&&tint>.84)col=mix(col,vec3(.96,.86,.90),.72);}
    else if(uSeason<1.5){col*=.88+.24*tint;}
    else if(uSeason<2.5){if(broad>.5){vec3 a=tint<.3?vec3(.78,.42,.08):tint<.62?vec3(.82,.64,.14):tint<.85?vec3(.64,.2,.1):vec3(.48,.34,.12);col=mix(col,a*(.72+.4*fract(aP.y*7.+aP.x*3.)),.92);}else col*=vec3(.95,.95,.8);}
    else if(broad>.5){gl_Position=vec4(2.,2.,2.,1.);vP=vec3(0.);vC=vec3(0.);vT=0.;vUV=vec2(0.);vAux=vec4(0.);vN=vec3(0.);return;}
  }
  vec3 P=p+iA.xyz;vP=P;vC=col;vT=aT;vUV=aLeafUV;vAux=vec4(0.);vN=n;
  gl_Position=uVP*vec4(P,1.);
}`;
const FS_TREE_DEPTH=GLSL_HEAD+GLSL_LEAF+`
in float vT;in vec2 vUV;
void main(){if(vT>9.1&&vT<9.4&&leafCoverage(vUV)<.5)discard;}`;

function makeVeg(gl){
  let seed=987654321;const rnd=()=>{seed|=0;seed=seed+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(seed^seed>>>15,1|seed);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
  const nrm=v=>{const l=Math.hypot(v[0],v[1],v[2])||1;return[v[0]/l,v[1]/l,v[2]/l]};
  const hex=h=>[parseInt(h.slice(1,3),16)/255,parseInt(h.slice(3,5),16)/255,parseInt(h.slice(5,7),16)/255];
  const mix=(a,b,t)=>[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*t];
  const scaleC=(c,k)=>[clamp(c[0]*k,0,1),clamp(c[1]*k,0,1),clamp(c[2]*k,0,1)];
  const vert=(m,p,n,c,t,uv)=>m.push({p,n,c,t,uv});
  function prism(m,a,b,r0,r1,seg,col,t){
    const d=nrm([b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2]]),up=Math.abs(d[1])>.9?[1,0,0]:[0,1,0];
    const u=nrm([d[1]*up[2]-d[2]*up[1],d[2]*up[0]-d[0]*up[2],d[0]*up[1]-d[1]*up[0]]),w=[d[1]*u[2]-d[2]*u[1],d[2]*u[0]-d[0]*u[2],d[0]*u[1]-d[1]*u[0]];
    for(let i=0;i<seg;i++){const a0=i/seg*TAU,a1=(i+1)/seg*TAU,c0=[Math.cos(a0),Math.sin(a0)],c1=[Math.cos(a1),Math.sin(a1)];
      const dir=(c)=>[u[0]*c[0]+w[0]*c[1],u[1]*c[0]+w[1]*c[1],u[2]*c[0]+w[2]*c[1]];
      const d0=dir(c0),d1=dir(c1),P=(o,r,dd)=>[o[0]+dd[0]*r,o[1]+dd[1]*r,o[2]+dd[2]*r];
      const A0=P(a,r0,d0),A1=P(a,r0,d1),B0=P(b,r1,d0),B1=P(b,r1,d1);
      const ca=scaleC(col,.82),cb=scaleC(col,1.04);
      vert(m,A0,d0,ca,t);vert(m,A1,d1,ca,t);vert(m,B1,d1,cb,t);vert(m,A0,d0,ca,t);vert(m,B1,d1,cb,t);vert(m,B0,d0,cb,t)}
  }
  function cone(m,y0,r,h,seg,c0,c1,droop){
    const apex=[0,y0+h,0];
    for(let i=0;i<seg;i++){const a0=i/seg*TAU,a1=(i+1)/seg*TAU,am=(a0+a1)*.5;
      const j0=.84+rnd()*.32,j1=.84+rnd()*.32,jm=.72+rnd()*.22;
      const p0=[Math.cos(a0)*r*j0,y0-droop*(.5+rnd()*.8),Math.sin(a0)*r*j0];
      const p1=[Math.cos(a1)*r*j1,y0-droop*(.5+rnd()*.8),Math.sin(a1)*r*j1];
      const pm=[Math.cos(am)*r*jm,y0+h*.38-droop*.3,Math.sin(am)*r*jm];
      const n0=nrm([Math.cos(a0)*h,r*.85,Math.sin(a0)*h]),n1=nrm([Math.cos(a1)*h,r*.85,Math.sin(a1)*h]);
      const nm=nrm([Math.cos(am)*h,r*.65,Math.sin(am)*h]),na=nrm([(n0[0]+n1[0])/2,(n0[1]+n1[1])/2+.7,(n0[2]+n1[2])/2]);
      const cDark=scaleC(c0,.72);
      vert(m,p0,n0,cDark,9);vert(m,pm,nm,c0,9);vert(m,apex,na,c1,9);
      vert(m,pm,nm,c0,9);vert(m,p1,n1,cDark,9);vert(m,apex,na,c1,9)}
  }
  function spray(m,center,width,height,angle,tilt,lo,hi){
    const cs=Math.cos(angle),sn=Math.sin(angle);
    const P=(u,v)=>[center[0]+u*cs*width+sn*(v*tilt+.14*v*v)*height,center[1]+v*height,center[2]+u*sn*width-cs*(v*tilt+.14*v*v)*height];
    const n=nrm([-sn,.44+tilt,cs]),a=P(-1,-.78),b=P(1,-.78),c=P(.87,1),d=P(-.87,1),mid=P(0,.18);
    const pairs=[[a,[0,0]],[b,[1,0]],[c,[1,1]],[d,[0,1]]];
    for(let j=0;j<4;j++){const A=pairs[j],B=pairs[(j+1)%4];
      vert(m,A[0],n,A[1][1]?hi:lo,9.22,A[1]);vert(m,B[0],n,B[1][1]?hi:lo,9.22,B[1]);vert(m,mid,n,mix(lo,hi,.6),9.22,[.5,.53]);}
  }
  function blob(m,cx,cy,cz,rx,ry,rz,sub,lo,hi,lump){
    const count=sub===2?12:sub===1?7:5,spin=rnd()*TAU;
    for(let j=0;j<count;j++){const a=spin+j*2.39996,r=.30+.46*rnd(),v=(j+.5)/count;
      spray(m,[cx+Math.cos(a)*rx*r,cy+(v-.5)*ry*1.1,cz+Math.sin(a)*rz*r],rx*(.58+rnd()*.25),ry*(.73+rnd()*.26),a+1.57,.14+rnd()*.45,scaleC(lo,.88+.22*v),hi);}
  }
  const BARK=hex('#4f3a2a'),BARK2=hex('#644d39'),BIRCH=hex('#cfc8bc');
  function pine(lod){const m=[],layers=lod===0?8:lod===1?4:2,seg=lod===0?9:lod===1?7:5;
    if(lod<2){prism(m,[0,0,0],[0,.14,0],.034,.021,lod===0?7:5,BARK,3);prism(m,[0,.14,0],[0,lod===0?.56:.44,0],.021,.008,lod===0?6:4,BARK,3)}
    for(let i=0;i<layers;i++){const f=i/Math.max(1,layers-1),y0=lod===2?.14+f*.38:.14+f*(lod===0?.68:.62),h=lod===2?.52:(lod===0?.24:.34),r=(lod===2?.30:.33)*(1-f*.78);
      if(lod===0){for(let j=0;j<seg;j++){const a=(j+.49*(i%2))*TAU/seg;
        const tip=[Math.cos(a)*r,y0+.01,Math.sin(a)*r];
        prism(m,[0,y0+h*.53,0],tip,.007,.0018,3,BARK2,3);
        spray(m,[tip[0]*.72,y0+h*.21,tip[2]*.72],r*.52,h*.58,a+1.57,-.62,hex('#153d2c'),hex('#386d4b'));}
      }else cone(m,y0,r,h,seg,mix(hex('#143826'),hex('#1d4f34'),f),mix(hex('#26603c'),hex('#387a4a'),f),lod===0?.038:.024)}
    return m}
  function broad(lod){const m=[];
    // Zakrivljeno stablo sa prosirenjem korena
    if(lod===0){

      const lo=hex('#234c26'),hi=hex('#59943b');

      blob(m,.02,.60,-.15,.19,.16,.19,1,lo,hi,.24,.64);
    }else{

      blob(m,0,.64,0,.34,.28,.34,0,hex('#28522a'),hex('#5a953c'),0,.64);

  function bush(lod){const m=[],lo=hex('#284f24'),hi=hex('#5d9444');
    if(lod===0){
      prism(m,[0,0,0],[.06,.24,.03],.028,.012,4,BARK,3);prism(m,[0,0,0],[-.05,.22,-.04],.026,.012,4,BARK,3);

  // 3: visoka vitka breza/topola (cesta u Nisu i parkovima)
  function birch(lod){const m=[],lo=hex('#30622d'),hi=hex('#74a846');

    }else{blob(m,0,.66,0,.22,.34,.22,0,lo,hi,0,.65)}
    return m}
  function linden(lod){
    const m=broad(lod);for(const v of m){v.p[0]*=.91;v.p[2]*=.87;v.p[1]*=1.10;if(v.t>8){v.c[0]*=1.17;v.c[1]*=1.06;}}
    return m;
  }
  function grass(lod){
    const m=[];for(let j=0;j<(lod?5:10);j++){const a=rnd()*TAU,x=(rnd()-.5)*1.3,z=(rnd()-.5)*1.3,
      w=.015+rnd()*.024,h=.21+rnd()*.31,n=[Math.sin(a),.45,Math.cos(a)],dx=Math.cos(a)*w,dz=-Math.sin(a)*w;
      const root=hex('#58552d'),tip=hex(j%4?'#8b9953':'#c2ae71'),mx=x+.065*Math.sin(a),mz=z+.065*Math.cos(a);
      const A=[x-dx,0,z-dz],B=[x+dx,0,z+dz],C=[mx+dx*.6,h*.57,mz+dz*.6],D=[mx-dx*.6,h*.57,mz-dz*.6],E=[mx+.10*Math.sin(a),h,mz+.10*Math.cos(a)];
      for(const p of [A,B,C,A,C,D,D,C,E])vert(m,p,n,p===A||p===B?root:tip,9);}
    return m;
  }
  const TYPES=[pine,broad,bush,birch,linden,grass],NK=TYPES.length;
  const meshes=[];
  function pack(list){const n=list.length,buf=new ArrayBuffer(n*40),f=new Float32Array(buf),b=new Uint8Array(buf);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const v=list[i],o=i*10;f[o]=v.p[0];f[o+1]=v.p[1];f[o+2]=v.p[2];f[o+3]=v.n[0];f[o+4]=v.n[1];f[o+5]=v.n[2];b[i*40+24]=Math.round(v.c[0]*255);b[i*40+25]=Math.round(v.c[1]*255);b[i*40+26]=Math.round(v.c[2]*255);b[i*40+27]=255;f[o+7]=v.t;f[o+8]=v.uv?.[0]||0;f[o+9]=v.uv?.[1]||0}
    return {buf,n}}
  const ibuf=gl.createBuffer();
  for(let k=0;k<NK;k++){meshes[k]=[];for(let l=0;l<3;l++){seed=1000+k*37+l*11;const pk=pack(TYPES[k](l)),vbo=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,vbo);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,pk.buf,gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    const vao=gl.createVertexArray();gl.bindVertexArray(vao);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,vbo);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);gl.vertexAttribPointer(0,3,gl.FLOAT,false,40,0);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(5);gl.vertexAttribPointer(5,3,gl.FLOAT,false,40,12);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);gl.vertexAttribPointer(1,4,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,true,40,24);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);gl.vertexAttribPointer(2,1,gl.FLOAT,false,40,28);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(3);gl.vertexAttribPointer(3,2,gl.FLOAT,false,40,32);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,ibuf);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(6);gl.vertexAttribPointer(6,4,gl.FLOAT,false,32,0);gl.vertexAttribDivisor(6,1);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(7);gl.vertexAttribPointer(7,4,gl.FLOAT,false,32,16);gl.vertexAttribDivisor(7,1);
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);meshes[k][l]={vao,n:pk.n}}}
  const V={n:0,inst:null,drawn:0,tris:0};
  const NB=NK*3,buckets=Array.from({length:NB},()=>[]),starts=new Int32Array(NB),counts=new Int32Array(NB);let up=new Float32Array(8*1024);
  V.set=function(arr){V.inst=arr;V.n=arr?(arr.length/8)|0:0};
  V.prepare=function(eye,planes,Q,aabbVisible,grasses){
    for(const b of buckets)b.length=0;if(!V.n)return;
    const I=V.inst,s=Q.veg||1,d0=45*s,dn=125*s,df=360*s,dn2=dn*dn,df2=df*df,d02=d0*d0;
    for(let i=0;i<V.n;i++){const o=i*10,dx=I[o]-eye[0],dz=I[o+2]-eye[2],d2=dx*dx+dz*dz;if(d2>df2)continue;const k=clamp(I[o+7]|0,0,NK-1);
      if(d2<d02)buckets[k*3].push(i);
      else if(d2<dn2)buckets[k*3+1].push(i);
      else{const r=I[o+3]*.6;if(aabbVisible(planes,[I[o]-r,I[o+1],I[o+2]-r],[I[o]+r,I[o+1]+I[o+3],I[o+2]+r]))buckets[k*3+2].push(i)}}
    if(grasses&&Q.grassRadius){for(let i=0;i<grasses.length;i+=8){const dx=grasses[i]-eye[0],dz=grasses[i+2]-eye[2],d2=dx*dx+dz*dz;if(d2>Q.grassRadius**2)continue;
      if(aabbVisible(planes,[grasses[i]-1,grasses[i+1]-.12,grasses[i+2]-1],[grasses[i]+1,grasses[i+1]+.8,grasses[i+2]+1]))buckets[5*3+(d2>530?1:0)].push(-1-i/8);}}
    V.grassCount=buckets[15].length+buckets[16].length;
    let tot=0;for(let b=0;b<NB;b++){starts[b]=tot;counts[b]=buckets[b].length;tot+=counts[b]}
    if(tot*8>up.length)up=new Float32Array(Math.max(tot*8,up.length*2));
    for(let b=0;b<NB;b++){let w=starts[b]*8;for(const i of buckets[b]){const src=i<0?grasses:I,o=i<0?(-1-i)*8:i*8;up.set(src.subarray(o,o+8),w);w+=8}}
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,ibuf);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,up.subarray(0,Math.max(8,tot*8)),gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
  };
  V.draw=function(shadow){
    let cnt=0,tri=0;
    for(let b=0;b<NB;b++){const c=counts[b];if(!c)continue;const lod=b%3,k=(b/3)|0;if(shadow&&lod>1)continue;
      const m=meshes[k][lod];gl.bindVertexArray(m.vao);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,ibuf);
      gl.vertexAttribPointer(6,4,gl.FLOAT,false,32,starts[b]*32);gl.vertexAttribPointer(7,4,gl.FLOAT,false,32,starts[b]*32+16);
      gl.drawArraysInstanced(gl.TRIANGLES,0,m.n,c);cnt+=c;tri+=c*m.n/3}
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);V.drawn=cnt;V.tris=tri;return tri;
  };
  return V;
}
