const smoothstep=(a,b,x)=>{const t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)};
const packRGB=(r,g,b)=>((r<0?0:r>1?255:r*255+.5)|0)|(((g<0?0:g>1?255:g*255+.5)|0)<<8)|(((b<0?0:b>1?255:b*255+.5)|0)<<16)|(255<<24);

function chunkize(src,CS,SX){
  SX=SX||7;
  const N=(src.length/SX)|0,T=(N/3)|0;
  if(!T)return {buf:new ArrayBuffer(0),chunks:[],verts:0};
  let bx0=1e9,bz0=1e9,bx1=-1e9,bz1=-1e9;const cx=new Float32Array(T),cz=new Float32Array(T);
  for(let t=0,k=0;t<T;t++,k+=3*SX){const x=(src[k]+src[k+SX]+src[k+2*SX])/3,z=(src[k+2]+src[k+SX+2]+src[k+2*SX+2])/3;cx[t]=x;cz[t]=z;if(x<bx0)bx0=x;if(x>bx1)bx1=x;if(z<bz0)bz0=z;if(z>bz1)bz1=z}
  const gx=Math.max(1,Math.floor((bx1-bx0)/CS)+1),gz=Math.max(1,Math.floor((bz1-bz0)/CS)+1),cells=gx*gz,cell=new Int32Array(T),count=new Int32Array(cells);
  for(let t=0;t<T;t++){const ci=Math.min(gz-1,Math.floor((cz[t]-bz0)/CS))*gx+Math.min(gx-1,Math.floor((cx[t]-bx0)/CS));cell[t]=ci;count[ci]++}
  const start=new Int32Array(cells+1);for(let i=0;i<cells;i++)start[i+1]=start[i]+count[i];
  const fill=start.slice(0,cells),buf=new ArrayBuffer(N*28),f=new Float32Array(buf),u=new Uint32Array(buf),h=new Int16Array(buf),b=new Uint8Array(buf);
  const mn=new Float32Array(cells*3).fill(1e9),mx=new Float32Array(cells*3).fill(-1e9);
  const q16=v=>Math.max(-32767,Math.min(32767,Math.round(v*16)));
  for(let t=0;t<T;t++){const ci=cell[t],dst=fill[ci]++;
    for(let v=0;v<3;v++){const s=(t*3+v)*SX,iv=dst*3+v,d=iv*7,x=src[s],y=src[s+1],z=src[s+2];f[d]=x;f[d+1]=y;f[d+2]=z;u[d+3]=packRGB(src[s+3],src[s+4],src[s+5]);f[d+4]=src[s+6];
      if(SX>=13){h[iv*14+10]=q16(src[s+7]);h[iv*14+11]=q16(src[s+8]);b[iv*28+24]=src[s+9];b[iv*28+25]=src[s+10];b[iv*28+26]=src[s+11];b[iv*28+27]=src[s+12]}
      const m=ci*3;if(x<mn[m])mn[m]=x;if(x>mx[m])mx[m]=x;if(y<mn[m+1])mn[m+1]=y;if(y>mx[m+1])mx[m+1]=y;if(z<mn[m+2])mn[m+2]=z;if(z>mx[m+2])mx[m+2]=z}}
  const chunks=[];
  for(let ci=0;ci<cells;ci++){if(!count[ci])continue;const m=ci*3,a=[mn[m],mn[m+1],mn[m+2]],b2=[mx[m],mx[m+1],mx[m+2]],c=[(a[0]+b2[0])/2,(a[1]+b2[1])/2,(a[2]+b2[2])/2];
    chunks.push({first:start[ci]*3,count:count[ci]*3,min:a,max:b2,c,r:Math.hypot(b2[0]-a[0],b2[1]-a[1],b2[2]-a[2])/2})}
  return {buf,chunks,verts:N};
}

function create(gl){
  if(typeof WebGL2RenderingContext==='undefined'||!(gl instanceof WebGL2RenderingContext))return null;
  const E={cbf:gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_float'),cbh:gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_half_float'),an:gl.getExtension('EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic')};
  gl.getExtension('OES_texture_float_linear');
  const maxTex=gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE),maxAniso=E.an?gl.getParameter(E.an.MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT):1;
  const isMobile=/Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent||'');
  const texRes=(!isMobile&&maxTex>=4096)?512:256;
  let hdr=!!(E.cbf||E.cbh);
  const R={ready:false,hdr,stats:{draws:0,tris:0,cpuMs:0,shadowDraws:0,texRes},get quality(){return curQ},names:QT.map(q=>q.name),failed:null,version:'3.1.0-v16'};

  /* ---------- shaderi i programi ---------- */
  function compile(type,src,name){const s=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(s,src);gl.compileShader(s);if(!gl.getShaderParameter(s,gl.COMPILE_STATUS)){const log=gl.getShaderInfoLog(s)||'';gl.deleteShader(s);throw new Error('KBR2 shader '+name+': '+log.slice(0,600))}return s}
  const progCache=new Map();
  function prog(name,vs,fs,defs=''){
    const key=name+'|'+defs;if(progCache.has(key))return progCache.get(key);
    const p=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(p,compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,vs,name+'.vs'));gl.attachShader(p,compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,typeof fs==='function'?fs(defs):fs,name+'.fs'));gl.linkProgram(p);
    if(!gl.getProgramParameter(p,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw new Error('KBR2 link '+name+': '+(gl.getProgramInfoLog(p)||'').slice(0,400));
    const cache=new Map();p.u=n=>{if(!cache.has(n))cache.set(n,gl.getUniformLocation(p,n));return cache.get(n)};
    p.f1=(n,v)=>{const l=p.u(n);if(l)gl.uniform1f(l,v)};p.i1=(n,v)=>{const l=p.u(n);if(l)gl.uniform1i(l,v)};
    p.f2=(n,a,b)=>{const l=p.u(n);if(l)gl.uniform2f(l,a,b)};p.f3=(n,a,b,c)=>{const l=p.u(n);if(l)gl.uniform3f(l,a,b,c)};
    p.v3=(n,v)=>{const l=p.u(n);if(l)gl.uniform3fv(l,v)};p.m4=(n,m)=>{const l=p.u(n);if(l)gl.uniformMatrix4fv(l,false,m)};
    progCache.set(key,p);return p;
  }

  /* ---------- tekstura helperi ---------- */
  function tex2D(w,h,ifmt,fmt,type,filter=gl.LINEAR){const t=gl.createTexture();gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,t);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,ifmt,w,h,0,fmt,type,null);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,filter);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,filter);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);return t}
  function depthTex(w,h,compare){const t=tex2D(w,h,gl.DEPTH_COMPONENT24,gl.DEPTH_COMPONENT,gl.UNSIGNED_INT,compare?gl.LINEAR:gl.NEAREST);if(compare){gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE,gl.COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_COMPARE_FUNC,gl.LEQUAL)}return t}
  function fbo(colors,depth){const f=gl.createFramebuffer();gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,f);colors.forEach((c,i)=>gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0+i,gl.TEXTURE_2D,c,0));if(depth)gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,gl.DEPTH_ATTACHMENT,gl.TEXTURE_2D,depth,0);
    if(!colors.length){gl.drawBuffers([gl.NONE]);gl.readBuffer(gl.NONE)}
    const st=gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER);return {f,ok:st===gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE,status:st}}

  /* ---------- materijali (texture arrays) ---------- */
  let texA=null,texN=null;
  function buildTextures(){
    const T=buildMaterials(texRes);
    const mk=(data)=>{const t=gl.createTexture();gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,t);gl.texImage3D(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,0,gl.RGBA8,T.N,T.N,T.L,0,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,data);gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY);
      gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.REPEAT);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.REPEAT);return t};
    texA=mk(T.alb);texN=mk(T.nor);
  }
  function setAniso(n){if(!E.an)return;const a=Math.min(n,maxAniso);for(const t of [texA,texN]){gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,t);gl.texParameterf(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,E.an.TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT,a)}}

  const veg=makeVeg(gl);R.setVeg=function(arr){veg.set(arr)};
  /* ---------- žice (linije) ---------- */
  const wire={vbo:gl.createBuffer(),vao:null,n:0};
  wire.vao=(()=>{const v=gl.createVertexArray();gl.bindVertexArray(v);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,wire.vbo);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);gl.vertexAttribPointer(0,3,gl.FLOAT,false,12,0);gl.bindVertexArray(null);return v})();
  R.setWires=function(arr){gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,wire.vbo);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array(arr||[]),gl.STATIC_DRAW);wire.n=arr?(arr.length/3)|0:0;R.stats.wires=wire.n};
  /* ---------- mape terena i tablice ulica ---------- */
  const terr={n:null,m:null,box:[0,0,1],on:0},sign={t:null};
  function mkTex2D(w,h,data,mip){const t=gl.createTexture();gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,t);gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_ALIGNMENT,1);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA8,w,h,0,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,data);if(mip)gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,mip?gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR:gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);return t}
  const dummyTex=mkTex2D(1,1,new Uint8Array([255,255,255,255]),false);
  R.setTerrain=function(o){
    if(terr.n){gl.deleteTexture(terr.n);gl.deleteTexture(terr.m)}
    terr.n=mkTex2D(o.w,o.h,o.nrm,true);terr.m=mkTex2D(o.w,o.h,o.mask,true);terr.box=[o.x0,o.z0,1/o.size];terr.on=1;R.stats.terrain=o.w+'x'+o.h;
  };
  R.setSigns=function(canvas){
    if(sign.t)gl.deleteTexture(sign.t);
    const t=gl.createTexture();gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,t);gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL,false);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA8,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,canvas);gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    if(E.an)gl.texParameterf(gl.TEXTURE_2D,E.an.TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT,Math.min(8,maxAniso));sign.t=t;
  };

  /* ---------- geometrija ---------- */
  function vao(vbo){const v=gl.createVertexArray();gl.bindVertexArray(v);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,vbo);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);gl.vertexAttribPointer(0,3,gl.FLOAT,false,28,0);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);gl.vertexAttribPointer(1,4,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,true,28,12);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);gl.vertexAttribPointer(2,1,gl.FLOAT,false,28,16);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(3);gl.vertexAttribPointer(3,2,gl.SHORT,false,28,20);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(4);gl.vertexAttribPointer(4,4,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,false,28,24);gl.bindVertexArray(null);return v}
  const stat={vbo:gl.createBuffer(),vao:null,chunks:[],verts:0},inner={vbo:gl.createBuffer(),vao:null,verts:0},dyn={vbo:gl.createBuffer(),vao:null,verts:0};
  stat.vao=vao(stat.vbo);inner.vao=vao(inner.vbo);dyn.vao=vao(dyn.vbo);
  const emptyVAO=gl.createVertexArray();
  R.setStatic=function(mesh,fac,ground){
    const parts=[[mesh,7],[fac,13],[ground,7]].filter(p=>p[0]&&p[0].length).map(p=>({c:chunkize(p[0],48,p[1])}));
    let total=0;for(const p of parts)total+=p.c.buf.byteLength;
    const nb=new Uint8Array(total);let off=0,vert=0,chunks=[];
    for(const p of parts){nb.set(new Uint8Array(p.c.buf),off);off+=p.c.buf.byteLength;for(const k of p.c.chunks)chunks.push({...k,first:k.first+vert});vert+=p.c.verts}
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,stat.vbo);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,nb,gl.STATIC_DRAW);stat.chunks=chunks;stat.verts=vert;R.stats.staticVerts=vert;R.stats.chunks=chunks.length};
  R.setInterior=function(mesh){const c=chunkize(mesh,1e4,7);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,inner.vbo);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,c.buf,gl.STATIC_DRAW);inner.verts=c.verts};
  let dynBuf=new ArrayBuffer(28*8192),dynF=new Float32Array(dynBuf),dynU=new Uint32Array(dynBuf);
  function uploadDyn(src){
    const n=src?(src.length/7)|0:0;if(!n){dyn.verts=dyn.alpha=0;return}
    if(n*28>dynBuf.byteLength){let cap=dynBuf.byteLength;while(cap<n*28)cap*=2;dynBuf=new ArrayBuffer(cap);dynF=new Float32Array(dynBuf);dynU=new Uint32Array(dynBuf)}
    let solid=0;for(let k=6;k<src.length;k+=21)if(!(src[k]>7&&src[k]<8))solid+=3;
    let a=0,b=solid*7;
    for(let k=0;k<src.length;k+=21){const alpha=src[k+6]>7&&src[k+6]<8;let o=alpha?b:a;
      if(alpha)b+=21;else a+=21;
      for(let j=0;j<3;j++,o+=7){const k0=k+j*7;dynF[o]=src[k0];dynF[o+1]=src[k0+1];dynF[o+2]=src[k0+2];dynU[o+3]=packRGB(src[k0+3],src[k0+4],src[k0+5]);dynF[o+4]=src[k0+6];dynU[o+5]=0;dynU[o+6]=0}}
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,dyn.vbo);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Uint8Array(dynBuf,0,n*28),gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);dyn.verts=solid;dyn.alpha=n-solid;
  }

  /* ---------- ciljevi renderovanja (HDR, LDR, Bloom, SSAO) ---------- */
  let W=0,H=0,T={},curQ=-1,Q=QT[1],sunSh=null,spotSh=null,sunS=0,OV={},curExpo=1.35;
  function freeTargets(){const del=o=>{if(!o)return;if(Array.isArray(o)){o.forEach(del);return}for(const x of (o.tex||[]))gl.deleteTexture(x);if(o.f)gl.deleteFramebuffer(o.f)};for(const k of Object.keys(T))del(T[k]);T={}}
  function ensureTargets(w,h){
    if(w===W&&h===H&&T.hdr)return;W=w;H=h;freeTargets();
    const colorFmt=hdr?gl.RGBA16F:gl.RGBA8,colorType=hdr?gl.HALF_FLOAT:gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE;
    const mkScene=()=>{const c=tex2D(W,H,colorFmt,gl.RGBA,colorType),d=depthTex(W,H,false),o=fbo([c],d);o.tex=[c,d];o.c=c;o.d=d;return o};
    let s=mkScene();
    if(!s.ok&&hdr){gl.deleteFramebuffer(s.f);for(const x of s.tex)gl.deleteTexture(x);hdr=false;R.hdr=false;s=mkScene()}
    if(!s.ok)throw new Error('KBR2: scene FBO nepotpun ('+s.status+')');
    T.hdr=s;
    if(curQ===4){const c=tex2D(W,H,colorFmt,gl.RGBA,colorType),o=fbo([c],null);
      if(o.ok){o.tex=[c];o.c=c;T.reflection=o;}else{gl.deleteTexture(c);gl.deleteFramebuffer(o.f);}}
    const lc=tex2D(W,H,gl.RGBA8,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE),lo=fbo([lc],null);lo.tex=[lc];lo.c=lc;T.ldr=lo;
    T.bloom=[];
    if(Q.bloom>0&&hdr){let bw=W,bh=H;for(let i=0;i<Q.bloom;i++){bw=Math.max(2,bw>>1);bh=Math.max(2,bh>>1);const c=tex2D(bw,bh,colorFmt,gl.RGBA,colorType),o=fbo([c],null);o.tex=[c];o.c=c;o.w=bw;o.h=bh;T.bloom.push(o)}}
    if(Q.ssao>0){
      const aw=Math.max(2,W>>1),ah=Math.max(2,H>>1);
      const mkAO=()=>{const c=tex2D(aw,ah,gl.RGBA8,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,gl.LINEAR),o=fbo([c],null);o.tex=[c];o.c=c;o.w=aw;o.h=ah;return o};
      const a0=mkAO(),a1=mkAO();
      if(a0.ok&&a1.ok){T.ao0=a0;T.ao1=a1}else{gl.deleteFramebuffer(a0.f);gl.deleteTexture(a0.c);gl.deleteFramebuffer(a1.f);gl.deleteTexture(a1.c)}
    }
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,null);
  }
  function applyQuality(q,force){
    q=clamp(q|0,0,QT.length-1);if(q===curQ&&!force)return;curQ=q;Q=Object.assign({},QT[q],OV);
    if(sunSh){gl.deleteTexture(sunSh.tex);gl.deleteFramebuffer(sunSh.f);sunSh=null}
    if(spotSh){gl.deleteTexture(spotSh.tex);gl.deleteFramebuffer(spotSh.f);spotSh=null}
    if(Q.sh){sunS=Math.min(Q.sh,Math.floor(maxTex/Q.nc));const t=depthTex(sunS*Q.nc,sunS,true),o=fbo([],t);if(!o.ok)throw new Error('KBR2: sun shadow FBO '+o.status);sunSh={tex:t,f:o.f,w:sunS*Q.nc,h:sunS}}
    if(Q.spot){const t=depthTex(Q.spot,Q.spot,true),o=fbo([],t);if(!o.ok)throw new Error('KBR2: spot shadow FBO '+o.status);spotSh={tex:t,f:o.f,w:Q.spot,h:Q.spot}}
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,null);
    if(texA)setAniso(Q.aniso);
    W=0;H=0;
    R.stats.quality=Q.name;
  }

  /* ---------- svetlo i okruženje (realistican nocni kontrast i prirodan ambijent) ---------- */
  function lighting(S){
    const a=(S.hour-6)/24*TAU,el=[.78,.92,.7,.46][clamp(S.season|0,0,3)],y=Math.sin(a)*el,hz=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-y*y)),sun=[Math.cos(a)*hz,y,Math.sin(a)*hz];
    const rainK=1-.78*S.rain,day=smoothstep(-.02,.24,sun[1]),night=smoothstep(.02,.3,-sun[1]);
    let Ld,Lc;
    if(sun[1]>=0){const w=smoothstep(.04,.5,sun[1]);Ld=sun;Lc=[1,lerp(.52,.93,w),lerp(.28,.82,w)].map(v=>v*2.15*day*rainK)}
    else{Ld=[-sun[0],-sun[1],-sun[2]];Lc=[.40,.54,.96].map(v=>v*.88*night*(1-.68*S.rain))}
    const sd=Math.max(.0,S.dusk),dim=1-.42*S.rain;
    const skyAmb=[lerp(.31,.046,sd),lerp(.41,.078,sd),lerp(.60,.185,sd)].map(v=>v*dim);
    const gndAmb=[lerp(.15,.018,sd),lerp(.145,.024,sd),lerp(.11,.038,sd)].map(v=>v*dim);
    const sdir=[...Ld];if(sdir[1]<.22){const k=Math.sqrt((1-.0484)/(Math.max(1e-4,sdir[0]*sdir[0]+sdir[2]*sdir[2])));sdir[0]*=k;sdir[2]*=k;sdir[1]=.22}
    return {sun,Ld,Lc,skyAmb,gndAmb,sdir,lightOn:Lc[0]+Lc[1]+Lc[2]>.01};
  }

  /* ---------- crtanje ---------- */
  function drawList(list){let first=-1,cnt=0,calls=0,tris=0;for(const c of list){if(first>=0&&c.first===first+cnt)cnt+=c.count;else{if(cnt){gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,first,cnt);calls++;tris+=cnt/3}first=c.first;cnt=c.count}}if(cnt){gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,first,cnt);calls++;tris+=cnt/3}R.stats.draws+=calls;R.stats.tris+=tris}
  function drawDyn(){if(!dyn.verts)return;gl.bindVertexArray(dyn.vao);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,dyn.verts);R.stats.draws++;R.stats.tris+=dyn.verts/3}
  function cascadeMatrix(Ld,center,Rr,Sz){
    const D=Rr+170,lk=M4.lookDir([0,0,0],[-Ld[0],-Ld[1],-Ld[2]]),X=lk.x,Y=lk.y,tex=2*Rr/Sz;
    const dx=center[0]*X[0]+center[1]*X[1]+center[2]*X[2],dy=center[0]*Y[0]+center[1]*Y[1]+center[2]*Y[2],sx=Math.round(dx/tex)*tex-dx,sy=Math.round(dy/tex)*tex-dy;
    const C=[center[0]+X[0]*sx+Y[0]*sy,center[1]+X[1]*sx+Y[1]*sy,center[2]+X[2]*sx+Y[2]*sy],eye=[C[0]+Ld[0]*D,C[1]+Ld[1]*D,C[2]+Ld[2]*D];
    const view=M4.lookDir(eye,[-Ld[0],-Ld[1],-Ld[2]]).m,proj=M4.ortho(-Rr,Rr,-Rr,Rr,1,D+Rr+60);
    return {vp:M4.mul(proj,view),C,X,Y,L:Ld,R:Rr,D};
  }
  function casterList(cm){const out=[];for(const c of stat.chunks){const px=c.c[0]-cm.C[0],py=c.c[1]-cm.C[1],pz=c.c[2]-cm.C[2],lx=px*cm.X[0]+py*cm.X[1]+pz*cm.X[2],ly=px*cm.Y[0]+py*cm.Y[1]+pz*cm.Y[2],lz=px*cm.L[0]+py*cm.L[1]+pz*cm.L[2],r=c.r;
      if(Math.abs(lx)>cm.R+r||Math.abs(ly)>cm.R+r||lz+r<-(cm.R+40)||lz-r>cm.D-1)continue;out.push(c)}return out}

  const lights12=new Float32Array(36);
  R.frame=function(S){
    const t0=performance.now();R.stats.draws=0;R.stats.tris=0;R.stats.shadowDraws=0;
    if(S.quality!==curQ||(curQ>=0&&!sunSh&&Q.sh)){const first=curQ<0;applyQuality(S.quality);if(first)setAniso(Q.aniso)}
    ensureTargets(S.W,S.H);
    const eye=S.eye,interior=!!S.interior,town=!interior&&!S.cineSet;
    const proj=M4.persp(S.fov,S.W/S.H,S.near,S.far),view=M4.look(eye,S.target,S.roll),vp=M4.mul(proj,view),planes=M4.planes(vp);
    const LT=lighting(S);if(interior){LT.Lc=[0,0,0];LT.lightOn=false;LT.skyAmb=[.62,.56,.48];LT.gndAmb=[.34,.3,.25]}
    uploadDyn(S.dyn);
    if(town)veg.prepare(eye,planes,Q,aabbVisible,S.grass);R.stats.grassClumps=town?veg.grassCount||0:0;R.stats.trees=0;
    // Pripremi niz od 12 svetala (podrzava i stare 6-light i nove 12-light ulaze)
    if(S.lights&&S.lights.length>=36)lights12.set(S.lights.subarray(0,36));
    else{lights12.fill(1e4);if(S.lights)lights12.set(S.lights.subarray(0,Math.min(36,S.lights.length)))}
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);gl.depthMask(true);gl.colorMask(true,true,true,true);gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);gl.disable(gl.SCISSOR_TEST);

    const fogDens=(S.fogDens!=null?S.fogDens:.00165)*(1+S.rain*1.55+S.dusk*(/[?&]cinema=0/.test(location.search)?.85:1.25)),fogEnd=S.fogEnd||250;
    const vis=[];R.stats.visChunks=0;
    if(town){
      const far=Math.max(fogEnd+45,130),far2=far*far;
      for(const c of stat.chunks){const dx=Math.max(c.min[0]-eye[0],0,eye[0]-c.max[0]),dz=Math.max(c.min[2]-eye[2],0,eye[2]-c.max[2]);if(dx*dx+dz*dz>far2)continue;if(!aabbVisible(planes,c.min,c.max))continue;vis.push(c)}
      R.stats.visChunks=vis.length;
    }

    /* 1) senka sunca/meseca (2-cascade atlas) */
    const casc=[],cs=Q.nc===1?[Math.min(95,S.far*.2)]:[26,112];
    const fwd=[S.target[0]-eye[0],S.target[1]-eye[1],S.target[2]-eye[2]],fl=Math.hypot(...fwd)||1;
    const useSun=!!(sunSh&&LT.lightOn&&!interior);
    if(useSun){
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,sunSh.f);gl.drawBuffers([gl.NONE]);gl.viewport(0,0,sunSh.w,sunSh.h);gl.clearDepth(1);gl.clear(gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
      const sp=prog('shadow',VS_SHADOW,FS_DEPTH);gl.useProgram(sp);gl.enable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);gl.polygonOffset(1.4,2.6);
      for(let i=0;i<cs.length;i++){const Rr=cs[i],ctr=[eye[0]+fwd[0]/fl*Rr*.32,eye[1]+fwd[1]/fl*Rr*.32-1,eye[2]+fwd[2]/fl*Rr*.32],cm=cascadeMatrix(LT.sdir,ctr,Rr,sunS);casc.push(cm);
        gl.viewport(i*sunS,0,sunS,sunS);gl.useProgram(sp);sp.m4('uVP',cm.vp);gl.bindVertexArray(stat.vao);const list=town?casterList(cm):[];const before=R.stats.draws;drawList(list);drawDyn();if(town&&veg.n){const tp=prog('treeSh',VS_TREE,FS_TREE_DEPTH);gl.useProgram(tp);tp.m4('uVP',cm.vp);tp.f1('uTime',S.time);tp.f1('uWind',S.wind||0);tp.f1('uSeason',S.season);veg.draw(true)}R.stats.shadowDraws+=R.stats.draws-before}
      gl.disable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);
    }

    /* 2) senka baterijske lampe */
    let spotVP=null,useSpot=false;
    if(spotSh&&S.torch>.02&&!S.noTorchShadow){
      const dir=S.torchDir,fov=Math.min(2.2,2*Math.acos(clamp(S.beam[0],.2,.999))+.16),pr=M4.persp(fov,1,.3,54),vw=M4.lookDir(S.torchPos,dir).m;spotVP=M4.mul(pr,vw);useSpot=true;
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,spotSh.f);gl.drawBuffers([gl.NONE]);gl.viewport(0,0,spotSh.w,spotSh.h);gl.clear(gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
      const sp=prog('shadow',VS_SHADOW,FS_DEPTH);gl.useProgram(sp);gl.enable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);gl.polygonOffset(1.8,3.6);sp.m4('uVP',spotVP);gl.bindVertexArray(interior?inner.vao:stat.vao);
      if(interior){gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,inner.verts)}else{const list=[];for(const c of stat.chunks){const px=c.c[0]-S.torchPos[0],py=c.c[1]-S.torchPos[1],pz=c.c[2]-S.torchPos[2],d=Math.hypot(px,py,pz);if(d-c.r>56)continue;if(px*dir[0]+py*dir[1]+pz*dir[2]<-c.r)continue;list.push(c)}drawList(list);drawDyn()}
      gl.disable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);
    }

    /* 2.5) Depth Pre-Pass + SSAO + Bilateral Blur (VISOKO / ULTRA / ULTRA MAX) */
    const useAO=!!(Q.ssao>0&&T.ao0&&T.ao1);
    if(useAO){
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,T.hdr.f);gl.viewport(0,0,W,H);
      gl.colorMask(false,false,false,false);gl.clearDepth(1);gl.clear(gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
      const pp=prog('prepass',VS_PREPASS,FS_DEPTH);gl.useProgram(pp);pp.m4('uVP',vp);pp.v3('uEye',eye);
      if(interior){gl.bindVertexArray(inner.vao);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,inner.verts);drawDyn()}
      else{
        gl.bindVertexArray(stat.vao);drawList(vis);
        drawDyn();
        if(town&&veg.n){const tp=prog('treeDepth',VS_TREE,FS_TREE_DEPTH);gl.useProgram(tp);tp.m4('uVP',vp);tp.f1('uTime',S.time);tp.f1('uWind',S.wind||0);tp.f1('uSeason',S.season);veg.draw(false)}
      }
      gl.colorMask(true,true,true,true);
      // SSAO prolaz u pola rezolucije
      const taps=Q.ssao>=2?14:8;
      const aop=prog('ssao',VS_FS,FS_SSAO,'#define SSAO_TAPS '+taps+'\n'+(curQ>=3?'#define CONTACT\n':''));gl.useProgram(aop);
      gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.bindVertexArray(emptyVAO);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,T.ao0.f);gl.viewport(0,0,T.ao0.w,T.ao0.h);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,T.hdr.d);
      aop.i1('uDepth',0);aop.m4('uInvP',M4.inv(proj));aop.m4('uProj',proj);
      aop.v3('uViewLight',[0,1,2].map(row=>view[row]*LT.Ld[0]+view[4+row]*LT.Ld[1]+view[8+row]*LT.Ld[2]));
      aop.f1('uRadius',interior?.55:.88);aop.f1('uBias',.045);
      gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);
      // Separabilni bilateralni blur (cuva ostre ivice fasada i trotoara)
      const blp=prog('ssaoBlur',VS_FS,FS_SSAO_BLUR);gl.useProgram(blp);blp.i1('uSrc',0);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,T.ao1.f);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,T.ao0.c);blp.f2('uDir',1/T.ao0.w,0);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,T.ao0.f);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,T.ao1.c);blp.f2('uDir',0,1/T.ao0.h);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);
      gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    }

    /* 3) glavni PBR prolaz u HDR */
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,T.hdr.f);gl.drawBuffers([gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0]);gl.viewport(0,0,W,H);
    gl.clearColor(.018,.026,.038,0);gl.clearDepth(1);
    gl.clear(useAO?gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT:(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT));
    gl.depthFunc(useAO?gl.EQUAL:gl.LEQUAL);gl.depthMask(!useAO);
    const defs=(useSun?'#define SUN_SHADOW\n#define SHADOW_TAPS '+Q.taps+'\n':'')+(spotSh?'#define SPOT_SHADOW\n':'')+(useAO?'#define SSAO\n':'')+(Q.vol?'#define VOL_FOG\n':'')+(Q.tri?'#define TRIPLANAR\n':'')+(Q.nmap?'#define NORMALMAP\n':'')+(curQ>=3?'#define KB_ARCH_HIGH\n':'')+(curQ>=4?'#define KB_ARCH_MAX\n':'');
    const mp=prog('main',VS_MAIN,FS_MAIN,defs);gl.useProgram(mp);
    const setMain=(mp)=>{
      mp.m4('uVP',vp);mp.v3('uEye',eye);mp.v3('uLDir',LT.Ld);mp.v3('uSunDir',LT.sun);mp.v3('uLCol',LT.Lc);mp.v3('uSkyAmb',LT.skyAmb);mp.v3('uGndAmb',LT.gndAmb);
      mp.f2('uFog',48,fogEnd);mp.f1('uFogDens',fogDens);mp.f1('uGroundY',S.groundY||0);mp.f1('uSeason',S.season);mp.f1('uTorch',S.torch);mp.f1('uMorse',S.morse==null?1:S.morse);
      mp.v3('uTorchPos',S.torchPos);mp.v3('uTorchDir',S.torchDir);mp.f2('uBeam',S.beam[0],S.beam[1]);
      {const l=mp.u('uLights[0]');if(l)gl.uniform3fv(l,lights12)}
      const colors=mp.u('uLightRGB[0]'),lobes=mp.u('uLobe[0]');
      const windows=mp.u('uWindows[0]');if(windows)gl.uniform4fv(windows,S.windows);
      if(colors)gl.uniform3fv(colors,S.lightRGB);if(lobes)gl.uniform4fv(lobes,S.lobes);
      mp.v3('uSignal',S.signal||[1e5,1e5,1e5]);mp.v3('uFlashPos',S.torchPos);mp.f1('uFlash',S.flash);
      mp.f1('uDusk',interior?1:S.dusk);mp.f1('uRain',S.rain);mp.f1('uTime',S.time);mp.f1('uWet',Math.min(1,S.rain*1.35));mp.f1('uInterior',interior?1:0);mp.f1('uTexOn',1);
      mp.f1('uAOOn',useAO?1:0);mp.f2('uInvRes',1/W,1/H);
      if(useSun){const l=mp.u('uSunVP[0]');const buf=new Float32Array(32);buf.set(casc[0].vp,0);buf.set((casc[1]||casc[0]).vp,16);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(l,false,buf);mp.f2('uCasc',cs[0],cs[1]||cs[0]);mp.f1('uCascN',cs.length);mp.f2('uShadowTexel',1/sunSh.w,1/sunSh.h);
        gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,sunSh.tex);mp.i1('uSunShadow',0)}
      if(spotSh){mp.f1('uSpotOn',useSpot?1:0);mp.f2('uSpotTexel',1/spotSh.w,1/spotSh.h);if(useSpot)mp.m4('uSpotVP',spotVP);gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,spotSh.tex);mp.i1('uSpotShadow',1)}
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE2);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,texA);mp.i1('uTexA',2);gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE3);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,texN);mp.i1('uTexN',3);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE4);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,terr.n||dummyTex);mp.i1('uTerrN',4);gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE5);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,terr.m||dummyTex);mp.i1('uTerrM',5);gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE6);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,sign.t||dummyTex);mp.i1('uSign',6);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE7);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,useAO?T.ao0.c:dummyTex);mp.i1('uAO',7);
      mp.v3('uTerrBox',terr.box);mp.f1('uTerrOn',town?terr.on:0);
    };
    setMain(mp);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    if(interior){gl.bindVertexArray(inner.vao);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,inner.verts);R.stats.draws++;R.stats.tris+=inner.verts/3;drawDyn()}
    else{
      gl.bindVertexArray(stat.vao);
      drawList(vis);
      if(town&&veg.n){const tp=prog('tree',VS_TREE,FS_MAIN,defs);gl.useProgram(tp);setMain(tp);tp.m4('uVP',vp);tp.f1('uTime',S.time);tp.f1('uWind',S.wind||0);tp.f1('uSeason',S.season);const tr=veg.draw(false);R.stats.tris+=tr;R.stats.trees=veg.drawn;gl.useProgram(mp);gl.bindVertexArray(stat.vao)}
      drawDyn();
    }
    gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);gl.depthMask(true);
    if(!interior){
      const sk=prog('sky',VS_SKY,FS_SKY,(Q.clouds?'#define CLOUDS\n#define CLOUD_OCT '+Math.max(1,Q.clouds)+'\n':''));gl.useProgram(sk);
      gl.depthMask(false);gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
      sk.m4('uInvVP',M4.inv(vp));sk.v3('uEye',eye);sk.v3('uSunDir',LT.sun);sk.v3('uLDir',LT.Ld);sk.f1('uDusk',S.dusk);sk.f1('uRain',S.rain);sk.f1('uFlash',S.flash);sk.f1('uTime',S.time);
      gl.bindVertexArray(emptyVAO);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);gl.depthMask(true);gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    }
    if(!interior){
      if(town&&wire.n){const wp=prog('wire',VS_WIRE,FS_WIRE);gl.useProgram(wp);wp.m4('uVP',vp);wp.v3('uEye',eye);wp.f2('uFog',48,fogEnd);wp.f1('uFogDens',fogDens);wp.f1('uGroundY',S.groundY||0);wp.v3('uSkyAmb',LT.skyAmb);wp.v3('uLCol',LT.Lc);wp.v3('uSunDir',LT.sun);wp.v3('uLDir',LT.Ld);wp.f1('uDusk',S.dusk);wp.f1('uRain',S.rain);wp.f1('uFlash',S.flash);wp.f1('uTime',S.time);gl.bindVertexArray(wire.vao);gl.drawArrays(gl.LINES,0,wire.n);R.stats.draws++;gl.useProgram(mp);gl.bindVertexArray(stat.vao)}
      if(dyn.alpha){
        gl.useProgram(mp);gl.enable(gl.BLEND);gl.blendFuncSeparate(gl.SRC_ALPHA,gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA,gl.ZERO,gl.ONE);
        gl.depthMask(false);gl.bindVertexArray(dyn.vao);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,dyn.verts,dyn.alpha);
        R.stats.draws++;gl.depthMask(true);gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
      }
    }

    /* 4) čestice (kiša/sneg/lišće) sa osvetljenjem od lampi */
    if((town||S.memoryRain)&&Q.prt>0){const kind=S.season===3?1:(S.rain>.12?0:(S.season===2?2:-1));
      if(kind>=0){drawParticles(kind,S,vp,Q.prt*(kind===0?1650*(.4+S.rain):kind===1?1900:280)|0,LT)}}
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);

    /* 5) bloom (meki threshold za realistican sjaj bez preterivanja) */
    let sceneColor=T.hdr.c;
    const useSSR=!!(T.reflection&&S.rain>.015&&!interior);
    if(useSSR){
      const sp=prog('wetReflection',VS_FS,FS_SSR);gl.useProgram(sp);gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,T.reflection.f);gl.bindVertexArray(emptyVAO);gl.viewport(0,0,W,H);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,T.hdr.c);sp.i1('uColor',0);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,T.hdr.d);sp.i1('uDepth',1);
      sp.m4('uProjection',proj);sp.m4('uUnproject',M4.inv(proj));sp.m4('uView',view);
      gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);sceneColor=T.reflection.c;
    }
    R.stats.earlyZ=useAO;R.stats.contact=useAO&&curQ>=3;R.stats.ssr=useSSR;
    let bloomOn=false;
    if(T.bloom.length&&hdr){
      const pre=prog('bloomPre',VS_FS,FS_BLOOM_PRE),dn=prog('bloomDn',VS_FS,FS_BLOOM_DOWN),up=prog('bloomUp',VS_FS,FS_BLOOM_UP);
      gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.bindVertexArray(emptyVAO);gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
      gl.useProgram(pre);gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,T.bloom[0].f);gl.viewport(0,0,T.bloom[0].w,T.bloom[0].h);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,sceneColor);pre.i1('uSrc',0);pre.f2('uTexel',1/W,1/H);pre.f1('uThr',1.25);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);
      gl.useProgram(dn);dn.i1('uSrc',0);
      for(let i=1;i<T.bloom.length;i++){const s=T.bloom[i-1],d=T.bloom[i];gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,d.f);gl.viewport(0,0,d.w,d.h);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,s.c);dn.f2('uTexel',1/s.w,1/s.h);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3)}
      gl.useProgram(up);up.i1('uSrc',0);up.f1('uK',.92);gl.enable(gl.BLEND);gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE,gl.ONE);
      for(let i=T.bloom.length-2;i>=0;i--){const s=T.bloom[i+1],d=T.bloom[i];gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,d.f);gl.viewport(0,0,d.w,d.h);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,s.c);up.f2('uTexel',1/s.w,1/s.h);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3)}
      gl.disable(gl.BLEND);bloomOn=true;
    }

    /* 6) kompozit sa glatkom svetlosnom adaptacijom oka (mrak <-> lampa/baterija) */
    const night=interior?.8:S.dusk;
    let lampGlow=0;
    if(!interior&&S.dusk>.1){
      for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const dx=lights12[i*3]-eye[0],dy=lights12[i*3+1]-eye[1],dz=lights12[i*3+2]-eye[2],d=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz);if(d<24){const facing=(dx*fwd[0]+dy*fwd[1]+dz*fwd[2])/Math.max(.01,d*fl);lampGlow+=Math.max(0,1-d/24)*(.12+.88*Math.max(0,facing)**3)}}
      lampGlow=Math.min(1,lampGlow*.45+S.torch*.22+S.flash*.5);
    }
    const baseExpo=interior?1.48:lerp(1.02,/[?&]cinema=0/.test(location.search)?1.92:1.80,S.dusk)*(1+S.rain*.08);
    const targetExpo=baseExpo*(1-lampGlow*.16);
    curExpo=lerp(curExpo,targetExpo,1-Math.exp(-clamp(S.dt||.016,.001,.12)*(targetExpo<curExpo?2.2:.85)));

    const cp=prog('comp',VS_FS,FS_COMP,(Q.ca>0?'#define CA\n':'')+(bloomOn?'#define BLOOM\n':''));gl.useProgram(cp);
    gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.bindVertexArray(emptyVAO);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,Q.fxaa?T.ldr.f:null);gl.viewport(0,0,W,H);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,sceneColor);cp.i1('uHDR',0);
    if(bloomOn){gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,T.bloom[0].c);cp.i1('uBloom',1);gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0)}
    const CG=/[?&]cinema=0/.test(location.search)?0:1;
    cp.f1('uExposure',curExpo);cp.f1('uCine',CG);cp.f1('uBloomK',lerp(.11,.19+.035*CG,night));cp.f1('uVig',Q.vig+S.dusk*(.09+.10*CG)+.03*CG);
    {const rm=S.reduced?0:1;cp.f1('uGrain',Q.grain*(1+night*(.6+.35*CG)+S.danger*1.3)*rm);cp.f1('uCA',Q.ca*(1+S.danger*3.5+S.hurt*2.5)*rm)}
    cp.f1('uTime',S.time);cp.f1('uDanger',S.danger||0);cp.f1('uHurt',clamp(S.hurt||0,0,1));cp.f1('uNight',night);cp.f1('uAspect',W/H);cp.f2('uRes',W,H);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);

    /* 7) FXAA + CAS sharpening na ekran */
    if(Q.fxaa){const fx=prog('fxaa',VS_FS,FS_FXAA);gl.useProgram(fx);gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,null);gl.viewport(0,0,W,H);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,T.ldr.c);fx.i1('uSrc',0);fx.f2('uTexel',1/W,1/H);fx.f1('uSharp',Q.cas||0);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3)}

    /* vrati stanje koje očekuje stari put */
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,null);gl.viewport(0,0,W,H);gl.disable(gl.BLEND);gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.depthMask(true);gl.useProgram(null);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    R.stats.cpuMs=performance.now()-t0;
  };

  /* ---------- čestice bez atributa (kiša hvata odsjaj uličnih lampi i baterije) ---------- */
  const VS_PRT=GLSL_HEAD+GLSL_NOISE+`
  uniform mat4 uVP;uniform vec3 uCenter;uniform vec3 uEye;uniform float uTime;uniform int uKind;uniform float uBox;
  uniform vec3 uLights[12];uniform vec3 uLightRGB[12];uniform float uDusk;uniform vec3 uTorchPos;uniform vec3 uTorchDir;uniform float uTorch;
  out vec2 vUV;out float vA;out vec3 vGlow;
  void main(){
    float id=float(gl_InstanceID);vec3 r=vec3(h11(id*1.731+.3),h11(id*3.117+7.7),h11(id*5.309+13.1));
    float H=20.;vec3 box=vec3(uBox*2.,H,uBox*2.);
    vec3 vel=uKind==0?vec3(-1.4,-25.-r.x*6.,.45):(uKind==1?vec3(sin(id)*.5+sin(uTime*.4+id)*.35,-1.3-r.y*.8,cos(id*1.3)*.5+cos(uTime*.3+id)*.35):vec3(sin(uTime*.5+id)*1.4+1.2,-.9-r.y*.6,cos(uTime*.4+id*2.)*1.4));
    vec3 w=vec3(r.x*box.x,r.y*box.y,r.z*box.z)+vel*uTime;
    vec3 rel=mod(w-vec3(uCenter.x-uBox,uCenter.y-3.,uCenter.z-uBox),box);vec3 P=vec3(uCenter.x-uBox,uCenter.y-3.,uCenter.z-uBox)+rel;
    vec2 c=vec2(float(gl_VertexID&1),float((gl_VertexID>>1)&1))-.5;vUV=c+.5;
    vec3 toC=normalize(uEye-P);vec3 pos;float sz;
    if(uKind==0){vec3 d=normalize(vel);vec3 s=normalize(cross(d,toC));pos=P+s*c.x*.012+d*c.y*.62;vA=.36;}
    else{vec3 rt=normalize(cross(vec3(0.,1.,0.),toC));vec3 up=cross(toC,rt);float rot=uTime*(.8+r.z*1.5)+id;vec2 q=mat2(cos(rot),-sin(rot),sin(rot),cos(rot))*c;sz=uKind==1?.045:.16;pos=P+rt*q.x*sz+up*q.y*sz*(uKind==1?1.:.55);vA=uKind==1?.85:.9;}
    vec3 glow=vec3(0.);
    if(uDusk>.1){
      for(int i=0;i<12;i++){vec3 q=P-uLights[i];float d2=dot(q,q);if(d2<324.){float fade=1.-sqrt(d2)/18.;glow+=uLightRGB[i]*fade*fade*1.1;}}
      if(uTorch>.01){vec3 td=P-uTorchPos;float tdL=length(td);float cn=smoothstep(.88,.98,dot(td/max(tdL,.001),uTorchDir));glow+=vec3(1.,.92,.74)*cn*exp(-tdL*.09)*uTorch*1.4;}
    }
    vGlow=glow;
    float dist=distance(P,uEye);vA*=(1.-smoothstep(uBox*.58,uBox*1.05,dist))*smoothstep(.35,1.5,dist);
    gl_Position=uVP*vec4(pos,1.);
  }`;
  const FS_PRT=GLSL_HEAD+`
  in vec2 vUV;in float vA;in vec3 vGlow;uniform int uKind;uniform vec3 uTint;layout(location=0) out vec4 oC;
  void main(){float a;if(uKind==0){a=smoothstep(0.,.25,vUV.y)*(1.-smoothstep(.6,1.,vUV.y))*(1.-abs(vUV.x-.5)*2.);}else if(uKind==1){a=(1.-smoothstep(.18,.5,length(vUV-.5)));}else{a=(1.-smoothstep(.35,.5,abs(vUV.x-.5)))*(1.-smoothstep(.3,.5,abs(vUV.y-.5)));}
    oC=vec4(uTint+vGlow,a*vA);if(oC.a<.01)discard;}`;
  function drawParticles(kind,S,vp,count,LT){
    const p=prog('prt',VS_PRT,FS_PRT);gl.useProgram(p);gl.bindVertexArray(emptyVAO);
    p.m4('uVP',vp);p.v3('uEye',S.eye);p.v3('uCenter',S.eye);p.f1('uTime',S.time);p.i1('uKind',kind);p.f1('uBox',Q.pdist*.22+8);
    {const l=p.u('uLights[0]'),c=p.u('uLightRGB[0]');if(l)gl.uniform3fv(l,lights12);if(c)gl.uniform3fv(c,S.lightRGB);}
    p.f1('uDusk',S.dusk);p.v3('uTorchPos',S.torchPos);p.v3('uTorchDir',S.torchDir);p.f1('uTorch',S.torch);
    const amb=[(LT.skyAmb[0]*1.2+LT.Lc[0]*.12),(LT.skyAmb[1]*1.2+LT.Lc[1]*.12),(LT.skyAmb[2]*1.2+LT.Lc[2]*.12)];
    const tint=kind===0?[.62*amb[0]+.10,.70*amb[1]+.12,.80*amb[2]+.15]:kind===1?[.95*(.4+amb[0]),.97*(.4+amb[1]),1.02*(.4+amb[2])]:[.64*(.3+amb[0]),.46*(.3+amb[1]),.25*(.3+amb[2])];
    p.v3('uTint',tint);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);gl.blendFuncSeparate(gl.SRC_ALPHA,gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA,gl.ZERO,gl.ONE);gl.depthMask(false);
    gl.drawArraysInstanced(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP,0,4,count);R.stats.draws++;
    gl.depthMask(true);gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
  }
  R.setOverride=function(ov){OV=Object.assign({},ov||{});if(curQ>=0){try{applyQuality(curQ,true)}catch(e){console.warn('KBR2 override:',e)}}};
  R.dispose=function(){try{freeTargets()}catch(e){}R.ready=false};
  try{applyQuality(1);buildTextures();setAniso(Q.aniso);R.ready=true}catch(e){R.failed=e;console.warn('KBR2 init:',e);return null}
  return R;
}
window.KBR2={create,QUALITY:QT.map(q=>q.name),version:'3.1.0-v16',chunkize};

})();
</script>
<script id="kb-real-world-runtime">/* KALAČ BRDO — jedinstveni pogon sa ugrađenim geografskim podacima. */
(()=>{'use strict';

// Ugovor dodatka v2: jedan vlasnik AI-a i zvuka, isti fiksni korak simulacije.
