/**
 * A vertex in a circular doubly linked list representing a polygon ring.
 * `prev`/`next` are always linked (set immediately after {@link createNode}), so they're typed
 * non-null; `prevZ`/`nextZ` are the z-order list links and are null at the ends.
 *
 * @typedef {object} Node
 * @property {number} i vertex index in the coordinates array
 * @property {number} x vertex x coordinate
 * @property {number} y vertex y coordinate
 * @property {Node} prev previous vertex node in the polygon ring
 * @property {Node} next next vertex node in the polygon ring
 * @property {number} z z-order curve value; doubles as the owning block index during eliminateHoles
 * @property {Node | null} prevZ previous node in z-order
 * @property {Node | null} nextZ next node in z-order
 */

// single-vertex holes to preserve through filterPoints (steiner points); kept off the Node
// shape since they're rare — the empty-set fast path means non-steiner inputs pay nothing
/** @type {Set<Node>} */
const steiners = new Set();

// halves of split polygons waiting to be triangulated, drained by earcut in a loop so that the
// call stack doesn't grow with the nesting depth of splits
/** @type {Node[]} */
const splitStack = [];

// set by filterPoints whenever it removes at least one node; read by earcutLinked's stall
// handler to decide whether another clip pass is worth attempting before the costlier stages
let filteredOut = false;

/**
 * Triangulate a polygon given as a flat array of vertex coordinates.
 *
 * @param {ArrayLike<number>} data flat array of vertex coordinates
 * @param {ArrayLike<number> | null} [holeIndices] indices (in vertices, not coordinates) where each hole ring starts
 * @param {number} [dim=2] number of coordinates per vertex in `data`
 * @returns {number[]} triangles as triplets of vertex indices into `data`
 * @example earcut([10,0, 0,50, 60,60, 70,10]); // [1,0,3, 3,2,1]
 */
function earcut(data, holeIndices, dim = 2) {

    const hasHoles = holeIndices && holeIndices.length;
    const outerLen = hasHoles ? holeIndices[0] * dim : data.length;
    if (steiners.size) steiners.clear();

    let outerNode = linkedList(data, 0, outerLen, dim, true);
    /** @type {number[]} */
    const triangles = [];

    if (!outerNode || outerNode.next === outerNode.prev) return triangles;

    let minX = 0, minY = 0, invSize = 0;

    if (hasHoles) outerNode = eliminateHoles(data, holeIndices, outerNode, dim);

    // if the shape is not too simple, we'll use z-order curve hash later; calculate polygon bbox
    if (data.length > 80 * dim) {
        minX = data[0];
        minY = data[1];
        let maxX = minX;
        let maxY = minY;

        for (let i = dim; i < outerLen; i += dim) {
            const x = data[i];
            const y = data[i + 1];
            if (x < minX) minX = x;
            if (y < minY) minY = y;
            if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
            if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
        }

        // minX, minY and invSize are later used to transform coords into integers for z-order calculation
        invSize = Math.max(maxX - minX, maxY - minY);
        invSize = invSize !== 0 ? 32767 / invSize : 0;
    }

    earcutLinked(outerNode, triangles, minX, minY, invSize);
    while (splitStack.length) earcutLinked(/** @type {Node} */ (splitStack.pop()), triangles, minX, minY, invSize);

    return triangles;
}

// create a circular doubly linked list from polygon points in the specified winding order
/** @param {ArrayLike<number>} data @param {number} start @param {number} end @param {number} dim @param {boolean} clockwise @returns {Node | null} */
function linkedList(data, start, end, dim, clockwise) {
    /** @type {Node | null} */
    let last = null;

    if (clockwise === (signedArea(data, start, end, dim) > 0)) {
        for (let i = start; i < end; i += dim) last = insertNode(i / dim | 0, data[i], data[i + 1], last);
    } else {
        for (let i = end - dim; i >= start; i -= dim) last = insertNode(i / dim | 0, data[i], data[i + 1], last);
    }

    if (last && equals(last, last.next)) {
        removeNode(last);
        last = last.next;
    }

    return last;
}

// Remove collinear or coincident points; removability depends only on a node's immediate
// neighbors, so we sweep forward and re-check the predecessor after each removal. With no `end`
// we sweep the whole ring, lapping until nothing is removable (the fixpoint the clipper needs).
// With an explicit `end` we heal only the dirty window around a bridge/diagonal cut, stopping at
// `end` rather than lapping — O(window) instead of O(ring).
/** @param {Node} start @param {Node} [end] @returns {Node} */
function filterPoints(start, end = start) {
    const full = end === start;

    let p = start, again;
    do {
        again = false;
        if (p !== p.next && (steiners.size === 0 || !steiners.has(p)) &&
            (equals(p, p.next) || area(p.prev, p, p.next) === 0)) {
            if (full || p === end) end = p.prev; // pull the stop bound back past the removal
            filteredOut = true;
            removeNode(p);
            p = p.prev;         // re-check the predecessor
            again = true;
        } else if (full || p !== end) {
            p = p.next;
            again = !full;      // local heal: keep looping until the sweep reaches end
        }
    } while (again || p !== end);

    return end;
}

// main ear slicing loop which triangulates a polygon (given as a linked list)
/** @param {Node} ear @param {number[]} triangles @param {number} minX @param {number} minY @param {number} invSize */
function earcutLinked(ear, triangles, minX, minY, invSize) {
    // interlink polygon nodes in z-order
    if (invSize) indexCurve(ear, minX, minY, invSize);

    // a strictly convex ring has no vertex that could block an ear, so skip the point checks until a candidate fails;
    // without this, a big convex ring is cut as one fan of long triangles and each hashed check scans O(n) points
    let stop = ear, cured = false, convex = invSize ? isConvex(ear) : false;

    // iterate through ears, slicing them one by one
    while (ear.prev !== ear.next) {
        const prev = ear.prev;
        /** @type {Node} */
        const next = ear.next;

        if (area(prev, ear, next) < 0 && (convex || (invSize ? isEarHashed(ear, minX, minY, invSize) : isEar(ear)))) {
            triangles.push(prev.i, ear.i, next.i); // cut off the triangle

            removeNode(ear);
            ear = next;
            stop = next;
            continue;
        }

        convex = false;
        ear = next;

        // if we looped through the whole remaining polygon and can't find any more ears
        if (ear === stop) {
            // try filtering collinear/coincident points and slicing again — repeat as long as
            // filtering actually removes nodes, since each removal can expose new ears
            filteredOut = false;
            ear = filterPoints(ear);
            if (filteredOut) { stop = ear; continue; }

            // filtering is exhausted: cure small local self-intersections once, then retry
            if (!cured) {
                ear = cureLocalIntersections(ear, triangles);
                stop = ear;
                cured = true;
                continue;
            }

            // as a last resort, try splitting the remaining polygon into two
            splitEarcut(ear);
            break;
        }
    }
}

// check whether every vertex of a ring is strictly convex
/** @param {Node} start @returns {boolean} */
function isConvex(start) {
    let p = start;
    do {
        if (area(p.prev, p, p.next) >= 0) return false;
        p = p.next;
    } while (p !== start);
    return true;
}

// check whether a polygon node forms a valid ear with adjacent nodes
/** @param {Node} ear @returns {boolean} */
function isEar(ear) {
    // reflex check (area(a, b, c) >= 0) is hoisted into the earcutLinked caller to avoid non-inlined call here
    const a = ear.prev, b = ear, c = ear.next,
        ax = a.x, bx = b.x, cx = c.x, ay = a.y, by = b.y, cy = c.y,
        x0 = Math.min(ax, bx, cx), // triangle bbox
        y0 = Math.min(ay, by, cy),
        x1 = Math.max(ax, bx, cx),
        y1 = Math.max(ay, by, cy);

    // make sure we don't have other points inside the potential ear
    let p = c.next;
    while (p !== a) {
        if (p.x >= x0 && p.x <= x1 && p.y >= y0 && p.y <= y1 && !(ax === p.x && ay === p.y) &&
            pointInTriangle(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, p.x, p.y) && area(p.prev, p, p.next) >= 0) return false;
        p = p.next;
    }
    return true;
}

/** @param {Node} ear @param {number} minX @param {number} minY @param {number} invSize @returns {boolean} */
function isEarHashed(ear, minX, minY, invSize) {
    // reflex check is hoisted into the earcutLinked caller (see isEar)
    const a = ear.prev, b = ear, c = ear.next,
        ax = a.x, bx = b.x, cx = c.x, ay = a.y, by = b.y, cy = c.y,
        x0 = Math.min(ax, bx, cx), // triangle bbox
        y0 = Math.min(ay, by, cy),
        x1 = Math.max(ax, bx, cx),
        y1 = Math.max(ay, by, cy),
        minZ = zOrder(x0, y0, minX, minY, invSize), // z-order range for the current triangle bbox;
        maxZ = zOrder(x1, y1, minX, minY, invSize);

    let p = ear.prevZ;
    while (p && p.z >= minZ) { // look for points inside the triangle in decreasing z-order
        if (p.x >= x0 && p.x <= x1 && p.y >= y0 && p.y <= y1 && p !== c && !(ax === p.x && ay === p.y) &&
            pointInTriangle(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, p.x, p.y) && area(p.prev, p, p.next) >= 0) return false;
        p = p.prevZ;
    }
    let n = ear.nextZ;
    while (n && n.z <= maxZ) { // look for points in increasing z-order
        if (n.x >= x0 && n.x <= x1 && n.y >= y0 && n.y <= y1 && n !== c && !(ax === n.x && ay === n.y) &&
            pointInTriangle(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, n.x, n.y) && area(n.prev, n, n.next) >= 0) return false;
        n = n.nextZ;
    }
    return true;
}

// go through all polygon nodes and cure small local self-intersections
/** @param {Node} start @param {number[]} triangles @returns {Node} */
function cureLocalIntersections(start, triangles) {
    let p = start;
    let cured = false;
    do {
        const a = p.prev,
            b = p.next.next;

        if (intersects(a, p, p.next, b, false) && locallyInside(a, b) && locallyInside(b, a)) {

            triangles.push(a.i, p.i, b.i);

            // remove two nodes involved
            removeNode(p);
            removeNode(p.next);

            p = start = b;
            cured = true;
        }
        p = p.next;
    } while (p !== start);

    return cured ? filterPoints(p) : p;
}

// try splitting polygon into two and triangulate them independently
/** @param {Node} start */
function splitEarcut(start) {
    // look for a valid diagonal that divides the polygon into two
    let a = start;
    do {
        let b = a.next.next;
        while (b !== a.prev) {
            if (a.i !== b.i && isValidDiagonal(a, b)) {
                // split the polygon in two by the diagonal
                let c = splitPolygon(a, b);

                // filter colinear points around the cuts
                a = filterPoints(a, a.next);
                c = filterPoints(c, c.next);

                // queue both halves for earcut, a on top so it's triangulated first
                splitStack.push(c, a);
                return;
            }
            b = b.next;
        }
        a = a.next;
    } while (a !== start);
}

// true only while eliminateHoles merges holes, so removeNode keeps the block index live (growBlock)
let indexActive = false;

// link every hole into the outer loop, producing a single-ring polygon without holes
/** @param {ArrayLike<number>} data @param {ArrayLike<number>} holeIndices @param {Node} outerNode @param {number} dim @returns {Node} */
function eliminateHoles(data, holeIndices, outerNode, dim) {
    const queue = [];

    for (let i = 0, len = holeIndices.length; i < len; i++) {
        const start = holeIndices[i] * dim;
        const end = i < len - 1 ? holeIndices[i + 1] * dim : data.length;
        const list = /** @type {Node} */ (linkedList(data, start, end, dim, false));
        if (list === list.next) steiners.add(list);
        queue.push(getLeftmost(list));
    }

    queue.sort(compareXYSlope);

    // block-bbox index for findHoleBridge, grown append-only as holes merge (see notes
    // above buildBlockIndex). Seed it with the outer ring, then append each merged hole.
    buildBlockIndex(data.length / dim, holeIndices.length);
    indexSegment(outerNode, outerNode);

    // process holes from left to right; indexActive lets removeNode keep block bboxes live as
    // filterPoints heals edges during merges (see growBlock)
    indexActive = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < queue.length; i++) {
        outerNode = eliminateHole(queue[i], outerNode);
    }
    indexActive = false;

    // collapse collinear/coincident points across the whole merged ring once before clipping
    return filterPoints(outerNode);
}

/** @param {Node} a @param {Node} b @returns {number} */
function compareXYSlope(a, b) {
    // when the left-most point of 2 holes meet at a vertex, sort the holes counterclockwise so that when we find
    // the bridge to the outer shell is always the point that they meet at.
    return a.x - b.x || a.y - b.y ||
        (a.next.y - a.y) / (a.next.x - a.x) -
        (b.next.y - b.y) / (b.next.x - b.x);
}

// find a bridge between vertices that connects hole with an outer ring and link it
/** @param {Node} hole @param {Node} outerNode @returns {Node} */
function eliminateHole(hole, outerNode) {
    const bridge = findHoleBridge(hole, outerNode);
    if (!bridge) {
        return outerNode;
    }

    const bridgeReverse = splitPolygon(bridge, hole);

    // index the merged-in segment before filtering: in ring order the splice runs
    // bridge -> hole -> bridgeReverse -> bridge2 -> (bridge's old next), covering the
    // hole's edges and both new slit edges. filterPoints below only drops collinear /
    // coincident points, so these bboxes stay valid (conservative) supersets.
    const bridge2 = bridgeReverse.next;
    indexSegment(bridge, bridge2.next);

    // heal collinear/coincident points around the two new slit edges, but leave bridge2 alone: dropping it as collinear
    // would leave bridge lying on the healed edge, where a later hole could bridge into it from outside its sector
    filterPoints(bridgeReverse.prev, bridgeReverse);

    // likewise, if bridge lies strictly between its prev and hole, healing would drop it and leave bridge2 on the healed
    // edge; skip the heal then (a spike at bridge, e.g. a hole touching an outer edge, still needs it)
    const a = bridge.prev;
    if (area(a, bridge, hole) === 0 && (a.x - bridge.x) * (hole.x - bridge.x) + (a.y - bridge.y) * (hole.y - bridge.y) < 0) return bridge;

    return filterPoints(bridge, bridge.next);
}

// Block-bbox index for findHoleBridge (issue #183): one [minX,minY,maxX,maxY] bbox per K
// consecutive ring edges, in a flat Float64Array, so the leftward-ray scan can skip whole
// blocks in O(1) instead of walking the entire merged ring. Grown append-only — the outer
// ring seeds it, then each merged hole appends a segment (head node, stop node, K-blocks
// over head..stop); independent segments, not a ring tiling, since splices land mid-ring.
// Buffers are sized once from the input upper bound and reused across calls.
//
// filterPoints only drops collinear/coincident points, so a stale bbox stays a conservative
// superset of its live edges (never a false skip); the scan skips dead nodes (p.prev.next !==
// p) and lazily advances a dead stop. Blocks are scanned in append (not ring) order, so the
// chosen bridge can differ from the un-indexed code — a different but equally valid result.
const K = 16; // edges per block

let blockBBox = new Float64Array(0); // [minX,minY,maxX,maxY] per block
let numBlocks = 0;
/** @type {Node[]} */
const blockHead = []; // first node of each block's segment
/** @type {Node[]} */
const blockStop = []; // node just past each block's segment (exclusive walk bound)

/** @param {number} maxNodes @param {number} numHoles */
function buildBlockIndex(maxNodes, numHoles) {
    // upper bound: every input node indexed once, +2 bridge nodes per hole, plus a partial
    // trailing block per appended segment (outer ring + one per hole)
    const maxBlocks = Math.ceil((maxNodes + 2 * numHoles) / K) + numHoles + 2;
    if (blockBBox.length < maxBlocks * 4) blockBBox = new Float64Array(maxBlocks * 4);
    numBlocks = 0;
}

// index the ring run head..stop (exclusive) as ceil(len / K) blocks; head === stop means
// the whole ring. each block's bbox covers both endpoints of every edge it owns.
/** @param {Node} head @param {Node} stop */
function indexSegment(head, stop) {
    let p = head;
    do {
        const b = numBlocks++;
        blockHead[b] = p;
        let minX = p.x, minY = p.y, maxX = p.x, maxY = p.y;
        let k = 0;
        do {
            const c = p.next; // edge p->c; bbox must bound both endpoints
            p.z = b; // reuse z as the owning block during eliminateHoles (see growBlock)
            if (c.x < minX) minX = c.x; if (c.x > maxX) maxX = c.x;
            if (c.y < minY) minY = c.y; if (c.y > maxY) maxY = c.y;
            p = c;
        } while (++k < K && p !== stop);
        blockStop[b] = p;
        const g = b * 4;
        blockBBox[g] = minX; blockBBox[g + 1] = minY; blockBBox[g + 2] = maxX; blockBBox[g + 3] = maxY;
    } while (p !== stop);
}

// when filterPoints heals an edge head->tail (removing the collinear node between them), the
// healed edge can extend past head's frozen block bbox if its old far endpoint lived in another
// block; grow head's block bbox to cover tail so the leftward-ray prune can't false-skip it.
/** @param {Node} head @param {Node} tail */
function growBlock(head, tail) {
    const g = head.z * 4;
    if (tail.x < blockBBox[g]) blockBBox[g] = tail.x;
    if (tail.y < blockBBox[g + 1]) blockBBox[g + 1] = tail.y;
    if (tail.x > blockBBox[g + 2]) blockBBox[g + 2] = tail.x;
    if (tail.y > blockBBox[g + 3]) blockBBox[g + 3] = tail.y;
}

/** @param {number} b @returns {Node} */
function liveBlockStop(b) {
    let stop = blockStop[b];
    while (stop.prev.next !== stop) stop = stop.next;
    blockStop[b] = stop;
    return stop;
}

// the block's head node can be removed by filterPoints during merges; advance it to the next
// live node so the walk doesn't start on (and immediately terminate at) a dead node. For the
// single full-ring seed block (head === stop) the same forward advance keeps them equal, so the
// do-while still laps the whole ring instead of collapsing to an empty walk.
/** @param {number} b @returns {Node} */
function liveBlockHead(b) {
    let head = blockHead[b];
    while (head.prev.next !== head) head = head.next;
    blockHead[b] = head;
    return head;
}

// David Eberly's algorithm for finding a bridge between hole and outer polygon
/** @param {Node} hole @param {Node} outerNode @returns {Node | null} */
function findHoleBridge(hole, outerNode) {
    let p = outerNode;
    const hx = hole.x;
    const hy = hole.y;
    let qx = -Infinity;
    /** @type {Node | undefined} */
    let m;

    // find a segment intersected by a ray from the hole's leftmost point to the left;
    // segment's endpoint with lesser x will be potential connection point
    // unless they intersect at a vertex, then choose the vertex
    if (equals(hole, p)) return p;

    // scan blocks; skip any whose bbox can't hold a crossing that beats qx and lies left
    // of hx (the prune Morton order can't express — explicit per-axis [minY,maxY]/[minX,maxX])
    for (let b = 0, g = 0; b < numBlocks; b++, g += 4) {
        if (hy < blockBBox[g + 1] || hy > blockBBox[g + 3] || blockBBox[g] > hx || blockBBox[g + 2] <= qx) continue;

        // ensure the walk's exclusive bound is live so we don't overrun into other blocks
        const stop = liveBlockStop(b);

        p = liveBlockHead(b);
        do {
            if (equals(hole, p.next)) return p.next;
            else if (hy <= p.y && hy >= p.next.y && p.next.y !== p.y) {
                const x = p.x + (hy - p.y) * (p.next.x - p.x) / (p.next.y - p.y);
                if (x <= hx && x > qx) {
                    qx = x;
                    m = p.x < p.next.x ? p : p.next;
                    if (x === hx) return m; // hole touches outer segment; pick leftmost endpoint
                }
            }
            p = p.next;
        } while (p !== stop);
    }

    if (!m) return null;

    // look for points inside the triangle of hole point, segment intersection and endpoint;
    // if there are no points found, we have a valid connection;
    // otherwise choose the point of the minimum angle with the ray as connection point

    const mx = m.x;
    const my = m.y;
    const tminY = Math.min(hy, my); // the triangle's y span; x span is [mx, hx]
    const tmaxY = Math.max(hy, my);
    let tanMin = Infinity;

    // scan the same blocks; skip any whose bbox can't overlap the triangle's [mx,hx]×[tminY,tmaxY] box
    for (let b = 0, g = 0; b < numBlocks; b++, g += 4) {
        if (blockBBox[g + 2] < mx || blockBBox[g] > hx || blockBBox[g + 3] < tminY || blockBBox[g + 1] > tmaxY) continue;

        const stop = liveBlockStop(b);

        p = liveBlockHead(b);
        do {
            if (hx >= p.x && p.x >= mx && hx !== p.x &&
                    pointInTriangle(hy < my ? hx : qx, hy, mx, my, hy < my ? qx : hx, hy, p.x, p.y)) {

                const tan = Math.abs(hy - p.y) / (hx - p.x); // tangential

                // if hole point sits on p's horizontal edge (T-junction touch): the bridge runs
                // along that edge — locallyInside rejects it as collinear, but it's valid
                if ((locallyInside(p, hole) || (p.y === hy && p.next.y === hy && p.next.x > hx)) &&
                    (tan < tanMin || (tan === tanMin && (p.x > m.x || (p.x === m.x && sectorContainsSector(m, p)))))) {
                    m = p;
                    tanMin = tan;
                }
            }

            p = p.next;
        } while (p !== stop);
    }

    return m;
}

// whether sector in vertex m contains sector in vertex p in the same coordinates
/** @param {Node} m @param {Node} p @returns {boolean} */
function sectorContainsSector(m, p) {
    return area(m.prev, m, p.prev) < 0 && area(p.next, m, m.next) < 0;
}

// scratch buffers reused across calls and grown on demand: two node-ref arrays that
// ping-pong during the radix passes, plus parallel z-value arrays so the passes read
// z from contiguous memory instead of dereferencing each node. 256-entry histogram for
// 8-bit digits; the small histogram keeps per-call setup cheap (most rings are short)
/** @type {Node[]} */
const sortArr = [];
/** @type {Node[]} */
let sortBuf = [];
let zArr = new Uint32Array(0);
let zBuf = new Uint32Array(0);
const counts = new Uint32Array(256);

// interlink polygon nodes in z-order: collect into an array, sort by z, relink
/** @param {Node} start @param {number} minX @param {number} minY @param {number} invSize */
function indexCurve(start, minX, minY, invSize) {
    let p = start;
    let n = 0;
    do {
        // always (re)compute: z may still hold a block index left over from eliminateHoles
        p.z = zOrder(p.x, p.y, minX, minY, invSize);
        sortArr[n++] = p;
        p = p.next;
    } while (p !== start);

    sortNodes(n);

    /** @type {Node | null} */
    let prev = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const node = sortArr[i];
        node.prevZ = prev;
        if (prev) prev.nextZ = node;
        prev = node;
    }
    /** @type {Node} */ (prev).nextZ = null;

    // drop the node refs but keep the capacity: setting length to 0 leaves sortBuf unresized
    // (its growth is gated on zArr), so the radix scatter regrows it out of order every call
    sortArr.fill(/** @type {Node} */ (/** @type {unknown} */ (null)), 0, n);
    sortBuf.fill(/** @type {Node} */ (/** @type {unknown} */ (null)), 0, n);
}

// sort the first n nodes of sortArr by z, in place: insertion sort for small n (cheaper
// than histogram setup), else LSD radix in four 8-bit passes (covering z's 30 bits)
/** @param {number} n */
function sortNodes(n) {
    if (n <= 32) {
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            const node = sortArr[i], z = node.z;
            let j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && sortArr[j].z > z) { sortArr[j + 1] = sortArr[j]; j--; }
            sortArr[j + 1] = node;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (zArr.length < n) {
        zArr = new Uint32Array(n);
        zBuf = new Uint32Array(n);
        sortBuf = new Array(n);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) zArr[i] = sortArr[i].z;

    // even pass count lands the sorted result back in sortArr
    radixPass(n, sortArr, zArr, sortBuf, zBuf, 0);
    radixPass(n, sortBuf, zBuf, sortArr, zArr, 8);
    radixPass(n, sortArr, zArr, sortBuf, zBuf, 16);
    radixPass(n, sortBuf, zBuf, sortArr, zArr, 24);
}

// one LSD radix pass: stably scatter the first n nodes (and their z) from src to dst,
// bucketed by the 8-bit digit of z at the given bit shift
/** @param {number} n @param {Node[]} src @param {Uint32Array} srcZ @param {Node[]} dst @param {Uint32Array} dstZ @param {number} shift */
function radixPass(n, src, srcZ, dst, dstZ, shift) {
    counts.fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) counts[(srcZ[i] >>> shift) & 0xff]++;
    // turn per-bucket counts into start offsets (prefix sum)
    let sum = 0;
    for (let b = 0; b < 256; b++) { const c = counts[b]; counts[b] = sum; sum += c; }
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const z = srcZ[i];
        const pos = counts[(z >>> shift) & 0xff]++;
        dst[pos] = src[i];
        dstZ[pos] = z;
    }
}

// z-order of a point given coords and inverse of the longer side of data bbox
/** @param {number} x @param {number} y @param {number} minX @param {number} minY @param {number} invSize @returns {number} */
function zOrder(x, y, minX, minY, invSize) {
    // coords are transformed into non-negative 15-bit integer range
    x = (x - minX) * invSize | 0;
    y = (y - minY) * invSize | 0;

    x = (x | (x << 8)) & 0x00FF00FF;
    x = (x | (x << 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F;
    x = (x | (x << 2)) & 0x33333333;
    x = (x | (x << 1)) & 0x55555555;

    y = (y | (y << 8)) & 0x00FF00FF;
    y = (y | (y << 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F;
    y = (y | (y << 2)) & 0x33333333;
    y = (y | (y << 1)) & 0x55555555;

    return x | (y << 1);
}

// find the leftmost node of a polygon ring
/** @param {Node} start @returns {Node} */
function getLeftmost(start) {
    let p = start,
        leftmost = start;
    do {
        if (p.x < leftmost.x || (p.x === leftmost.x && p.y < leftmost.y)) leftmost = p;
        p = p.next;
    } while (p !== start);

    return leftmost;
}

// check if a point lies within a convex triangle
/** @param {number} ax @param {number} ay @param {number} bx @param {number} by @param {number} cx @param {number} cy @param {number} px @param {number} py @returns {boolean} */
function pointInTriangle(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, px, py) {
    return (cx - px) * (ay - py) >= (ax - px) * (cy - py) &&
           (ax - px) * (by - py) >= (bx - px) * (ay - py) &&
           (bx - px) * (cy - py) >= (cx - px) * (by - py);
}

// check if a diagonal between two polygon nodes is valid (lies in polygon interior)
/** @param {Node} a @param {Node} b @returns {boolean} true when the diagonal is valid */
function isValidDiagonal(a, b) {
    const zeroLength = equals(a, b) && area(a.prev, a, a.next) > 0 && area(b.prev, b, b.next) > 0; // degenerate case
    return a.next.i !== b.i && (zeroLength || locallyInside(a, b) && locallyInside(b, a) && // // locally visible
        (area(a.prev, a, b.prev) !== 0 || area(a, b.prev, b) !== 0)) && // no opposite-facing sectors
        !intersectsPolygon(a, b) && (zeroLength || middleInside(a, b)); // doesn't intersect other edges, diagonal inside polygon
}

// signed area of a triangle
/** @param {Node} p @param {Node} q @param {Node} r @returns {number} */
function area(p, q, r) {
    return (q.y - p.y) * (r.x - q.x) - (q.x - p.x) * (r.y - q.y);
}

// check if two points are equal
/** @param {Node} p1 @param {Node} p2 @returns {boolean} */
function equals(p1, p2) {
    return p1.x === p2.x && p1.y === p2.y;
}

// check if two segments intersect; by default includes collinear boundary touches
/** @param {Node} p1 @param {Node} q1 @param {Node} p2 @param {Node} q2 @param {boolean} [includeBoundary] @returns {boolean} */
function intersects(p1, q1, p2, q2, includeBoundary = true) {
    const o1 = area(p1, q1, p2);
    const o2 = area(p1, q1, q2);
    const o3 = area(p2, q2, p1);
    const o4 = area(p2, q2, q1);

    if (((o1 > 0 && o2 < 0) || (o1 < 0 && o2 > 0)) && ((o3 > 0 && o4 < 0) || (o3 < 0 && o4 > 0))) return true;

    if (!includeBoundary) return false;

    if (o1 === 0 && onSegment(p1, p2, q1)) return true; // p1, q1 and p2 are collinear and p2 lies on p1q1
    if (o2 === 0 && onSegment(p1, q2, q1)) return true; // p1, q1 and q2 are collinear and q2 lies on p1q1
    if (o3 === 0 && onSegment(p2, p1, q2)) return true; // p2, q2 and p1 are collinear and p1 lies on p2q2
    if (o4 === 0 && onSegment(p2, q1, q2)) return true; // p2, q2 and q1 are collinear and q1 lies on p2q2

    return false;
}

// for collinear points p, q, r, check if point q lies on segment pr
/** @param {Node} p @param {Node} q @param {Node} r @returns {boolean} */
function onSegment(p, q, r) {
    return q.x <= Math.max(p.x, r.x) && q.x >= Math.min(p.x, r.x) && q.y <= Math.max(p.y, r.y) && q.y >= Math.min(p.y, r.y);
}

// check if a polygon diagonal intersects any polygon segments
/** @param {Node} a @param {Node} b @returns {boolean} */
function intersectsPolygon(a, b) {
    // diagonal bbox; an edge whose bbox can't overlap it can't intersect it, so
    // skip the orientation test for those (the common case — the diagonal is short)
    const minX = Math.min(a.x, b.x);
    const maxX = Math.max(a.x, b.x);
    const minY = Math.min(a.y, b.y);
    const maxY = Math.max(a.y, b.y);

    let p = a;
    do {
        const n = p.next;
        if ((p.x > maxX && n.x > maxX) || (p.x < minX && n.x < minX) ||
            (p.y > maxY && n.y > maxY) || (p.y < minY && n.y < minY)) {
            p = n;
            continue;
        }
        if (p.i !== a.i && n.i !== a.i && p.i !== b.i && n.i !== b.i &&
                intersects(p, n, a, b)) return true;
        p = n;
    } while (p !== a);

    return false;
}

// check if a polygon diagonal is locally inside the polygon
/** @param {Node} a @param {Node} b @returns {boolean} */
function locallyInside(a, b) {
    return area(a.prev, a, a.next) < 0 ?
        area(a, b, a.next) >= 0 && area(a, a.prev, b) >= 0 :
        area(a, b, a.prev) < 0 || area(a, a.next, b) < 0;
}

// check if the middle point of a polygon diagonal is inside the polygon
/** @param {Node} a @param {Node} b @returns {boolean} */
function middleInside(a, b) {
    let p = a;
    let inside = false;
    const px = (a.x + b.x) / 2;
    const py = (a.y + b.y) / 2;
    do {
        const n = p.next;
        if (((p.y > py) !== (n.y > py)) && (px < (n.x - p.x) * (py - p.y) / (n.y - p.y) + p.x))
            inside = !inside;
        p = n;
    } while (p !== a);

    return inside;
}

// link two polygon vertices with a bridge; if the vertices belong to the same ring, it splits polygon into two;
// if one belongs to the outer ring and another to a hole, it merges it into a single ring
/** @param {Node} a @param {Node} b @returns {Node} */
function splitPolygon(a, b) {
    const a2 = createNode(a.i, a.x, a.y),
        b2 = createNode(b.i, b.x, b.y),
        an = a.next,
        bp = b.prev;

    a.next = b;
    b.prev = a;

    a2.next = an;
    an.prev = a2;

    b2.next = a2;
    a2.prev = b2;

    bp.next = b2;
    b2.prev = bp;

    return b2;
}

// create a node and optionally link it with previous one (in a circular doubly linked list)
/** @param {number} i @param {number} x @param {number} y @param {Node | null} last @returns {Node} */
function insertNode(i, x, y, last) {
    const p = createNode(i, x, y);

    if (!last) {
        p.prev = p;
        p.next = p;

    } else {
        p.next = last.next;
        p.prev = last;
        last.next.prev = p;
        last.next = p;
    }
    return p;
}

/** @param {Node} p */
function removeNode(p) {
    p.next.prev = p.prev;
    p.prev.next = p.next;

    if (p.prevZ) p.prevZ.nextZ = p.nextZ;
    if (p.nextZ) p.nextZ.prevZ = p.prevZ;

    // keep the hole-bridge index's block bboxes covering the healed prev->next edge
    if (indexActive) growBlock(p.prev, p.next);
}

/** @param {number} i @param {number} x @param {number} y @returns {Node} */
function createNode(i, x, y) {
    // prev/next are assigned by the caller before any read, so the null init is cast away here
    return /** @type {Node} */ (/** @type {unknown} */ ({
        i, // vertex index in coordinates array
        x, y, // vertex coordinates
        prev: null, // previous and next vertex nodes in a polygon ring
        next: null,
        z: 0, // z-order curve value; doubles as owning block in the hole-bridge index during eliminateHoles
        prevZ: null, // previous and next nodes in z-order
        nextZ: null
    }));
}

/**
 * Return the relative difference between the polygon area and the area of its triangulation —
 * a value near 0 means a correct triangulation. Useful for verifying output in tests.
 *
 * @param {ArrayLike<number>} data
 * @param {ArrayLike<number> | null} holeIndices
 * @param {number} dim number of coordinates per vertex in `data`
 * @param {ArrayLike<number>} triangles output of {@link earcut}
 * @returns {number}
 * @example deviation(data, holes, dim, earcut(data, holes, dim)); // ~0 if correct
 */
function deviation(data, holeIndices, dim, triangles) {
    const hasHoles = holeIndices && holeIndices.length;
    const outerLen = hasHoles ? holeIndices[0] * dim : data.length;

    let polygonArea = Math.abs(signedArea(data, 0, outerLen, dim));
    if (hasHoles) {
        for (let i = 0, len = holeIndices.length; i < len; i++) {
            const start = holeIndices[i] * dim;
            const end = i < len - 1 ? holeIndices[i + 1] * dim : data.length;
            polygonArea -= Math.abs(signedArea(data, start, end, dim));
        }
    }

    let trianglesArea = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < triangles.length; i += 3) {
        const a = triangles[i] * dim;
        const b = triangles[i + 1] * dim;
        const c = triangles[i + 2] * dim;
        trianglesArea += Math.abs(
            (data[a] - data[c]) * (data[b + 1] - data[a + 1]) -
            (data[a] - data[b]) * (data[c + 1] - data[a + 1]));
    }

    // with no triangles, a polygon area within shoelace roundoff of zero (which scales with the
    // squared coordinate magnitude) means the input was degenerate rather than mistriangulated
    if (trianglesArea === 0) {
        let max = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += dim) max = Math.max(max, Math.abs(data[i]), Math.abs(data[i + 1]));
        return Math.abs(polygonArea) <= data.length * max * max * Number.EPSILON ? 0 : 1;
    }
    return Math.abs((trianglesArea - polygonArea) / polygonArea);
}

/** @param {ArrayLike<number>} data @param {number} start @param {number} end @param {number} dim @returns {number} */
function signedArea(data, start, end, dim) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = start, j = end - dim; i < end; i += dim) {
        sum += (data[j] - data[i]) * (data[i + 1] + data[j + 1]);
        j = i;
    }
    return sum;
}

/**
 * Turn a polygon in multi-dimensional array form (e.g. as in GeoJSON) into the flat form Earcut accepts.
 *
 * @param {ReadonlyArray<ReadonlyArray<ArrayLike<number>>>} data array of rings; the first ring is the outer contour, the rest are holes
 * @returns {{vertices: number[], holes: number[], dimensions: number}}
 * @example const {vertices, holes, dimensions} = flatten(geojson.coordinates);
 */
function flatten(data) {
    const vertices = [];
    const holes = [];
    const dimensions = data[0][0].length;
    let holeIndex = 0;

    for (const ring of data) {
        for (const p of ring) {
            for (let d = 0; d < dimensions; d++) vertices.push(p[d]);
        }
        if (holeIndex && ring.length) holes.push(holeIndex);
        holeIndex += ring.length;
    }
    return {vertices, holes, dimensions};
}

// Reusable module-level scratch for refine():
//   he      = twin half-edge of each edge, or -1 on the polygon boundary
//   hTable  = open-addressing hash, slot -> half-edge index, valid iff hStamp[slot] === gen
//   edgeStamp = pending-in-stack flag, cleared when the edge is popped
/** @type {Int32Array} */ let edgeStack;
/** @type {Int32Array} */ let he;
/** @type {Int32Array} */ let hTable;
/** @type {Uint32Array} */ let hStamp;
/** @type {Uint8Array} */ let edgeStamp;
let hMask = 0, gen = 0;

/**
 * Refine a triangulation toward the constrained Delaunay triangulation by legalizing every
 * interior edge in place with Lawson flips — maximizing the minimum angle and removing most
 * slivers. An optional post-pass for {@link earcut} output, or any manifold triangle-index array
 * indexing into `coords`. Adapted from delaunator's edge legalization.
 *
 * Uses non-robust predicates: float input is fine, and the worst case is a not-quite-Delaunay
 * edge, never an invalid mesh.
 *
 * @param {number[]} triangles triangle indices, as returned by {@link earcut}; mutated in place
 * @param {ArrayLike<number>} coords the flat vertex coordinates passed to {@link earcut}
 * @param {number} [dim=2] number of coordinates per vertex in `coords`
 * @example refine(earcut(data), data);
 */
function refine(triangles, coords, dim = 2) {
    const t = triangles;
    const n = t.length;
    if (n < 6) return;

    // the predicates below assume CCW triangles; for a CW mesh, swapping each edge's endpoints
    // mirrors them, so take the winding from the first non-degenerate triangle
    let cw = false;
    for (let k = 0, o = 0; o === 0 && k < n; k += 3) {
        const a = t[k] * dim, b = t[k + 1] * dim, c = t[k + 2] * dim;
        o = orient(coords[a], coords[a + 1], coords[b], coords[b + 1], coords[c], coords[c + 1]);
        cw = o < 0;
    }

    ensureScratch(n);
    gen++;              // bumping the generation logically empties the hash (no clearing)
    he.fill(-1, 0, n);

    // Build half-edge twins with an undirected-edge hash; consumed slots mark linked pairs. As each
    // pair is linked we seed the stack with one representative (s, the earlier-inserted edge) — this
    // fuses the initial "push every interior edge" pass into the build, saving a full O(n) scan.
    // edgeStamp is all-zero here (balanced push/pop leaves it clean) and each pair links once, so
    // the seed write needs no dedup guard.
    let i = 0;
    for (let e = 0; e < n; e++) {
        const a = t[e], b = t[nextHE(e)];
        const lo = a < b ? a : b, hi = a < b ? b : a;
        let h = (Math.imul(lo, 0x9e3779b1) ^ Math.imul(hi, 0x85ebca6b)) & hMask;
        while (hStamp[h] === gen) {
            const s = hTable[h];
            // s === -1 marks a consumed slot (a pair already linked) — skip past it
            if (s !== -1) {
                const sa = t[s], sb = t[nextHE(s)];
                if ((sa === lo && sb === hi) || (sa === hi && sb === lo)) {
                    he[e] = s; he[s] = e; hTable[h] = -1; // link, then consume the slot
                    edgeStamp[s] = 1; edgeStack[i++] = s; // seed the interior edge for the cascade
                    break;
                }
            }
            h = (h + 1) & hMask;
        }
        if (hStamp[h] !== gen) { hTable[h] = e; hStamp[h] = gen; } // first occurrence: insert
    }

    while (i > 0) {
        const a = edgeStack[--i];
        edgeStamp[a] = 0;
        const b = he[a];
        if (b === -1) continue;

        const a0 = a - a % 3;
        const b0 = b - b % 3;
        const ar = a0 + (a + 2) % 3;
        const al = a0 + (a + 1) % 3;
        const bl = b0 + (b + 2) % 3;
        const br = b0 + (b + 1) % 3;
        const p0 = t[ar], pr = t[cw ? al : a], pl = t[cw ? a : al], p1 = t[bl];

        const x0 = coords[p0 * dim], y0 = coords[p0 * dim + 1];
        const xr = coords[pr * dim], yr = coords[pr * dim + 1];
        const xl = coords[pl * dim], yl = coords[pl * dim + 1];
        const x1 = coords[p1 * dim], y1 = coords[p1 * dim + 1];

        // Test inCircle first: most interior edges are already Delaunay (inCircle true → no flip),
        // so this short-circuits before the two convexity orients on the common path. The quad must
        // also be convex (both new triangles CCW) — flipping a reflex quad would push a triangle
        // outside the polygon. Boundary/hole edges need no guard — they self-protect via he === -1.
        if (!inCircle(x0, y0, xr, yr, xl, yl, x1, y1) &&
            orient(x0, y0, xr, yr, x1, y1) > 0 && orient(x0, y0, x1, y1, xl, yl) > 0) {
            t[a] = p1; t[b] = p0;
            const hbl = he[bl], har = he[ar];
            he[a] = hbl; if (hbl !== -1) he[hbl] = a;
            he[b] = har; if (har !== -1) he[har] = b;
            he[ar] = bl; he[bl] = ar;

            // re-check the quad's four outer edges; skip boundary edges (he === -1) and any
            // already queued (edgeStamp), which also keeps the stack bounded by n.
            if (hbl    !== -1 && edgeStamp[a]  === 0) { edgeStamp[a]  = 1; edgeStack[i++] = a; }
            if (har    !== -1 && edgeStamp[b]  === 0) { edgeStamp[b]  = 1; edgeStack[i++] = b; }
            if (he[al] !== -1 && edgeStamp[al] === 0) { edgeStamp[al] = 1; edgeStack[i++] = al; }
            if (he[br] !== -1 && edgeStamp[br] === 0) { edgeStamp[br] = 1; edgeStack[i++] = br; }
        }
    }
}

/** @param {number} ax @param {number} ay @param {number} bx @param {number} by @param {number} cx @param {number} cy */
function orient(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy) {
    return (bx - ax) * (cy - ay) - (by - ay) * (cx - ax);
}

// Whether p is inside or exactly on the circumcircle of triangle (a, b, c). Sign is negated vs the
// usual predicate to match earcut's CCW winding — the standard sign would build the anti-Delaunay
// mesh. Cocircular quads are legal ties, so refine only flips when this returns false.
/** @param {number} ax @param {number} ay @param {number} bx @param {number} by @param {number} cx @param {number} cy @param {number} px @param {number} py */
function inCircle(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, px, py) {
    const dx = ax - px, dy = ay - py, ex = bx - px, ey = by - py, fx = cx - px, fy = cy - py;
    const ap = dx * dx + dy * dy, bp = ex * ex + ey * ey, cp = fx * fx + fy * fy;
    // A near-cocircular quad is a legal Delaunay tie, but roundoff can flag both an edge and its
    // flip as illegal, cascading into an endless flip loop (#205) — so treat a determinant within
    // a small margin of zero as a tie. The determinant's worst-case roundoff error is provably
    // below 9e-16·(ap + bp + cp)² (Shewchuk-style bound), so the margin guarantees every executed
    // flip is illegal in exact arithmetic, and Lawson flipping always terminates.
    const s = ap + bp + cp;
    return dx * (ey * cp - bp * fy) - dy * (ex * cp - bp * fx) + ap * (ex * fy - ey * fx) <= 1e-13 * s * s;
}

/** @param {number} e */
function nextHE(e) { // next half-edge within the same triangle
    return e - e % 3 + (e + 1) % 3;
}

// Grow the scratch arrays on demand (like earcut's z-order arrays). Allocating lazily here rather
// than at module load lets the whole refine() block tree-shake away for callers who don't use it.
/** @param {number} n */
function ensureScratch(n) {
    // edgeStack holds at most one entry per half-edge (edgeStamp dedups), so n is a safe cap —
    // sizing it up front lets the cascade push without a bounds/grow check.
    if (!edgeStack || edgeStack.length < n) edgeStack = new Int32Array(n);
    if (!he || he.length < n) he = new Int32Array(n);
    if (!edgeStamp || edgeStamp.length < n) edgeStamp = new Uint8Array(n);
    let size = 1;
    while (size < n * 4) size <<= 1; // power-of-two table, load factor <= 0.25
    if (!hTable || hTable.length < size) { hTable = new Int32Array(size); hStamp = new Uint32Array(size); }
    hMask = size - 1;
}

/* Mreža terena, ulice i krovovi koriste isti metrički koordinatni sistem. */
function polygonMesh(m,rings,color,material=6,offset=.04){const flat=[],holes=[];for(let j=0;j<rings.length;j++){const r=rings[j],n=r.length>1&&hyp(r[0][0]-r[r.length-1][0],r[0][1]-r[r.length-1][1])<.001?r.length-1:r.length;if(j)holes.push(flat.length/2);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)flat.push(r[i][0],r[i][1]);}const ix=earcut(flat,holes,2);for(let i=0;i<ix.length;i+=3){const v=ix.slice(i,i+3).map(k=>[flat[k*2],height(flat[k*2],flat[k*2+1])+offset,flat[k*2+1]]);m.tri(v[0],v[1],v[2],color,material);}}
function roadStrip(m,a,b,w,color,yadd=.08,t=5){const dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[1]-a[1],n=hyp(dx,dz)||1,ox=-dz/n*w/2,oz=dx/n*w/2;const p=(x,z)=>[x,height(x,z)+yadd,z];m.quad(p(a[0]+ox,a[1]+oz),p(b[0]+ox,b[1]+oz),p(b[0]-ox,b[1]-oz),p(a[0]-ox,a[1]-oz),color,t)}
function addHouse(m,h,i){const rings=h.rings,poly=h.poly,n=poly.length-1,base=Math.max(...poly.map(p=>height(...p))),H=h.height||h.floors*2.85+.5,eave=base+H;
 const walls=['#dbcfb9','#d3c4b0','#e1ddd1','#d8c9bb','#c6bcab','#d1a6a2','#b2aaa0'],roofs=['#a4553e','#8c4938','#af583e','#94543c','#824b3d'];const wall=h.hero==='secret'?'#d7a0ac':h.hero==='abandoned'?'#aaa38d':walls[i%walls.length],roof=roofs[i%roofs.length];
 for(const ring of rings)for(let k=1;k<ring.length;k++){const a=ring[k-1],b=ring[k];m.quad([a[0],height(...a)-.3,a[1]],[b[0],height(...b)-.3,b[1]],[b[0],eave,b[1]],[a[0],eave,a[1]],wall,1);}
 // Dvovodni krov prati rotaciju pravougaonog tlocrta, bez širenja preko susjedne parcele.
 if(n===4&&rings.length===1&&h.roof!=='flat'){
  let p=poly.slice(0,4),ab=hyp(p[1][0]-p[0][0],p[1][1]-p[0][1]),bc=hyp(p[2][0]-p[1][0],p[2][1]-p[1][1]);if(ab>bc)p=[p[1],p[2],p[3],p[0]];
  const A=p.map(a=>[a[0],eave,a[1]]),mid=(a,b)=>[(a[0]+b[0])/2,eave+Math.min(2.8,Math.max(.65,Math.min(ab,bc)*.23)),(a[2]+b[2])/2],r0=mid(A[0],A[1]),r1=mid(A[2],A[3]);m.quad(A[0],r0,r1,A[3],roof,2);m.quad(r0,A[1],A[2],r1,roof,2);m.tri(A[0],A[1],r0,wall,1);m.tri(A[2],A[3],r1,wall,1);m.rod(r0,r1,.045,'#ce8961',2);
 }else{const flat=[],holes=[];rings.forEach((r,k)=>{if(k)holes.push(flat.length/2);for(const p of r.slice(0,-1))flat.push(...p)});const ix=earcut(flat,holes,2);for(let j=0;j<ix.length;j+=3){const p=ix.slice(j,j+3).map(k=>[flat[k*2],eave+.08,flat[k*2+1]]);m.tri(...p,roof,2);}}
 // Prozori uzduž stvarne fasade; detalji su procijenjeni gde nisu dostupni u izvoru.
 const detailed=hyp(h.c[0]-PARK_POS.x,h.c[1]-PARK_POS.z)<180||!!h.hero,levels=detailed?Math.min(h.floors,4):1;
 for(let k=1;k<poly.length;k++){const a=poly[k-1],b=poly[k],dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[1]-a[1],L=hyp(dx,dz);if(L<3.7)continue;const nx=dz/L*.022,nz=-dx/L*.022,count=detailed?Math.min(4,Math.floor(L/3)):1;
  for(let f=0;f<levels;f++)for(let j=0;j<count;j++){const c=(j+.5)/count,wide=Math.min(1.1,L*.22),u=wide/L*.5,x=a[0]+dx*c+nx,z=a[1]+dz*c+nz,y=base+1.1+f*2.85,col=h.hero==='abandoned'?'#192b31':'#57777d';m.quad([x-dx*u,y,z-dz*u],[x+dx*u,y,z+dz*u],[x+dx*u,y+1.25,z+dz*u],[x-dx*u,y+1.25,z-dz*u],col,0);}
 }
 if(h.door){const p=h.door,y=height(p.x,p.z);m.box(p.x,y+1.05,p.z,1.2,2.1,.12,'#5c4734',3);}
}

}

function streetSection(m,road,i,j,N,p,q){
  const path=road.p,a=path[i-1],b=path[i],half=road.width*.5;
  const normal=(u,v)=>{const dx=v[0]-u[0],dz=v[1]-u[1],l=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;return [-dz/l,dx/l];};
  const n=normal(a,b),joint=other=>{const d=Math.max(.40,1+n[0]*other[0]+n[1]*other[1]);return [(n[0]+other[0])/d,(n[1]+other[1])/d];};
  const n0=i>1?joint(normal(path[i-2],a)):n,n1=i+1<path.length?joint(normal(b,path[i+1])):n;
  const pt=(end,off,h)=>{const k=(j+end)/N,base=end?q:p,x=base[0]+off*lerp(n0[0],n1[0],k),z=base[1]+off*lerp(n0[1],n1[1],k);return [x,height(x,z)+h,z];};
  const strip=(u,v,hu,hv,col,mat)=>m.quad(pt(0,u,hu),pt(1,u,hu),pt(1,v,hv),pt(0,v,hv),col,mat);
  m.fq(pt(0,-half,.081),pt(1,-half,.081),pt(1,half,.081),pt(0,half,.081),'#45494a',5,[[-half,0],[-half,1],[half,1],[half,0]],[Math.min(255,Math.round(road.width*8)),0,0,0]);
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    const sw=quality>=2?.94:.69,k=side*half,mid=pt(0,side*(half+sw*.54),0),far=pt(1,side*(half+sw*.54),0);
    const x=(mid[0]+far[0])*.5,z=(mid[2]+far[2])*.5;
    const around=roadGrid.get(Math.floor(x/64)+','+Math.floor(z/64))||[];
    if(Array.from(around).some(t=>t.road!==road&&segDist(x,z,t.a,t.b)<t.road.width*.5+.18))continue;
    strip(k,k+side*.075,.081,.197,'#b2ada0',5.25);
    strip(k+side*.075,k+side*.22,.197,.207,'#ada99d',5.25);
    strip(k+side*.22,k+side*sw,.207,.19,'#a39f94',5.25);
    strip(k+side*sw,k+side*(sw+.21),.19,.03,'#989386',5.25);
    strip(k+side*(sw+.21),k+side*(sw+.48),.032,.012,'#a89c80',5.40);
  }
}

// Circle-vs-polygon collision, swept in short steps so sprinting cannot tunnel.
function pointSegmentDistance(x,z,a,b){return segDist(x,z,a,b)}
function collide(x,z,r=.38){
 if(interior)return Math.abs(x)>6.8-r||Math.abs(z)>6.65-r;
 if(typeof missionCollision==='function'&&missionCollision(x,z,r))return true;
 if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(z)||Math.abs(x)>HALF-3-r||Math.abs(z)>HALF-3-r)return true;
 for(const c of nearbyColliders(x,z,r)){if(c.kind==='r6-gate'&&(r6.gateOpen||story.on))continue;const b=c.bound;if(x<b[0]-r||x>b[2]+r||z<b[1]-r||z>b[3]+r)continue;
  if(c.r){if(hyp(x-c.x,z-c.z)<r+c.r)return true;continue;}
  if(insideRings(x,z,c.rings))return true;for(const p of c.rings)for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++)if(segDist(x,z,p[i-1],p[i])<r)return true;
 }
 return false;
}
function lineClear(a,b,r=.40){const d=distance(a,b),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(d/.7));if(d>HALF*3)return false;for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)if(collide(lerp(a.x,b.x,i/n),lerp(a.z,b.z,i/n),r))return false;return true}
function moveBody(a,dx,dz,r=.38){
 const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(hyp(dx,dz)/.20)),sx=dx/n,sz=dz/n;let moved=0;
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++){
   const x=a.x,z=a.z,X=x+sx,Z=z+sz;
   if(!collide(X,Z,r)){a.x=X;a.z=Z;moved+=hyp(sx,sz);continue;}
   // Project the remaining displacement onto the tangent of the actual polygon edge (or cylinder).
   let best=0,slideX=0,slideZ=0;
   const slide=(tx,tz)=>{const len=hyp(tx,tz)||1;tx/=len;tz/=len;const along=sx*tx+sz*tz,score=along*along;
     if(score<=best||collide(x+tx*along,z+tz*along,r))return;best=score;slideX=tx*along;slideZ=tz*along;};
   if(!interior)for(const c of nearbyColliders(X,Z,r+.05)){
     if(c.r){if(hyp(X-c.x,Z-c.z)<c.r+r+.025)slide(z-c.z,c.x-x);continue;}
     for(const poly of c.rings||[])for(let i=1;i<poly.length;i++)if(segDist(X,Z,poly[i-1],poly[i])<r+.035)
       slide(poly[i][0]-poly[i-1][0],poly[i][1]-poly[i-1][1]);}
   slide(1,0);slide(0,1);
   if(best>1e-12){a.x+=slideX;a.z+=slideZ;moved+=Math.sqrt(best);}
   else{let lo=0,hi=1;for(let j=0;j<5;j++){const f=(lo+hi)*.5;if(collide(x+sx*f,z+sz*f,r))hi=f;else lo=f;}
     a.x+=sx*lo;a.z+=sz*lo;moved+=hyp(sx,sz)*lo;}
 }
 return moved;
}
function settleActors(){for(const a of [...actors,reks,...dogs]){if(!collide(a.x,a.z,.45))continue;const rd=nearestRoad(a.x,a.z);if(rd.p&&!collide(rd.p[0],rd.p[1],.45)){a.x=rd.p[0];a.z=rd.p[1]}a.path=[];a.vx=a.vz=0;}if(waypoint)routeToSilent(waypoint)}
function buildGraph(){
 graph=[];const buckets=new Map(),key=(x,z)=>Math.floor(x/5)+','+Math.floor(z/5),get=p=>{const k=Math.round(p[0]*2)+','+Math.round(p[1]*2);if(index.has(k))return index.get(k);const n=graph.length;index.set(k,n);graph.push({p:[p[0],p[1]],e:[]});const b=key(...p);if(!buckets.has(b))buckets.set(b,[]);buckets.get(b).push(n);return n},index=new Map();
 const link=(a,b)=>{if(a===b||graph[a].e.some(q=>q[0]===b))return;const A=graph[a].p,B=graph[b].p,d=hyp(A[0]-B[0],A[1]-B[1]);if(!lineClear({x:A[0],z:A[1]},{x:B[0],z:B[1]},.43))return;graph[a].e.push([b,d]);graph[b].e.push([a,d])};
 for(const r of roads){let prev=null;for(let i=1;i<r.p.length;i++){const A=r.p[i-1],B=r.p[i],n=Math.ceil(hyp(B[0]-A[0],B[1]-A[1])/7.5);for(let k=0;k<=n;k++){const p=[lerp(A[0],B[0],k/n),lerp(A[1],B[1],k/n)];if(Math.abs(p[0])>HALF-3||Math.abs(p[1])>HALF-3||collide(p[0],p[1],.43)){prev=null;continue}const u=get(p);if(prev!==null)link(prev,u);prev=u;}}}
 // Nearby nodes join geometric intersections even if external map way IDs differ.
 for(let i=0;i<graph.length;i++){const p=graph[i].p,gx=Math.floor(p[0]/5),gz=Math.floor(p[1]/5);for(let x=-1;x<=1;x++)for(let z=-1;z<=1;z++)for(const j of buckets.get((gx+x)+','+(gz+z))||[])if(j>i&&hyp(p[0]-graph[j].p[0],p[1]-graph[j].p[1])<5.6)link(i,j)}
 if(waypoint)routeToSilent(waypoint);
}
function findPath(from,to){
 if(lineClear(from,to))return [[to.x,to.z]];
 if(!graph.length)return [];
 const nearest=p=>{const sorted=graph.map((n,i)=>[i,hyp(n.p[0]-p.x,n.p[1]-p.z)]).sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]),candidates=[];for(const [i,d]of sorted.slice(0,36)){const q=graph[i].p;if(lineClear(p,{x:q[0],z:q[1]}))candidates.push([i,d]);if(candidates.length>=12)break}return candidates};
 const starts=nearest(from),goals=new Map(nearest(to));if(!starts.length||!goals.size)return [];
 const N=graph.length,dist=new Float64Array(N).fill(Infinity),prev=new Int32Array(N).fill(-1),closed=new Uint8Array(N),heap=[];
 const heuristic=i=>hyp(graph[i].p[0]-to.x,graph[i].p[1]-to.z);
 const push=(i,v)=>{let j=heap.length;heap.push([i,v]);while(j){const p=(j-1)>>1;if(heap[p][1]<=v)break;heap[j]=heap[p];j=p}heap[j]=[i,v]};
 const pop=()=>{const out=heap[0],tail=heap.pop();if(heap.length){let j=0;while(j*2+1<heap.length){let k=j*2+1;if(k+1<heap.length&&heap[k+1][1]<heap[k][1])k++;if(heap[k][1]>=tail[1])break;heap[j]=heap[k];j=k}heap[j]=tail}return out[0]};
 let goal=-1;for(const [i,d]of starts){dist[i]=d;push(i,d+heuristic(i))}while(heap.length){const u=pop();if(closed[u])continue;if(goals.has(u)){goal=u;break;}closed[u]=1;for(const [v,w]of graph[u].e){const d=dist[u]+w;if(d<dist[v]){dist[v]=d;prev[v]=u;push(v,d+heuristic(v))}}}
 if(goal<0||!Number.isFinite(dist[goal]))return [];
 const result=[];let at=goal;for(let n=0;at>=0&&n<N;n++){result.push(graph[at].p);at=prev[at]}result.reverse();result.push([to.x,to.z]);return cine?.flags.shortcut&&story.on&&story.chapter===2?woodSmoothPath(result):result;
}
function routeTo(pos,silent=false){if(collide(pos.x,pos.z,.43)){const r=nearestRoad(pos.x,pos.z);if(r.p&&!collide(...r.p,.43))pos={x:r.p[0],z:r.p[1]};}waypoint={x:pos.x,z:pos.z};route=findPath(actors[active],waypoint);gm.classList.add('nvon');if(!silent)tip(route.length?'Putanja postavljena · '+Math.round(distance(actors[active],waypoint))+' m':'Cilj je van prohodne mreže; prati kompas.',3)}
function routeToSilent(target){if(target)routeTo(target,true)}
function follower(a,target,dt,speed=6){
 a.repath-=dt;const d=distance(a,target);if(d<1.4){a.move=lerp(a.move,0,Math.min(1,dt*9));return}
 if(a.repath<=0||a.stuck>1.2){a.repath=.85+Math.random()*.25;a.path=findPath(a,target);a.stuck=0}
 let dest=target;if(!lineClear(a,target)){if(!a.path.length){a.move=0;return}while(a.path.length>1&&hyp(a.path[0][0]-a.x,a.path[0][1]-a.z)<1.2)a.path.shift();dest={x:a.path[0][0],z:a.path[0][1]};}
 const L=distance(a,dest);if(L<.1)return;const v=Math.min(speed,1.3+(d-1.4)*.75),dx=(dest.x-a.x)/L*v*dt,dz=(dest.z-a.z)/L*v*dt,m=moveBody(a,dx,dz,.38);a.yaw=angleLerp(a.yaw,Math.atan2(dx,dz),Math.min(1,dt*9));a.move=lerp(a.move,m/Math.max(dt,.001),Math.min(1,dt*10));a.phase+=m*2.7;if(m<.02)a.stuck+=dt;else a.stuck=0;
}

function movePlayer(dt){const p=actors[active],{fw,sd}=inputAxes();if(cine?.wire?.open){p.move=0;p.vx=p.vz=0;return;}if(cine?.autoPad?.actor===active){const ap=cine.autoPad;if(Math.abs(fw)+Math.abs(sd)>.1)cine.autoPad=null;else if(distance(p,ap.target)>2.7){follower(p,ap.target,dt,CREW_ROLES[active].walk);return;}else {cine.autoPad=null;p.move=0;p.vx=p.vz=0;if(ap.tune){cine.scanner=true;openTuner();}}}
 if(ride.kind){
  const speedCap=(ride.kind===1?[4.8,7.8,11.2]:[5.5,9,14])[ride.mode],grip=season===3?.6:rain>.4?.78:1,oldX=p.x,oldZ=p.z;
  const slope=((height(p.x+Math.sin(ride.heading),p.z+Math.cos(ride.heading))-height(p.x,p.z))),power=ride.kind===2&&ride.battery<=0?0:ride.kind===1?3.5:5.8;
  let accel=(fw>0?fw*power:fw<0?-7*grip:0)-slope*5.5-ride.speed*.15;
  if(fw<0&&ride.speed<.3)accel=-1.8;
  ride.speed=clamp(ride.speed+accel*dt,-1.4,speedCap*(1-slope*.14));if(Math.abs(ride.speed)<.06&&Math.abs(fw)<.02)ride.speed=0;
  const steer=sd*(1.7/(1+Math.abs(ride.speed)*.06))*Math.min(1,Math.abs(ride.speed)/1.8)*(ride.wheel>.25?.5:1)*grip;
  ride.heading+=steer*dt*Math.sign(ride.speed||1);yaw=angleLerp(yaw,ride.heading,Math.min(1,dt*2.5));
  const dx=Math.sin(ride.heading)*ride.speed*dt,dz=Math.cos(ride.heading)*ride.speed*dt,moved=moveBody(p,dx,dz,.52);
  if(moved<(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dz))*.35&&Math.abs(ride.speed)>1){if(Math.abs(ride.speed)>8){p.hp=Math.max(1,p.hp-3);hurt=.45;sound('bump')}ride.speed*=.18}
  ride.lean=lerp(ride.lean,clamp(-steer*ride.speed*.09,-.42,.42),1-Math.exp(-dt*7));ride.wheel=lerp(ride.wheel,(keys.has('x')||ride.hold)&&ride.speed>2?.62:0,1-Math.exp(-dt*4));ride.pedal+=hyp(p.x-oldX,p.z-oldZ)*3;
  if(ride.kind===2&&ride.speed>0&&fw>0)ride.battery=Math.max(0,ride.battery-dt*(.045+ride.speed*.012+fw*.035));
  p.yaw=ride.heading;p.move=Math.abs(ride.speed);p.phase+=dt*Math.abs(ride.speed);p.stamina=Math.min(100,p.stamina+dt*8);return;
 }
 const crouched=!!cine?.crouch,grounded=p.jump<=.001&&p.vy<=0,hasInput=hyp(fw,sd)>.08;

 const sprint=!!((keys.has('shift')||runPress||joy.run)&&hasInput&&fw>-.26&&!crouched&&!p.exhausted);
 const speed=(sprint?CREW_ROLES[active].sprint:CREW_ROLES[active].walk)*(crouched?.43:1)*(active===2&&inWood(p.x,p.z)?1.06:1);
 const vx=(view===2?sd:Math.sin(yaw)*fw+Math.cos(yaw)*sd)*speed,vz=(view===2?-fw:Math.cos(yaw)*fw-Math.sin(yaw)*sd)*speed;
 const grip=season===3?.71:rain>.4?.91:1,rate=grounded?(hasInput?(sprint?5.7:8.6):12)*grip:(hasInput?2.3:.65),ease=1-Math.exp(-dt*rate);

 if(hyp(ax-p.vx,az-p.vz)>.30){p.vx=ax;p.vz=az;}
 p.move=travel/dt;p.phase+=travel*(crouched?3.7:sprint?2.67:3.15);
 if(p.move>.18)p.yaw=angleLerp(p.yaw,Math.atan2(ax,az),1-Math.exp(-dt*11));
 p.lean=lerp(p.lean,-sd*.056*Math.min(1,p.move/5),1-Math.exp(-dt*8));
 const exert=sprint&&p.move>CREW_ROLES[active].walk*.90;
 p.stamina=clamp(p.stamina+dt*(exert?-8.3:crouched?10.5:hasInput?5.9:10.8),0,100);
 motion.stance=lerp(motion.stance,crouched?1:0,1-Math.exp(-dt*9));

}

  if(d.fear>0)d.state='flee';else if(d.mission)d.state='chase';else if(range<(night?21:7)&&(!d.yard||insideYard)&&lineClear(d,p,.24))d.state='chase';else if(d.state==='chase'&&(range>32||(d.yard&&!insideYard)))d.state='return';
  let tx=d.x,tz=d.z,speed=.9;

  else if(d.state==='chase'){tx=p.x;tz=p.z;speed=night?5.15:3.8;if(range<1.25&&d.attack<=0){d.attack=1.5;if(p===actors[active])hurt=.7;p.hp=Math.max(0,p.hp-7);sound('bark');if(time>subtitleUntil){if(Math.random()<.5)say('Lazar','Drži odstojanje!   else if(d.state==='return'){tx=d.hx;tz=d.hz;speed=2;if(hyp(d.x-tx,d.z-tz)<1.5){d.state='patrol';d.timer=0}}
  else {if(d.timer<=0||!d.goal){d.timer=5+Math.random()*6;const angle=Math.random()*TAU,dist=d.yard?2.2:6;d.goal={x:d.hx+Math.sin(angle)*dist,z:d.hz+Math.cos(angle)*dist}}tx=d.goal.x;tz=d.goal.z;}
  if(d.yard&&d.state!=='flee'&&hyp(tx-d.hx,tz-d.hz)>8){const L=hyp(tx-d.hx,tz-d.hz);tx=d.hx+(tx-d.hx)/L*7;tz=d.hz+(tz-d.hz)/L*7}
  if(d.state==='chase'&&!lineClear(d,{x:tx,z:tz},.28)){follower(d,{x:tx,z:tz},dt,speed);continue;}const L=hyp(tx-d.x,tz-d.z);if(L>.5){let vx=(tx-d.x)/L*speed*dt,vz=(tz-d.z)/L*speed*dt,m=moveBody(d,vx,vz,.28);if(m<.003){const turn=(d.ph%2?1:-1)*1.3;vx=Math.sin(d.yaw+turn)*speed*dt;vz=Math.cos(d.yaw+turn)*speed*dt;m=moveBody(d,vx,vz,.28);d.timer=0}d.yaw=angleLerp(d.yaw,Math.atan2(vx,vz),dt*7);d.phase+=m*6;d.move=m/dt}else d.move=0;
  if(range<17&&time>nextBark&&d.fear<=0){sound('bark',clamp(1-range/23,.1,1),d);nextBark=time+1.8+Math.random()*2.8;}
 }}

function transformMesh(dst,data,x,y,z,angle=0,lean=0,tilt=0,scale=1){const co=Math.cos(angle),si=Math.sin(angle),cl=Math.cos(lean),sl=Math.sin(lean),ct=Math.cos(tilt),st=Math.sin(tilt);for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=7){let xx=data[i]*scale,yy=data[i+1]*scale,zz=data[i+2]*scale;const rx=xx*cl-yy*sl;yy=xx*sl+yy*cl;xx=rx;const ry=yy*ct+zz*st;zz=-yy*st+zz*ct;yy=ry;(dst.output||dst.out).push(x+xx*co+zz*si,y+yy,z-xx*si+zz*co,data[i+3],data[i+4],data[i+5],data[i+6])}}
function bone(m,A,B,w,col,d=w){const v=[B[0]-A[0],B[1]-A[1],B[2]-A[2]],L=Math.hypot(...v)||1,n=v.map(a=>a/L),ref=Math.abs(n[1])<.9?[0,1,0]:[1,0,0];let u=[n[1]*ref[2]-n[2]*ref[1],n[2]*ref[0]-n[0]*ref[2],n[0]*ref[1]-n[1]*ref[0]],len=Math.hypot(...u)||1;u=u.map(a=>a/len);const q=[n[1]*u[2]-n[2]*u[1],n[2]*u[0]-n[0]*u[2],n[0]*u[1]-n[1]*u[0]],pt=(a,b,s)=>[a[0]+u[0]*b*w/2+q[0]*s*d/2,a[1]+u[1]*b*w/2+q[1]*s*d/2,a[2]+u[2]*b*w/2+q[2]*s*d/2];for(const sign of [-1,1]){m.quad(pt(A,sign,-1),pt(B,sign,-1),pt(B,sign,1),pt(A,sign,1),col);m.quad(pt(A,-1,sign),pt(B,-1,sign),pt(B,1,sign),pt(A,1,sign),col)}m.quad(pt(B,-1,-1),pt(B,1,-1),pt(B,1,1),pt(B,-1,1),col)}

function clearSpot(p,r=.6){if(!collide(p.x,p.z,r))return {x:p.x,z:p.z};for(let rad=1;rad<=28;rad+=1.2)for(let k=0;k<24;k++){const x=p.x+Math.sin(k*TAU/24)*rad,z=p.z+Math.cos(k*TAU/24)*rad;if(!collide(x,z,r))return {x,z};}const n=nearestRoad(p.x,p.z).p;return n?{x:n[0],z:n[1]}:{x:PARK_POS.x,z:PARK_POS.z};}
function clearApproach(p,offset=1.6){const road=nearestRoad(p.x,p.z).p;if(road){const L=hyp(road[0]-p.x,road[1]-p.z)||1;return clearSpot({x:p.x+(road[0]-p.x)/L*offset,z:p.z+(road[1]-p.z)/L*offset},.55);}return clearSpot(p,.55);}

function startShot(kind,point){
 if(!live||software||!point||interior||kb11Cutscene.active||kb12Story.active)return;
 if(directorShot)endShot(false);makeShotHud();
 const p=actors[active],rd=nearestRoad(point.x,point.z),road=rd.road;

   if(seg!==null)axis=Math.atan2(road.p[seg][0]-road.p[seg-1][0],road.p[seg][1]-road.p[seg-1][1]);}
 const cast=actors.map((actor,i)=>{if(!crewVisible(i))return null;const a=clearSpot({x:p.x+(i-active)*1.05,z:p.z+(i%2)*.58},.39);
   const b=clearSpot({x:a.x+Math.sin(axis)*1.2,z:a.z+Math.cos(axis)*1.2},.38);
   return {actor,i,a,b:lineClear(a,b,.36)?b:a};}).filter(Boolean);
 directorShot={kind,point:{x:point.x,z:point.z},axis,cast,t:0,duration:reduced?2.7:kind==='finale'?8.4:5.4,view};

}
function easeShot(u){return u*u*(3-2*u);}
function bezierPoint(a,b,c,d,t){const s=1-t;return a.map((x,i)=>s*s*s*x+3*s*s*t*b[i]+3*s*t*t*c[i]+t*t*t*d[i]);}

 const shot=directorShot,u=clamp(shot.t/shot.duration,0,1),wide=u<.32,mid=u>=.32&&u<.65,k=easeShot(wide?u/.32:mid?(u-.32)/.33:(u-.65)/.35),sign=shot.kind==='wire'?-1:1;

 if(wide)tour=[pos(-12,8,-18),pos(-10,7,-13),pos(-8,5,-10),pos(-6,3.6,-8)];
 else if(mid)tour=[pos(2.2,.16,2.15),pos(2.08,.14,1.9),pos(1.9,.10,1.70),pos(1.66,.10,1.58)];
 else if(shot.kind==='finale')tour=[pos(2,2,-5),pos(6,8,-10),pos(12,18,-20),pos(17,30,-37)];
 else tour=[pos(-3*sign,.35,-6),pos(-2.7*sign,.18,-5.5),pos(-2*sign,.07,-4.6),pos(-1.8*sign,.03,-3.9)];

function behindCar(p,source,car){
 if(distance(p,car)>5.0)return false;const co=Math.cos(car.yaw),si=Math.sin(car.yaw);
 for(let j=1;j<=12;j++){const t=j/12*Math.min(1,5/Math.max(.01,distance(p,source))),x=lerp(p.x,source.x,t)-car.x,z=lerp(p.z,source.z,t)-car.z;
   if(Math.abs(x*co-z*si)<.92&&Math.abs(x*si+z*co)<2.1)return true;}
 return false;
}

/* STORY PACK v4 · adapter za module (ChatGPT) · m1_stealth_ograda */
const SPX_FACTORY_STEALTH=(function createM1StealthOgrada() {
  let s = null;
  let options = {};

  const dist2 = (ax, az, bx, bz) => {
    const x = ax - bx, z = az - bz;
    return x * x + z * z;
  };
  const clone = v => v == null ? null : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
  const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));

  function start(ctx, params) {
    options = params || {};
    if (s && s.active) return; // restore() pa start() nastavlja bit.
    const hedge = ctx.points.hedge;
    const pass = ctx.points.thornPass || hedge;
    const r = Math.max(3.5, Number(hedge.r) || 5);
    const angle = ctx.rand() * Math.PI * 2;
    const px = pass.x - hedge.x, pz = pass.z - hedge.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(px, pz) || 1;
    const ax = hedge.x + Math.cos(angle) * r * 0.58;
    const az = hedge.z + Math.sin(angle) * r * 0.58;
    const bx = hedge.x - Math.cos(angle) * r * 0.62;
    const bz = hedge.z - Math.sin(angle) * r * 0.62;
    s = {
      active: true, elapsed: 0, noise: clamp(ctx.noise.get(), 0, 100),
      foundA: !!ctx.flags.kalac_baterija, foundB: !!ctx.flags.kalac_poklopac,
      a: { x: ax, z: az }, b: { x: bx, z: bz },
      zones: [
        { x: hedge.x, z: hedge.z, r },
        { x: pass.x, z: pass.z, r: Math.max(2.2, r * 0.40) },
        { x: hedge.x + px / d * r * 0.58,
          z: hedge.z + pz / d * r * 0.58, r: Math.max(2, r * 0.38) }
      ],
      visibility: 1, retreat: false, retreatZone: 0,
      hints: 0, noiseWarned: false, helpful: false
    };
    ctx.tip('Čučni u ogradi. AKCIJA: pretraži trnje.', 5);
    if (s.foundA && s.foundB) { s.active = false; ctx.flags.m1_stealth_done = true; ctx.done(); }
  }

  function update(ctx, dt) {
    if (!s || !s.active) return;
    dt = clamp(Number(dt) || 0, 0, 0.10);
    s.elapsed += dt;
    const p = ctx.player;
    let zone = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.zones.length; i++) {
      const h = s.zones[i];
      if (dist2(p.x, p.z, h.x, h.z) < h.r * h.r) {
        zone = i;
        break;
      }
    }
    s.visibility = zone >= 0 ? (p.crouching ? 0.18 : 0.47) : 1;
    if (typeof options.onVisibility === 'function') {
      options.onVisibility(s.visibility);
    }

    const speed = Math.max(0, Number(p.speed) || 0);
    let change = speed < 0.20 ? -8 : speed > 3.3 ? 19 : 4.5;
    if (p.crouching) change = -10; // Čučanje ne pravi novu buku.
    if (zone >= 0 && !p.crouching && speed > 0.2) change += 3;
    const previous = s.noise;
    s.noise = clamp(previous + change * dt, 0, 100);
    ctx.noise.add(s.noise - previous);

    if (s.noise >= 100) {
      s.noise = 50;
      ctx.noise.add(50 - 100);
      s.retreat = zone >= 0;
      s.retreatZone = Math.max(0, zone);
      ctx.sound('dog_bark', 0.95);
      ctx.tip('Šuša je zalajao. Izađi iz žive ograde.', 4);
    }
    if (s.retreat) {
      const h = s.zones[s.retreatZone];
      if (dist2(p.x, p.z, h.x, h.z) > (h.r + 1.2) ** 2) {
        s.retreat = false;
        ctx.tip('Sad možeš ponovo.', 2);
      }
    }

    // Tri skrivena nagoveštaja; svaki se javlja samo jednom.
    if (!(s.hints & 1) && s.elapsed > 35 &&
        dist2(p.x, p.z, s.a.x, s.a.z) < 36) {
      s.hints |= 1;
      ctx.tip('Bela nit visi sa trna.', 3);
    }
    if (!(s.hints & 2) && s.elapsed > 65 &&
        dist2(p.x, p.z, s.b.x, s.b.z) < 64) {
      s.hints |= 2;
      ctx.tip('Mačka prolazi kroz uzak otvor.', 3);
    }
    if (!(s.hints & 4) && s.elapsed > 85 && zone >= 0) {
      s.hints |= 4;
      ctx.tip('Poznat glas dopire iza ograde. Nema nikoga.', 4);
    }
    if (s.elapsed > 115 && !s.helpful) {
      s.helpful = true;
      ctx.tip('Pregledaj oba kraja žive ograde.', 5);
    }
    if (s.noise > 80 && !s.noiseWarned) {
      s.noiseWarned = true;
      ctx.tip('Buka je visoka.', 2);
    } else if (s.noise < 55) {
      s.noiseWarned = false;
    }
    const items = Number(s.foundA) + Number(s.foundB);
    const suffix = s.retreat ? ' · IZAĐI IZ OGRADE' :
      zone >= 0 ? ' · zaklon' : '';
    ctx.setHud('Trnje ' + items + '/2 · buka ' +
      Math.round(s.noise) + '/100' + suffix, items / 2);
  }

  function interact(ctx) {
    if (!s || !s.active) return;
    if (s.retreat) {
      ctx.tip('Prvo izađi iz ograde.', 2);
      return;
    }
    const p = ctx.player;
    if (!s.foundA && dist2(p.x, p.z, s.a.x, s.a.z) <= 2.5 ** 2) {
      s.foundA = true;
      ctx.flags.kalac_baterija = true;
      ctx.sound('pickup', 0.7);
      ctx.tip('Baterija pronađena.', 3);
    } else if (!s.foundB &&
        dist2(p.x, p.z, s.b.x, s.b.z) <= 2.5 ** 2) {
      s.foundB = true;
      ctx.flags.kalac_poklopac = true;
      ctx.sound('pickup', 0.7);
      ctx.tip('Poklopac telefona pronađen.', 3);
    } else {
      ctx.tip('Ovde nema ničega. Probaj bliže trnju.', 2);
    }
    if (s.foundA && s.foundB) {
      s.active = false;
      ctx.flags.m1_stealth_done = true;
      ctx.done();
    }
  }

  function stop(ctx, reason) {
    if (s) s.active = false;
    if (reason === 'abort') ctx.setHud('', 0);
  }

  return {
    id: 'm1_stealth_ograda',
    start, update, interact, stop,
    serialize() { return clone(s); },
    restore(obj) { s = obj && typeof obj === 'object' ? clone(obj) : null; },
    debug() { return s; } // Samo za radar test-stranice.
  };
});

function vukRoad(){let pts=[];for(const r of roads.filter(r=>/Lole Stojanovi/i.test(r.name||'')))for(const q of r.p){const l=pts[pts.length-1];if(!l||Math.hypot(l[0]-q[0],l[1]-q[1])>.5)pts.push(q)}if(pts.length<2)pts=[[245,176],[194,126],[-61,15]];return pts}
function vukAlong(pts,s){let acc=0;for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++){const a=pts[i],b=pts[i+1],l=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1;if(acc+l>=s||i===pts.length-2){const k=clamp((s-acc)/l,0,1);return {x:a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*k,z:a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*k,tx:(b[0]-a[0])/l,tz:(b[1]-a[1])/l}}acc+=l}return {x:pts[0][0],z:pts[0][1],tx:1,tz:0}}
function vukSetup(){
 const pts=vukRoad();let tot=0;for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++)tot+=Math.hypot(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0],pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]);
 const sv=tot*.45,P=vukAlong(pts,sv),S0=vukAlong(pts,Math.max(6,sv-46));
 let best=null;for(const sg of [1,-1]){const ox=P.x-P.tz*6.5*sg,oz=P.z+P.tx*6.5*sg,q=clearSpot({x:ox,z:oz},.5),d=Math.hypot(q.x-ox,q.z-oz);if(!best||d<best.d)best={q,d,sg}}

function vukStep(o,gx,gz,sp,dt){const dx=gx-o.x,dz=gz-o.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<.45){o.move=0;return true}
 const k=Math.min(1,sp*dt/d);let mv=moveBody(o,dx*k,dz*k,.3);if(mv<.002){const a=Math.atan2(dx,dz)+1.1;mv=moveBody(o,Math.sin(a)*sp*dt,Math.cos(a)*sp*dt,.3)}
 o.yaw=angleLerp(o.yaw,Math.atan2(dx,dz),Math.min(1,dt*8));o.move=mv/dt;o.phase=(o.phase||0)+mv*2.7;return false}
/* ===== ZVUČNIK · pesma svira iz sveta igre, tamo gde je zvučnik (kod Vuka, kod tebe ili na zemlji) =====
   Pun opseg sa jakim basom, blago zasićenje i kompresor (kao pravi bluetooth zvučnik), 3D pozicija,
   zid/kuća prigušuju, unutra se čuje kroz zid. Pesme su iste kao u telefonu, a pušta ih onaj kod koga je telefon (Vuk). */
const SPK={exists:false,holder:'vuk',gx:0,gz:0,el:null,n:null,song:-1,vol:.9,userPaused:false,autoPaused:false,queue:[],lvl:0,t0:0,chk:0,blocked:false,d:0,g:0,fr:0,buf:null,intro:false};
try{const v=parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('kb_spk_vol'));if(isFinite(v))SPK.vol=clamp(v,0,1)}catch(_){}
function spkSongs(){const S=window.KBSongs;return S&&S.count?S:null}
function spkNextIdx(){const S=spkSongs();if(!S)return -1;if(!SPK.queue.length){const a=[...Array(S.count).keys()];for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.random()*(i+1)|0;[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}if(a.length>1&&a[0]===SPK.song)a.push(a.shift());SPK.queue=a}return SPK.queue.shift()}
function spkKill(){const a=SPK.el,n=SPK.n;SPK.el=null;SPK.n=null;if(!a)return;a.onended=null;try{if(n&&audio)n.vg.gain.setTargetAtTime(.0001,audio.currentTime,.06)}catch(_){}
 setTimeout(()=>{try{a.pause()}catch(_){}if(n)for(const k in n){try{n[k].disconnect()}catch(_){}}},340)}
function spkStop(){spkKill();SPK.song=-1;SPK.userPaused=false;SPK.autoPaused=false}
function spkReset(){spkStop();SPK.exists=false;SPK.holder='vuk';SPK.queue=[]}
function spkPlay(i,from=0){
 const S=spkSongs();if(!S||!SPK.exists)return false;if(i==null||i<0)i=spkNextIdx();if(i<0||i>=S.count)return false;
 spkKill();
 try{initAudio();const c=audio;if(!c||c.state==='closed')return false;if(c.state==='suspended')c.resume().catch(()=>{});
  const a=new Audio(S.src(i));a.preload='auto';a.volume=1;
  if(from>1)a.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',()=>{try{a.currentTime=from}catch(_){}},{once:true});
  a.onended=()=>{if(SPK.el===a)spkPlay(-1)};
  const src=c.createMediaElementSource(a);
  const hp=c.createBiquadFilter();hp.type='highpass';hp.frequency.value=34;hp.Q.value=.7;
  const bass=c.createBiquadFilter();bass.type='lowshelf';bass.frequency.value=110;bass.gain.value=7;
  const mid=c.createBiquadFilter();mid.type='peaking';mid.frequency.value=2600;mid.Q.value=.9;mid.gain.value=2.5;
  const hi=c.createBiquadFilter();hi.type='highshelf';hi.frequency.value=9000;hi.gain.value=-2;
  const ws=c.createWaveShaper(),cu=new Float32Array(1024),dr=1.6,nm=Math.tanh(dr);for(let k=0;k<1024;k++)cu[k]=Math.tanh((k/512-1)*dr)/nm;ws.curve=cu;ws.oversample='2x';
  const cm=c.createDynamicsCompressor();cm.threshold.value=-18;cm.knee.value=12;cm.ratio.value=4;cm.attack.value=.005;cm.release.value=.22;
  const lp=c.createBiquadFilter();lp.type='lowpass';lp.frequency.value=17000;lp.Q.value=.6;
  const vg=c.createGain();vg.gain.value=.0001;
  const an=c.createAnalyser();an.fftSize=256;an.smoothingTimeConstant=.6;
  const pn=c.createPanner();pn.panningModel='HRTF';pn.distanceModel='inverse';pn.refDistance=4;pn.maxDistance=200;pn.rolloffFactor=1;
  src.connect(hp);hp.connect(bass);bass.connect(mid);mid.connect(hi);hi.connect(ws);ws.connect(cm);cm.connect(an);cm.connect(lp);lp.connect(vg);vg.connect(pn);pn.connect(c.destination);
  SPK.n={src,hp,bass,mid,hi,ws,cm,an,lp,vg,pn};SPK.el=a;SPK.song=i;SPK.userPaused=false;SPK.autoPaused=false;SPK.buf=new Uint8Array(an.frequencyBinCount);SPK.chk=0;
  const p=a.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{});
  tip('♪ '+(SPK.holder==='vuk'?'Vuk pušta':'Zvučnik svira')+': '+S.title(i)+' · '+S.artist(i),4);
  return true;
 }catch(e){SPK.el=null;SPK.n=null;return false}
}
function spkNext(){spkPlay(-1)}
function spkToggle(){const a=SPK.el;if(!a){spkPlay(-1);return}if(a.paused){SPK.userPaused=false;const p=a.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{})}else{SPK.userPaused=true;a.pause()}}
function spkVol(v){SPK.vol=Math.round(clamp(v,0,1)*100)/100;try{localStorage.setItem('kb_spk_vol',String(SPK.vol))}catch(_){}tip('🔊 Jačina zvučnika: '+Math.round(SPK.vol*100)+'%',1.6)}
if(!window.__kbSpkKeys){window.__kbSpkKeys=1;document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!SPK.el||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.altKey)return;const tg=e.target;if(tg&&(tg.isContentEditable||/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(tg.tagName)))return;if(e.key==='-'||e.key==='_')spkVol(SPK.vol-.1);else if(e.key==='+'||e.key==='=')spkVol(SPK.vol+.1)})}
function spkPos(){
 if(SPK.holder==='player'){const a=actors[active],fx=Math.sin(yaw),fz=Math.cos(yaw);return {x:a.x+Math.cos(yaw)*.4+fx*.5,z:a.z-Math.sin(yaw)*.4+fz*.5,y:height(a.x,a.z)+.95}}
 if(SPK.holder==='ground')return {x:SPK.gx,z:SPK.gz,y:height(SPK.gx,SPK.gz)+.25};
 return {x:VUK.x,z:VUK.z,y:height(VUK.x,VUK.z)+.95}}
function spkTick(dt){
 const a=SPK.el,n=SPK.n;if(!a||!n||!audio)return;const c=audio;
 if(!live||paused||document.hidden){if(!a.paused){a.pause();SPK.autoPaused=true}return}
 if(SPK.autoPaused){SPK.autoPaused=false;if(!SPK.userPaused){const p=a.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{})}}
 if(c.state==='suspended')c.resume().catch(()=>{});
 const me=actors[active],pos=spkPos(),t=c.currentTime,P=(p,v)=>{if(p)p.setValueAtTime(v,t)};
 let d=Math.hypot(pos.x-me.x,pos.z-me.z),px=pos.x,py=pos.y,pz=pos.z,away=false;
 if(interior){away=true;d=40;px=me.x+4;py=height(me.x,me.z)+1.2;pz=me.z-3;SPK.blocked=true}
 else if(SPK.holder==='player'){d=.5;SPK.blocked=false}
 else if(time-SPK.chk>.25){SPK.chk=time;try{SPK.blocked=!lineClear(me,pos,.1)}catch(_){SPK.blocked=false}}
 const fade=1-clamp((d-70)/40,0,1),amp=SPK.vol*SPK.vol,bl=SPK.blocked;
 SPK.d=d;SPK.g=amp*fade;
 const pn=n.pn;if(pn.positionX){P(pn.positionX,px);P(pn.positionY,py);P(pn.positionZ,pz)}else{try{pn.setPosition(px,py,pz)}catch(_){}}
 n.vg.gain.setTargetAtTime(.95*amp*fade*(away?.3:bl?.5:1),t,.08);
 n.lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(clamp(17000-d*230,1600,17000)*(away?.03:bl?.12:1),t,.12);
 if((++SPK.fr&1)===0&&SPK.buf){try{n.an.getByteFrequencyData(SPK.buf);let s=0;for(let i=0;i<8;i++)s+=SPK.buf[i];SPK.lvl+=(s/8/255-SPK.lvl)*.5}catch(_){}}
}
/* ---- crtanje zvučnika (isti model u Vukovim rukama, u tvojoj ruci i na zemlji) ---- */
function spkModel(b,x,y,z){
 const l=SPK.lvl||0,on=!!SPK.el&&!SPK.autoPaused&&!SPK.userPaused,w=.25,h=.42,d=.2,fz=z+d/2,rg=['#ff4fd8','#5cf0ff','#ffd24a'][(time*1.6|0)%3],fr='#aab1bd';
 b.box(x,y,z,w,h,d,'#272b33');b.box(x,y,fz+.004,w*.9,h*.9,.012,'#3a3f4a');
 for(const sx of [-1,1])b.box(x+sx*(w/2-.006),y,fz+.008,.012,h,.014,fr);       // svetli okvir da se vidi i na crnoj majici
 b.box(x,y+h/2-.006,fz+.008,w,.012,.014,fr);b.box(x,y-h/2+.006,fz+.008,w,.012,.014,fr);
 const k=1+(on?l*.25:0);
 b.sphere(x,y-h*.12,fz+.014,.092,.092,.02,'#7b818d');b.sphere(x,y-h*.12,fz+.02,.078*k,.078*k,.02,'#0b0c0f');b.sphere(x,y-h*.12,fz+.028,.032,.032,.012,'#555b67');
 b.sphere(x,y+h*.27,fz+.012,.04,.04,.015,'#7b818d');b.sphere(x,y+h*.27,fz+.02,.03,.03,.012,'#0b0c0f');
 b.box(x,y+h/2+.016,z,w*.5,.026,.022,'#14161a');b.box(x-w*.25,y+h/2+.006,z,.022,.03,.022,'#14161a');b.box(x+w*.25,y+h/2+.006,z,.022,.03,.022,'#14161a');
 b.box(x,y-h*.43,fz+.016,w*.46,.018,.012,on?(((time*9)|0)%2?'#5cf0b0':'#2e9c74'):'#3a7bd5',4);
 if(on){b.box(x,y+h*.42,fz+.016,w*.8,.014,.012,rg,4);for(const sx of [-1,1])b.box(x+sx*(w/2+.002),y,z,.006,h*.7*(.4+l*.6),.01,rg,4)}
}

function vukSnap(){const P=actors[active],q=clearSpot({x:P.x-Math.sin(yaw)*3+Math.cos(yaw)*1.4,z:P.z-Math.cos(yaw)*3-Math.sin(yaw)*1.4},.4);Object.assign(VUK,{x:q.x,z:q.z,move:0,path:[],repath:0,stuck:0});
 if(VUK.leonOn){const l=clearSpot({x:q.x-1.4,z:q.z-1},.4);Object.assign(VUK.leon,{x:l.x,z:l.z,move:0,path:[],repath:0,stuck:0})}}
function vukCrewTick(dt){
 const V=VUK,L=V.leon,P=actors[active];
 if(interior||football||transition){V.snap=true;return}
 if(V.snap){V.snap=false;if(distance(P,V)>14)vukSnap()}
 const dist=distance(P,V);if(dist>52){vukSnap();return}
 V.far=dist>16?(V.far||0)+dt:0;if(V.far>9){V.far=0;vukSnap();return}   // zaglavio se negde: stigni ekipu
 const tr=P.trail||[];let walked=0,des={x:P.x,z:P.z};
 for(let k=tr.length-1;k>0;k--){walked+=distance(tr[k],tr[k-1]);des=tr[k-1];if(walked>3.4)break}
 V.sideT=(V.sideT||0)-dt;if(V.sideT<=0){V.sideT=.4;const sx=des.x+Math.cos(yaw)*1.5,sz=des.z-Math.sin(yaw)*1.5;V.side=lineClear(P,{x:sx,z:sz},.3)&&lineClear(des,{x:sx,z:sz},.3)?{x:sx,z:sz}:{x:des.x,z:des.z}}
 let tgt=V.side||des;if(dist>12&&distance(V,tgt)<6)tgt={x:P.x,z:P.z};
 if(dist>4.6||(V.move>.6&&dist>3.1))follower(V,tgt,dt,dist>14?7.2:5.6);else V.move=lerp(V.move,0,Math.min(1,dt*9));
 if(V.move<.4&&dist<9)V.yaw=angleLerp(V.yaw,Math.atan2(P.x-V.x,P.z-V.z),Math.min(1,dt*2.2));
 if(V.leonOn&&L.state==='follow'){
  const lx=V.x-Math.sin(V.yaw)*1.7-Math.cos(V.yaw)*.9,lz=V.z-Math.cos(V.yaw)*1.7+Math.sin(V.yaw)*.9,dl=Math.hypot(L.x-V.x,L.z-V.z);
  if(dl>26){const q=clearSpot({x:lx,z:lz},.4);L.x=q.x;L.z=q.z;L.path=[];L.move=0}
  else if(dl>2.8||(L.move>.6&&dl>1.6))follower(L,{x:lx,z:lz},dt,dl>10?7.6:5.8);else{L.move=lerp(L.move,0,Math.min(1,dt*9));L.yaw=angleLerp(L.yaw,Math.atan2(V.x-L.x,V.z-L.z),Math.min(1,dt*3))}
 }
}

  if(SPK.holder==='vuk')o.push({label:'UZMI ZVUČNIK',detail:'Nosiš ga ti · svira iz tvoje ruke',run:()=>spkMove('player')});
