function vukTick(dt){
 spkTick(dt);if(!VUK.show||!live||paused||!story.on)return;if(VUK.crew){vukCrewTick(dt);return}VUK.t+=dt;const V=VUK,L=V.leon,P=actors[active];
 if(V.after&&!dialogueQueue.length&&time>subtitleUntil&&!cine.choice){const f=V.after;V.after=null;f()}
 /* Leon laje iza ograde dok čeka */
 if(L.state==='yard'&&time>V.barkNext&&distance(P,L)<45){V.barkNext=time+3.5+Math.random()*3;sound('bark',.85,{x:L.x,z:L.z});L.move=0}
 if(L.state==='yard'){L.yaw=angleLerp(L.yaw,Math.atan2(P.x-L.x,P.z-L.z),Math.min(1,dt*3))}
 const ph=V.ph;
 if(ph==='z_out'){
  if(V.stage===0){if(vukStep(V,V.goal.x,V.goal.z,2.4,dt)){V.stage=1;V.t=0;V.move=0}}
  else if(V.stage===1){V.move=0;if(V.t>1.6){SPK.exists=true;SPK.holder='vuk';SPK.t0=time;sound('collect',.8);V.stage=2;V.t=0}}
  else if(V.stage===2){const d=Math.hypot(V.x-P.x,V.z-P.z)||1;if(vukStep(V,P.x+(V.x-P.x)/d*2.6,P.z+(V.z-P.z)/d*2.6,2.6,dt)||V.t>20){V.move=0;V.stage=3;V.t=0;
    vukPhase('z_phone','Vuk traži tvoj telefon. Daj mu ga.');
    conversation([['Vuk','Evo ga! Pun do kraja. Samo… zvučnik bez telefona je obična kutija.',4],['Vuk','Daj mi svoj telefon da pustim pesmu. Ja nosim zvučnik, ti si zadužen za muziku.',5]])}}
 }else if(ph==='l_out'){
  if(V.stage===0){if(vukStep(V,V.goal.x-V.nx*.6,V.goal.z-V.nz*.6,2.4,dt)){V.stage=1;V.t=0;V.move=0;L.state='leash';sound('bark',.9,{x:L.x,z:L.z})}}
  else if(V.stage===1){V.move=0;if(V.t>1.4){V.goal={x:V.road.x+V.nx*2.2,z:V.road.z+V.nz*2.2};V.stage=2}}
  else if(V.stage===2){if(vukStep(V,V.goal.x,V.goal.z,2.3,dt)){V.stage=3;V.t=0;V.move=0;
    conversation([['Vuk','Mirno, Leone, mirno… Nešto je nanjušio. Vuče me ka kraju ulice.',5]]);V.find={x:V.fnd.x,z:V.fnd.z};V.goal={x:V.fnd.x-V.nx*2.5,z:V.fnd.z-V.nz*2.5}}}
  else if(V.stage===3){const rr=vukStep(V,V.goal.x,V.goal.z,2.2,dt);const a=vukStep(L,V.find.x,V.find.z,4.6,dt);if(a&&rr){L.state='sniff';V.stage=4;V.t=0;V.move=0;L.move=0;sound('bark',.9,{x:L.x,z:L.z});vukPhase('find','Leon je nešto našao uz ogradu. Priđi mu.')}}
 }else if(ph==='s_out'){
  if(V.stage===0){const d=Math.hypot(V.x-P.x,V.z-P.z)||1,tx=P.x+(V.x-P.x)/d*2.4,tz=P.z+(V.z-P.z)/d*2.4;if(vukStep(V,tx,tz,2.6,dt)||V.t>14){V.stage=1;V.move=0;vukPhase('phone')}}
 }
 /* Leon vodi pored Vuka dok je na povodcu */
 if(L.state==='leash'&&ph==='l_out'&&V.stage<3){vukStep(L,V.x+V.nx*-.8+Math.cos(V.yaw)*.9,V.z+V.nz*-.8-Math.sin(V.yaw)*.9,3.2,dt);L.yaw=V.yaw}
 if(L.state==='sniff'){L.yaw=angleLerp(L.yaw,Math.atan2(V.find.x-L.x+Math.sin(time*2)*.3,V.find.z-L.z),dt*4)}
 /* Vuk gleda ka igraču kad stoji blizu */
 if(!ph||ph==='approach'||ph==='ask'||ph==='find'||ph==='phone'||ph==='z_phone'||ph==='z_play'||ph==='done'){V.move=0;if(distance(P,V)<16)V.yaw=angleLerp(V.yaw,Math.atan2(P.x-V.x,P.z-V.z),Math.min(1,dt*3))}
}
function vukHuman(m){

 const tee='#14161d',trim='#2b2e39',shorts='#a1a7a9',skin='#cfa07f',hair='#1b140f',shoe='#ecece6';

 const both=Math.min(v.wR,v.wL),mx=(a,c,k)=>a+(c-a)*k;

 b.box(.012,hip+.36+bob,.165,.018,.5,.018,trim);
 for(const sign of [-1,1]){const leg=swing*sign,sx=sign*.135,knee=[sx,hip-.40,Math.sin(leg)*.29],foot=[sx,.12,Math.sin(leg)*.56],mid=[sx,hip-.27,Math.sin(leg)*.2];

  b.sphere(foot[0],foot[1]+.023,foot[2],.061,.061,.065,'#f4f4f0',0);kb11Shoe(b,foot[0],foot[1],foot[2],shoe,'#cfcfc6');
  const w=sign===1?v.wR:v.wL,sh=[sign*.255,hip+.60+bob,0];
  const acting=kb11Cutscene.active&&kb11Cutscene.speaker==='Vuk'&&sign===1;
  let fh=acting?[sign*.29,hip+.34+bob,.32+Math.sin(time*5)*.08]:[sign*.31,hip+.05+bob,-Math.sin(leg)*.30],
        fe=acting?[sign*.35,hip+.38+bob,.16]:[sign*.325,hip+.31+bob,-Math.sin(leg)*.15];
  if(kb12Story.active&&kb12Story.P.Vuk){const va=kb12Story.P.Vuk.act,T=time,o1=Math.sin(T*7),o2=Math.sin(T*4.3);
   if(va==='tease'){if(sign===1){fh=[.21,hip+.64+o1*.03,.64];fe=[.40,hip+.52,.24]}else{fh=[-.25,hip+.14,.07];fe=[-.46,hip+.30,-.03]}}
   else if(va==='laugh'){fh=[sign*.13,hip+.32+Math.abs(Math.sin(T*9))*.06,.28];fe=[sign*.40,hip+.34,.14]}
   else if(va==='shrug'){fh=[sign*.60,hip+.36+Math.max(0,o2)*.04,.30];fe=[sign*.50,hip+.40,.10]}

   else if(va==='think'){fh=sign===1?[.06,hip+.62,.28]:[.10,hip+.30,.24];fe=sign===1?[.22,hip+.42,.20]:[-.28,hip+.30,.14]}}
  const oh=[sign*.34,hip+.10+bob,.06],oe=[sign*.33,hip+.32+bob,.0],bh=[sign*.125,hip+.34+bob,.42],be=[sign*.29,hip+.34+bob,.22];
  const ch=[mx(oh[0],bh[0],both),mx(oh[1],bh[1],both),mx(oh[2],bh[2],both)],ce=[mx(oe[0],be[0],both),mx(oe[1],be[1],both),mx(oe[2],be[2],both)];

  if(sign===1)b.box(hand[0],hand[1]+.07,hand[2]-.02,.085,.038,.085,'#0c0d10');   // crni sat
 }

  const cR=[.34,hip-.19+bob,.06],cL=[-.34,hip-.19+bob,.06],cB=[0,hip+.34+bob,.46],oR=v.wR-both,oL=v.wL-both,s=oR+oL+both||1;

 const Y=height(v.x,v.z);castActorShadow(m,v,Y);transformMesh(m,b.out,v.x,Y,v.z,v.yaw,0,0,1);
}

 if(active!==0){const guard=clearSpot({x:missionScene.phone.x-5,z:missionScene.phone.z-9});follower(actors[0],guard,dt,7.4);const threat=dogs.filter(d=>d.mission&&d.fear<=0).sort((a,b)=>distance(a,actors[0])-distance(b,actors[0]))[0];if(threat&&distance(threat,actors[0])<12&&time>cine.defendNext){cine.defendNext=time+3.4;actors[0].lookYaw=Math.atan2(threat.x-actors[0].x,threat.z-actors[0].z);threat.fear=2.7;threat.state='flee';sound('flash',.35,actors[0]);}}

 return false;
}

/* A1: ove funkcije žive u postojećem zatvaranju 3D pogona. */
let kbA1BetaAt = 0;
function kbA1BetaObserve(complete = false) {
  const A = window.KBMissionDirector?.adapters; if (!A || !story.on && !complete) return;
  A.safe(d => d.observeBeta({on: story.on, complete, chapter: complete ? 2 : story.chapter,
    step: complete ? 3 : story.step, flags: cine?.flags || {}}));
}
function kbA1BetaSave() {
  window.KBStoryExtensions?.checkpoint();
  kbA1BetaObserve();
  return window.KBMissionDirector?.adapters.safe(() => window.KBMissionDirector.adapters.capture()) || undefined;
}

function saveGame(){if(!live||football||interior||transition)return false;const p=actors[active],kbDirector=kbA1BetaSave();if(story.on)return stateStore.put(CINEMA_SAVE,{kbDirector,version:5,chapter:story.chapter,step:story.step,active,prologue:VUK.on?{branch:VUK.branch,phase:VUK.ph}:null,actors:actors.map(({x,z,yaw})=>({x,z,yaw})),flags:cine?.flags,spx:(SPX.running?SPX.mod.serialize():null),scan:cine?.scan,peraFound:cine?.peraFound,flareStock:cine?.flareStock,gateMode:cine?.gateMode,wire:cine?.wire?{remaining:cine.wire.remaining,links:cine.wire.links}:cine?.savedWire?{remaining:45,links:cine.savedWire}:null,
 station:cine?.stationArmed?{sync:cine.sync,signal:cine.signal,tune:cine.tune,required:cine.requiredTune,scanner:cine.scanner}:null,at:Date.now()});return stateStore.put('kb_real_free_v1',{kbDirector,x:p.x,z:p.z,yaw,battery:ride.battery,at:Date.now()});}

function woodSmoothPath(path){if(path.length<3)return path;const out=[path[0]];for(let i=0;i<path.length-1;){let best=i+1;for(let j=Math.min(path.length-1,i+45);j>i+1;j--){const A=path[i],B=path[j],a={x:A[0],z:A[1]},b={x:B[0],z:B[1]};if(distance(a,b)>130||!lineClear(a,b,.45))continue;let forest=false,valid=true;for(let k=1;k<9;k++){const x=lerp(a.x,b.x,k/9),z=lerp(a.z,b.z,k/9);if(inWood(x,z))forest=true;else if(nearestRoad(x,z).d>5){valid=false;break;}}if(forest&&valid){best=j;break;}}out.push(path[best]);i=best;}return out;}

function startFootball(options={}){if(football||interior||transition)return;if(story.on){tip('Meč počinje u slobodnoj igri.',3);return;}const p=actors[active],street=!!options.street,count=3,F={...FIELD,w:street?28:50,d:street?18:32},players=[];

 football={players,field:F,ground:fieldY,street,ball:{x:F.x,y:fieldY+.38,z:F.z,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,spin:0,owner:0,cooldown:0},selected:0,score:[0,0],remaining:street?90:180,pause:1.6,over:false,kickTeam:0,maxGoals:street?2:3,lastPass:'',message:street?'NOĆNI DERBI · 3 NA 3':'POČETAK MEČA',return:{x:p.x,z:p.z,yaw,active,view}};ride.kind=0;ride.speed=0;clearInput();setBig(false);resetKickoff(0);yaw=Math.PI/2;pitch=-.18;view=software?2:1;sound('whistle');dayMode=street?3:dayMode;tip(street?'NOĆNI DERBI · 3 na 3 · 90 s · do 2 gola · Space šut · E pas':'FUDBAL · drži Space / ŠUT pa pusti · E pas · C igrač',6);snapCamera();updateHUD();}
function resetKickoff(team){const f=football;if(!f)return;for(const p of f.players){p.x=p.hx;p.z=p.hz;p.vx=p.vz=p.move=0;}const i=f.players.findIndex(p=>p.team===team);f.players[i].x=f.field.x+(team===0?-1:1)*.9;f.players[i].z=f.field.z;Object.assign(f.ball,{x:f.field.x,y:f.ground+.38,z:f.field.z,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,spin:0,owner:i,cooldown:.4});f.kickTeam=team;f.selected=0;charging=false;shotCharge=0;}
function exitFootball(){const f=football;if(!f)return;const r=f.return;football=null;active=r.active;Object.assign(actors[active],{x:r.x,z:r.z,vx:0,vz:0,jump:0,vy:0});yaw=r.yaw;pitch=-.06;view=r.view||0;clearInput();$('betaFootball').hidden=true;$('betaCharge').hidden=true;snapCamera();if(worldEvent?.type==='derby'&&worldEvent.state==='playing'){const won=f.over&&f.score[0]>f.score[1];resolveEvent(won,won?'Pobeda pod sijalicom: '+f.score.join(' : ')+'. Kosta: „Važi, revanš kad ne bude magle!“':f.over?'Derbi je završen '+f.score.join(' : ')+'. Ekipa traži revanš.':'Izašao si iz derbija. Ekipa nastavlja bez tebe.');}else tip('Vratio si se u slobodnu šetnju.',3);updateHUD();saveGame();}
function switchFootballer(){const f=football;if(!f||f.over)return;const choices=f.players.map((p,i)=>({p,i,d:distance(p,f.ball)})).filter(q=>q.p.team===0&&!q.p.gk&&q.i!==f.selected).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d);if(choices.length){f.selected=choices[0].i;charging=false;shotCharge=0;tip('IGRAČ · '+f.players[f.selected].n,1.4);}}
function passBall(){const f=football;if(!f||f.pause>0||f.over)return;const a=f.players[f.selected],b=f.ball;if(b.owner!==f.selected){tip('Priđi lopti i preuzmi je.',1.5);return;}const mates=f.players.map((p,i)=>({p,i})).filter(q=>q.p.team===a.team&&!q.p.gk&&q.i!==f.selected),choice=mates.map(q=>{const d=distance(a,q.p),op=f.players.filter(o=>o.team!==a.team).reduce((v,o)=>Math.min(v,distance(o,q.p)),99),forward=(q.p.x-a.x)*Math.sin(yaw)+(q.p.z-a.z)*Math.cos(yaw);return {...q,value:forward*.55+op*.8-d*.08};}).sort((a,b)=>b.value-a.value)[0];if(!choice)return;kickBall(f.selected,choice.p.x+choice.p.vx*.25,choice.p.z+choice.p.vz*.25,clamp(distance(a,choice.p)*1.15,8,18),.5,0);f.lastPass='PAS → '+choice.p.n;tip(f.lastPass,1.5);}
function kickBall(index,tx,tz,speed,lift=2,spin=0){const f=football;if(!f)return;const b=f.ball,a=f.players[index],dx=tx-b.x,dz=tz-b.z,L=hyp(dx,dz)||1;b.owner=null;b.vx=dx/L*speed;b.vz=dz/L*speed;b.vy=lift;b.spin=spin;b.y=Math.max(b.y,f.ground+.39);b.cooldown=.24;a.aiTimer=1.1;sound('kick');}
function releaseShot(){const f=football,power=clamp(shotCharge,0,1);charging=false;shotCharge=0;if(!f||f.over||f.pause>0)return;const i=f.selected,a=f.players[i],b=f.ball;if(b.owner!==i){if(distance(a,b)<1.8&&b.y<f.ground+1)b.owner=i;else return;}const F=f.field,manual=aim||aimHeld,goalHalf=f.street?1.7:3.0;let tx=F.x+F.w/2+2,tz=F.z+clamp(Math.sin(yaw-Math.PI/2)*8,-goalHalf,goalHalf);if(manual){tx=b.x+Math.sin(yaw)*30;tz=b.z+Math.cos(yaw)*30;}const axes=inputAxes(),precision=a.n==='Andrej'?.8:1;kickBall(i,tx,tz,12+power*14,manual?2.6+power*2:f.street?1.2+power*.6:2.0+power,axes.sd*5*precision);}
function scoreGoal(team){const f=football;if(!f||f.pause>0||f.over)return;f.score[team]++;f.pause=2.1;f.kickTeam=1-team;f.message=team===0?'GOL ZA KALAČ!':'GOL ZA GROBARSKO';tip(f.message+' · '+f.score.join(' : '),3);sound('goal');if(f.score[team]>=f.maxGoals){f.over=true;f.message=team===0?'POBEDA KALAČA!':'POBEDA GROBARSKOG';tip(f.message+' · '+f.score.join(' : ')+(f.street?' · E vrati se u kraj':''),8);}charging=false;shotCharge=0;}
function advanceBall(dt){const f=football,b=f.ball,F=f.field,y0=f.ground+.38;if(b.owner!==null){const a=f.players[b.owner];b.x=lerp(b.x,a.x+Math.sin(a.yaw)*.73,Math.min(1,dt*24));b.z=lerp(b.z,a.z+Math.cos(a.yaw)*.73,Math.min(1,dt*24));b.y=y0+.015*Math.sin(time*11);b.vx=a.vx;b.vz=a.vz;b.vy=0;return;}
 const px=b.x,pz=b.z,py=b.y,oldvx=b.vx;b.vx+=-b.vz*b.spin*.105*dt;b.vz+=oldvx*b.spin*.105*dt;b.spin*=Math.exp(-dt*1.1);b.vy-=9.81*dt;b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.z+=b.vz*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;
 if(b.y<y0){b.y=y0;if(b.vy<-.8){b.vy=-b.vy*.5;sound('bounce',Math.min(1,b.vy/5));}else b.vy=0;const speed=hyp(b.vx,b.vz),newSpeed=Math.max(0,speed-(1.8+rain*.4)*dt);if(speed>0){b.vx*=newSpeed/speed;b.vz*=newSpeed/speed;}}else{b.vx*=Math.exp(-dt*.1);b.vz*=Math.exp(-dt*.1);}
 for(const sign of [-1,1]){const gx=F.x+sign*F.w/2;if((px-gx)*sign<=0&&(b.x-gx)*sign>0){const alpha=(gx-px)/(b.x-px||1),cz=lerp(pz,b.z,alpha),cy=lerp(py,b.y,alpha);if(Math.abs(cz-F.z)<(f.street?2:3.5)-.22&&cy<f.ground+.13+(f.street?1.7:2.4)-.22){scoreGoal(sign===1?0:1);return;}b.x=gx-sign*.24;b.vx=-b.vx*.64;}}
 if(Math.abs(b.z-F.z)>F.d/2-.22){b.z=F.z+Math.sign(b.z-F.z)*(F.d/2-.23);b.vz=-b.vz*.67;}
 if(b.cooldown<=0&&b.y<f.ground+1.55){let winner=-1,best=1.05;for(let i=0;i<f.players.length;i++){const d=distance(f.players[i],b);if(d<best){best=d;winner=i;}}if(winner>=0){b.owner=winner;b.cooldown=.55;b.spin=0;}}
}
function updateFootball(dt){const f=football;if(!f)return;const F=f.field;if(f.over){charging=false;return;}if(f.pause>0){f.pause-=dt;if(f.pause<=0)resetKickoff(f.kickTeam);return;}f.remaining=Math.max(0,f.remaining-dt);if(f.remaining<=0){f.over=true;f.message=f.score[0]===f.score[1]?'NEREŠENO':f.score[0]>f.score[1]?'POBEDA KALAČA!':'POBEDA GROBARSKOG';tip(f.message+' · '+f.score.join(' : ')+(f.street?' · E povratak u kraj':''),8);sound('whistle');return;}f.ball.cooldown=Math.max(0,f.ball.cooldown-dt);if(charging)shotCharge=Math.min(1,shotCharge+dt/1.1);
 const chasers=[0,1].map(team=>f.players.map((p,i)=>({p,i,d:distance(p,f.ball)})).filter(o=>o.p.team===team&&!o.p.gk).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d)[0]?.i);
 for(let i=0;i<f.players.length;i++){const p=f.players[i];p.aiTimer-=dt;let vx=0,vz=0;if(i===f.selected){const {fw,sd}=inputAxes(),sp=keys.has('shift')||runPress?(p.n==='Andrej'?7.4:6.7):4.8;vx=(view===2?sd:Math.sin(yaw)*fw+Math.cos(yaw)*sd)*sp;vz=(view===2?-fw:Math.cos(yaw)*fw-Math.sin(yaw)*sd)*sp;}
 else{let tx=p.hx,tz=p.hz;const dir=p.team===0?1:-1;if(p.gk){tx=F.x-dir*(F.w/2-2.5);tz=F.z+clamp((f.ball.z-F.z)*.7,-3.6,3.6);if(f.ball.vx*dir<-.5){const pred=(tx-f.ball.x)/f.ball.vx;if(pred>0&&pred<1.5)tz=clamp(f.ball.z+f.ball.vz*pred,F.z-4,F.z+4);}}
 else if(f.ball.owner===i){tx=F.x+dir*(F.w/2-3);tz=F.z+Math.sin(time*.4+i)*1.8;if(p.aiTimer<=0){const threat=f.players.filter(o=>o.team!==p.team).reduce((d,o)=>Math.min(d,distance(p,o)),99);if(Math.abs(p.x-(F.x+dir*F.w/2))<(f.street?11:16)){kickBall(i,F.x+dir*(F.w/2+2),F.z+Math.sin(time*1.4)*(f.street?1.4:2.6),f.street?16:19,f.street?1.4:2.5,(Math.random()-.5)*2);p.aiTimer=1.5;}else if(threat<2.7){const mate=f.players.filter(q=>q.team===p.team&&!q.gk&&q!==p).sort((a,b)=>(b.x-a.x)*dir)[0];if(mate){kickBall(i,mate.x,mate.z,13,.6,0);p.aiTimer=1.2;}}}}
 else if(chasers[p.team]===i&&(f.ball.owner===null||f.players[f.ball.owner]?.team!==p.team)){tx=f.ball.x+f.ball.vx*.15;tz=f.ball.z+f.ball.vz*.15;}
 else {const ally=f.ball.owner!==null&&f.players[f.ball.owner].team===p.team;tx=clamp(p.hx+(f.ball.x-F.x)*.55+(ally?dir*3.5:0),F.x-F.w/2+3,F.x+F.w/2-3);tz=clamp(p.hz+(f.ball.z-F.z)*.35,F.z-F.d/2+2,F.z+F.d/2-2);}
 const dx=tx-p.x,dz=tz-p.z,L=hyp(dx,dz),sp=p.gk?5.1:f.street?4.5:4.9;if(L>.4){vx=dx/L*sp;vz=dz/L*sp;}}
 p.vx=lerp(p.vx,vx,1-Math.exp(-dt*13));p.vz=lerp(p.vz,vz,1-Math.exp(-dt*13));p.x=clamp(p.x+p.vx*dt,F.x-F.w/2+.6,F.x+F.w/2-.6);p.z=clamp(p.z+p.vz*dt,F.z-F.d/2+.7,F.z+F.d/2-.7);p.move=hyp(p.vx,p.vz);if(p.move>.15)p.yaw=angleLerp(p.yaw,Math.atan2(p.vx,p.vz),Math.min(1,dt*13));p.phase+=p.move*dt*3;}
 for(let i=0;i<f.players.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<f.players.length;j++){const a=f.players[i],b=f.players[j],dx=a.x-b.x,dz=a.z-b.z,d=hyp(dx,dz);if(d>.001&&d<.7){const k=(.7-d)*.5;a.x+=dx/d*k;a.z+=dz/d*k;b.x-=dx/d*k;b.z-=dz/d*k;}}
 if(f.ball.owner!==null&&f.ball.cooldown<=0){const owner=f.players[f.ball.owner];for(let i=0;i<f.players.length;i++){const p=f.players[i];if(p.team!==owner.team&&distance(p,f.ball)<.85){f.ball.owner=i;f.ball.cooldown=.75;sound('kick',.35);break;}}}
 advanceBall(dt/2);advanceBall(dt/2);
}

function sound(kind,volume=1,at=null){if(part2){part2.audio.play(kind,volume,at);return;}if(kind==='step'){surfaceStep();return;}if(kind==='bark'){spatialBark(volume,at||actors[active]);return;}if(!audio||audio.state!=='running')return;try{const t=audio.currentTime,o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain(),pan=audio.createStereoPanner?audio.createStereoPanner():null;const spec={switch:[180,860,.48,.024,'sine'],flare:[280,80,.55,.04,'sawtooth'],interference:[95,240,.4,.035,'triangle'],horn:[125,105,.65,.05,'sawtooth'],step:[75,38,.045,.018,'triangle'],kick:[155,48,.09,.07,'triangle'],bounce:[105,55,.07,.035,'sine'],bump:[90,35,.16,.06,'triangle'],bark:[175,65,.24,.075,'sawtooth'],repel:[1600,2600,.42,.035,'sine'],flash:[650,1900,.16,.025,'sine'],clue:[580,1160,.26,.035,'sine'],goal:[330,990,.7,.045,'triangle'],whistle:[1550,1800,.4,.03,'sine']}[kind]||[330,440,.1,.02,'sine'];o.type=spec[4];o.frequency.setValueAtTime(spec[0],t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(spec[1],t+spec[2]);g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(spec[3]*volume,t+.012);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+spec[2]);o.connect(g);if(pan){pan.pan.value=at?clamp(Math.sin(Math.atan2(at.x-actors[active].x,at.z-actors[active].z)-yaw),-1,1):0;g.connect(pan);pan.connect(audio.destination)}else g.connect(audio.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+spec[2]+.03)}catch(_){}}

 tick(dt){

  this.t=Math.min(this.sceneLength,this.t+dt);
  if(this.t>=14.45&&!this.shotDone){
   this.shotDone=true;
   this.balls[0].vx=4.4;this.balls[0].vz=.28;
   this.sound(.76,190,.11);
  }
  this.physics(dt);

  for(let i=0;i<this.actors.length;i++){
   const a=this.actors[i];a.phase+=dt*(i===2?1.05:.82);
   a.kb11Action=this.speaker===a.n?(this.currentCue?.action||'talk'):'idle';
   if(i===2&&this.t>13&&this.t<17.7)a.kb11Action='pool';
   if(i===1&&this.t>24.7&&this.t<47)a.kb11Action='phone';
  }
  if(this.progress)this.progress.style.width=(this.t/this.sceneLength*100).toFixed(2)+'%';

 speak(c){
  if(!this.voiceOn||!window.speechSynthesis||typeof SpeechSynthesisUtterance!=='function')return;
  try{
   window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
   const utterance=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(c.line);
   utterance.lang='sr-RS';
   const voices=window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
   const voice=voices.find(v=>/^sr(?:-|$)/i.test(v.lang))||voices.find(v=>/^(hr|bs)(?:-|$)/i.test(v.lang));
   if(voice)utterance.voice=voice;
   const profiles={Vuk:[.85,.98],Andrej:[1.01,1.04],Pera:[1.16,1.02],Lazar:[.95,1.08]};
   const profile=profiles[c.name]||[1,1];
   utterance.pitch=profile[0];utterance.rate=profile[1];utterance.volume=.85;
   window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
  }catch(e){console.warn('Kinematografski govor nije dostupan:',e)}
 },
 sound(volume=0.2,freq=270,duration=.09){
  if(!audio||audio.state==='closed')return;
  try{const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain(),now=audio.currentTime;
   o.type='triangle';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
   o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(60,freq*.7),now+duration);
   g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(.0001,volume*.045),now);
   g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+duration);
   o.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+duration+.015);
   o.onended=()=>{try{o.disconnect();g.disconnect()}catch(_){}};
  }catch(_){}
 },
 physics(dt){
  const b=this.balls,r=.09,minX=-1.6,maxX=1.6,minZ=-.77,maxZ=.77;
  let soundAt=false;
  for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++){
   const a=b[i];if(a.pocket)continue;
   a.x+=a.vx*dt;a.z+=a.vz*dt;
   const d=Math.hypot(a.vx,a.vz),drag=Math.exp(-1.15*dt);
   a.vx*=drag;a.vz*=drag;
   if(d<.015){a.vx=0;a.vz=0}
   const pockets=[[-1.61,-.77],[-1.61,.77],[0,-.78],[0,.78],[1.61,-.77],[1.61,.77]];
   if(pockets.some(p=>Math.hypot(a.x-p[0],a.z-p[1])<.21)){a.pocket=true;a.vx=a.vz=0;this.sound(.27,145,.12);continue;}
   if(a.x<minX+r||a.x>maxX-r){a.x=clamp(a.x,minX+r,maxX-r);a.vx*=-.72;soundAt=soundAt||Math.abs(a.vx)>.75}
   if(a.z<minZ+r||a.z>maxZ-r){a.z=clamp(a.z,minZ+r,maxZ-r);a.vz*=-.72;soundAt=soundAt||Math.abs(a.vz)>.75}
  }
  for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<b.length;j++){
   const a=b[i],c=b[j];if(a.pocket||c.pocket)continue;
   let dx=c.x-a.x,dz=c.z-a.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d>=r*2||d<.000001)continue;
   const nx=dx/d,nz=dz/d,over=(r*2-d)*.5;
   a.x-=nx*over;a.z-=nz*over;c.x+=nx*over;c.z+=nz*over;
   const rel=(c.vx-a.vx)*nx+(c.vz-a.vz)*nz;
   if(rel<0){
    const impulse=-.89*rel;
    a.vx-=nx*impulse;a.vz-=nz*impulse;c.vx+=nx*impulse;c.vz+=nz*impulse;
    if(Math.abs(rel)>1.2)soundAt=true;
   }
  }
  if(soundAt&&Math.floor(this.t*10)%3===0&&this.lastClack!==Math.floor(this.t*10)){
   this.lastClack=Math.floor(this.t*10);this.sound(.22,400,.045);
  }
  if(software&&this.preview&&!this.preview.hidden){
   for(let i=0;i<this.ballDots.length;i++){
    const dot=this.ballDots[i],a=b[i];dot.hidden=!a||a.pocket;
    if(a&&!a.pocket){dot.style.left=((a.x+1.6)/3.2*100).toFixed(2)+'%';dot.style.top=((a.z+.77)/1.54*100).toFixed(2)+'%';dot.style.background=a.col;}
   }
  }
 },
 camera(dt){
  if(!this.active||!this.stage)return;
  const shot=this.cameras[this.currentCue?.shot]||this.cameras.wide,S=this.stage;
  const at=shot.target.map((v,i)=>v+(i===0?S.x:i===1?S.y:S.z));
  const eye=shot.eye.map((v,i)=>v+(i===0?S.x:i===1?S.y:S.z));
  const start=this.currentCue?.at||0,end=this.cues?.[this.cueIndex+1]?.at||this.sceneLength||start+4;
  const k=easeShot(clamp((this.t-start)/Math.max(.5,end-start),0,1));
  if(!reduced){const offset=bezierPoint([-.14,.035,0],[-.09,.05,.055],[.05,.015,.09],[.13,0,.11],k);for(let i=0;i<3;i++)eye[i]+=offset[i];}
  const breathe=reduced?0:Math.sin(this.t*.37)*.023;
  eye[0]+=breathe;at[1]+=breathe*.6;
  const f=this.firstCamera?1:1-Math.exp(-dt*(reduced?24:3.5));
  this.firstCamera=false;
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){cam.eye[i]=lerp(cam.eye[i],eye[i],f);cam.target[i]=lerp(cam.target[i],at[i],f)}
  cam.roll=lerp(cam.roll,0,f);
 },

 paint(m){
  if(!this.active||!this.stage)return;
  this.buildRoom(m);
  const {x,z,y}=this.stage;
  for(let i=0;i<this.balls.length;i++){
   const b=this.balls[i];if(b.pocket)continue;
   m.sphere(x+b.x,y+1.345,z+b.z,.091,.091,.091,b.col,3);
   if(i!==0)m.box(x+b.x,y+1.402,z+b.z,.058,.015,.058,'#f7e8ca',3);
  }
  if(this.t>=12.4&&this.t<17.7){
   const pull=this.t<14.45?(Math.sin(this.t*12)*.16):Math.min(.28,(this.t-14.45)*1.2);
   m.rod([x-2.95+pull,y+1.43,z+.13],[x-1.28+pull,y+1.38,z+.02],.032,'#b99562',3);
   m.rod([x-1.67+pull,y+1.39,z+.05],[x-1.28+pull,y+1.38,z+.02],.042,'#ebdcca',3);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<this.actors.length;i++){
   const a=this.actors[i],tmp=Mesh();kb11Model(tmp,a,i,false);
   const correction=y-height(a.x,a.z);
   for(let j=0;j<tmp.out.length;j+=7){
    m.out.push(tmp.out[j],tmp.out[j+1]+correction,tmp.out[j+2],tmp.out[j+3],tmp.out[j+4],tmp.out[j+5],tmp.out[j+6]);
   }
  }
  const v=VUK,saved={x:v.x,z:v.z,yaw:v.yaw,move:v.move,phase:v.phase,wR:v.wR,wL:v.wL,lt:v.lt,mode:v.mode};
  const vi0=m.out.length;
  try{v.x=x-2.48;v.z=z-1.86;v.yaw=1.03;v.move=0;v.phase=this.t*.6;vukHuman(m)}
  finally{Object.assign(v,saved)}
  {const vc=y-height(x-2.48,z-1.86);if(vc)for(let i=vi0+1;i<m.out.length;i+=7)m.out[i]+=vc}
  if(this.t>=30){
   const dog={x:x+5.6,z:z+5.7,yaw:-2.2,phase:this.t*2,move:0,state:'idle'};
   const tmp=Mesh();dogModel(tmp,dog,true);const dy=y-height(dog.x,dog.z);
   for(let j=0;j<tmp.out.length;j+=7)m.out.push(tmp.out[j],tmp.out[j+1]+dy,tmp.out[j+2],tmp.out[j+3],tmp.out[j+4],tmp.out[j+5],tmp.out[j+6]);
  }
  if(this.t>=24.8){
   const blink=Math.sin(this.t*5)>.3?4:3;
   m.box(x+2.2,y+1.13,z+2.0,.35,.055,.22,'#13252c');
   m.box(x+2.2,y+1.164,z+2.0,.28,.01,.16,blink===4?'#a4e0da':'#467c7e',blink);
  }
  m.box(x-5.8,y+.32,z+3.4,1.1,.08,.25,'#7e6a4a');
  m.box(x-5.8,y+.14,z+3.4,.12,.3,.18,'#5e4a34');
 },
 finish(abort=false,skipped=false){
  if(!this.active)return false;
  this.active=false;this.queued=false;
  if(this.previous){
   view=this.previous.view;
   yaw=this.previous.yaw;pitch=this.previous.pitch;
   cam.eye=this.previous.camEye.slice();
   cam.target=this.previous.camTarget.slice();
   cam.roll=this.previous.camRoll;
  }
  this.previous=null;this.speaker='';this.currentCue=null;
  if(this.voiceOn&&window.speechSynthesis)try{window.speechSynthesis.cancel()}catch(_){}
  if(this.overlay)this.overlay.hidden=true;
  gm.classList.remove('kb11-cutscene');
  clearInput();
  if(!abort){
   stateStore.put(this.seenKey,true);
   if(story.on)tip(skipped?'KAT-SCENA PRESKOČENA · nastavlja se misija':'KAT-SCENA ZAVRŠENA · pratite trag prema meteo-stanici.',5);
   else tip(skipped?'Filmska scena preskočena.':'Poslednja partija · scena odigrana. Pokreni priču za misije.',5);
  }
  return true;
 }
};

const kb12Audio={
 held:false,phoneWasPlaying:false,speakerWasPlaying:false,
 hold(){
  if(this.held)return;
  this.held=true;
  const a=SPK.el;
  this.speakerWasPlaying=!!(a&&!a.paused);
  if(a){try{a.pause();SPK.autoPaused=this.speakerWasPlaying}catch(_){}}
  try{this.phoneWasPlaying=!!window.KBPhone3D?.cinemaHold?.()}catch(_){this.phoneWasPlaying=false}
 },
 release(){
  if(!this.held)return;
  this.held=false;
  if(this.speakerWasPlaying&&SPK.el&&!SPK.userPaused){SPK.autoPaused=true}
  try{window.KBPhone3D?.cinemaRelease?.(this.phoneWasPlaying)}catch(_){}
  this.phoneWasPlaying=this.speakerWasPlaying=false;
 }

 function P(o){

function memoryBeat(){

 const index=list.findIndex(p=>t>=p.from&&t<p.to),i=index<0?list.length-1:index,p=list[i];
 return {t,i,u:easeShot(clamp((t-p.from)/(p.to-p.from),0,1)),kids:kb12Mem.kind==='lazar'};
}

function paintMemory(m,stage){
 const {t,i,u,kids}=memoryBeat(),at=(name,x,z,facing,walk=0,gesture=0,tilt=0)=>memoryPerson(m,stage,name,x,z,facing,walk,t*(walk?6.2:1.65),gesture,tilt);
 transformMesh(m,memorySet(kids),stage.x,stage.y,stage.z);
 if(kids){
   const door=Mesh();door.box(.585,1.13,0,1.15,2.26,.078,'#889891',3);door.box(.58,1.72,.047,.72,.56,.028,'#9eafb0',10);door.box(1.02,1.07,.061,.17,.04,.045,'#5b635e');
   const close=easeShot(clamp((t-9)/1.70,0,1));transformMesh(m,door.out,stage.x-.06,stage.y,stage.z-2.52,1.42*(1-close));
   const k=easeShot(clamp(t/8.3,0,1)),moving=t<8.3?.72:0;
   at('lazar',lerp(-1.6,-.35,k),lerp(1.15,-4.0,k),i<2?2.8:1.36,moving,i===3?.46:0);
   at('lena',lerp(.82,.47,k),lerp(.14,-3.98,k),i===0?-1.20:i===1?2.9:-1.44,moving,i===0?.82:.14);
   if(i===2||i===3)at('friend',lerp(2.12,.92,clamp((t-9)/1.9,0,1)), -1.94,-2.80,i===2&&u<.5?.56:0,i===2?.95:.02);
 }else{
   const arrival=easeShot(clamp(t/5.1,0,1)),close=easeShot(clamp((t-7.8)/1.85,0,1)),release=easeShot(clamp((t-11.1)/2.3,0,1));
   const gap=.64-.47*close+.13*release,walk=t<5.1?.65:0,leaving=i===3?u:0;
   at('andrej',-gap+.71*leaving,.105-1.35*leaving,lerp(1.42,2.82,leaving),leaving*.55,i===2?.66:.13,i===2?.10:0);
   at('danica',gap+(1-arrival)*2.4+.79*leaving,.17+(1-arrival)*1.18-1.30*leaving,lerp(-1.47,2.89,leaving),walk+.5*leaving,i===2?.70:.17,i===2?-.08:0);
 }
}
